Enabling a software-defined, electrified future.

Visteon is a technology company that develops and builds innovative digital cockpit and electrification products at the leading-edge of the mobility revolution. Founded in 2000, Visteon brings decades of automotive intelligence combined with Silicon Valley speed to apply global insights that help transform the software-defined vehicle of the future for many of the world’s largest OEMs. The company employs 10,000 employees in 18 countries around the globe. To know more about us click here.

Position Overview

The Technical Product Manager leads Smart Cabin product development and customer pursuits, aligning customer and market needs with competitive, scalable product solutions. The role provides broader product direction, guides strategic RFI/RFQ activity, leads cross-functional execution, and drives prioritization and governance to strengthen product reuse, competitiveness, and delivery.

Key Objectives of this Role 

Support Smart Cabin product strategy and translate customer and market needs into competitive, scalable product solutions.
Lead customer pursuit activities, including RFI/RFQ responses, requirements review, technical solution definition, cost alignment, assumptions, risks, and proposal readiness.
Coordinate global engineering, commercial, purchasing, manufacturing, finance, and supplier contributors to meet product and pursuit milestones.
Drive technical and commercial trade-offs that improve reuse, cost competitiveness, feasibility, quality, and speed to market.
Partner with customers and internal stakeholders to communicate product direction, resolve issues, and support demonstrations and key reviews.
Ensure awarded opportunities transition effectively from pursuit into execution with clear scope, requirements, risks, timing, and ownership.
Provide broader product leadership across assigned Smart Cabin priorities, including roadmap alignment, strategic RFI/RFQ decisions, prioritization, complex trade-offs, and cross-pursuit governance.

Key Performance Indicators 

On-time, complete, and technically accurate RFI/RFQ submissions and product milestones.
Achievement of approved cost, quality, timing, and business-case targets.
Improved product reuse, solution competitiveness, and reduction of avoidable customer-specific variation.
Customer and internal stakeholder feedback on product and technical engagement.
Effective transition of awarded opportunities into execution.

Qualification, Experience And Skills

Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical field; equivalent experience considered.
10+ years of relevant automotive electronics, product development, launch, product management, or technical quotation experience.
Strong understanding of integrated cockpit products and automotive hardware/software development.
Ability to interpret customer requirements and lead system, hardware, software, validation, cost, and schedule trade-offs.
Strong customer communication, analytical, project leadership, and cross-functional influencing skills.
Commercial awareness, including cost modeling and core financial measures.
Demonstrated experience leading complex product work, setting priorities, influencing cross-functional stakeholders, and driving accountability for outcomes.

Key Behaviors 

Critical Thinking
Collaboration
Resilience
Result Orientation

Visteon Culture 

If you thrive in a fast-paced, organizational culture that requires agility, adaptability, and a growth mindset from its employees to thrive and stay ahead of the curve Visteon is the place. We value high performance and a drive for results. Innovation, risk-taking, and continuous learning help us keep up with the ever-changing landscape of our industry and be Market leaders. At Visteon you can be more.

QAD is building a world-class SaaS company, and we are growing. We are looking for talented individuals who want to join us on our mission to help solve relevant real-world problems in manufacturing and the supply chain.

Only candidates based or willing to relocate to Pune will be considered, as our operations are strictly limited to this location.

Job Description

Role Overview

As the Product Manager for Distribution, you are the "Full-Stack" owner of the value stream connecting our suppliers to our customers. You will move beyond tactical ticket-writing to drive the "Why" and "What" for both customer sales and supplier purchasing capabilities. This role is part of our Functional Product Stream, focused on solving pervasive market problems to drive adoption and revenue.

Core Responsibilities

Your work is structured around the Product Management Lifecycle (PMLC), focusing on outcome-based decision gates rather than feature output.

Discovery & Strategy (The "Why")
Market Sensing: Conduct biweekly customer and supplier interactions to validate that identified problems are urgent and pervasive.
Problem Validation: Use data from Win/Loss reports and Customer Advisory Boards (CAB) to build evidence-based business cases.
Opportunity Canvasing: Define the market driver, competitive landscape, and economic impact (ROI) for new distribution initiatives.
Solution & Design (The "What")
Roadmap Ownership: Maintain a 3-year Now/Next/Later roadmap that balances customer sales features, supplier integration, and technical health.
Ruthless Prioritization: Apply the RICE framework (Reach, Impact, Confidence, Effort) to the backlog to ensure we focus on "Return on Effort".
Constraint Definition: Clearly distinguish between MVP (Technical Prototype) and MLP (Minimum Lovable Product) to prevent scope creep.
Delivery & Market Alignment (The "How")
Squad Leadership: Act as the strategic lead for a group of Autonomous Squads (Atomic Scrum Units), collaborating with a Tech Lead and Product Designer.
GTM Readiness: Partner with Product Marketing to ensure Sales, Support, and Customer Success are operationally ready for new releases.
Success Analysis: Post-launch, measure actual adoption and revenue against the original business case metrics to decide whether to Pivot, Persevere, or Kill.
Success Metrics (KPIs)

In a product-led organization, you are measured on Outcomes, not outputs:

ARR: Supporting growth goals for sales. 
Customer Retention: Ensuring users get continuous value from the distribution module.
Outcome Achievement: Meeting the specific success criteria defined in your Business Cases (e.g., reducing purchasing lead times).
Strategic Alignment: Ensuring 100% of your roadmap items are scalable for multiple customers and not bespoke requests.

Qualifications

Experience: 5-10 years of experience in Product Management within supply chain, ERP, or distribution software is highly preferred.
Mindset: High tolerance for ambiguity and a natural curiosity for user problems over technical "purity".
Decision Making: Ability to make "Green Light" investment recommendations based on hard data (logs, usage stats) rather than "gut feel".
Tooling: Proficiency in Aha! for strategy/roadmapping and Jira for execution management.

Additional Information

TeamViewer provides a leading Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology—enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work work better. Our software solutions harness the power of AI and shape the future of digitalization.

We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645,000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1,900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?

Responsibilities

We are looking for a Product Manager to take ownership of the DEX Monitoring and Automations area within TeamViewer ONE. This is a high-impact, highly visible role at the centre of TeamViewer's Autonomous Endpoint Management (AEM) strategy — the journey from reactive IT to fully autonomous endpoint operations.

You will own the product vision, roadmap, and delivery for two equally strategic pillars: proactive digital employee experience monitoring (real-time telemetry, DEX scoring, AI-driven insights) and IT workflow automation (the DEX Hub automation library, Tia Scripting, SCALE instructions, and remediation workflows). Working closely with Engineering, UX, Data, Customer Success, Sales, and GTM teams, you will define clear requirements, deliver iterative value, and create measurable outcomes for both IT administrators and the employees they support.

DEX Monitoring & Insights

Define and execute the product roadmap for real-time DEX telemetry, endpoint health monitoring, and experience scoring, evolving the DEX Score to reflect true user-centric performance during live usage.
Drive the development of AI-powered insights that transform raw telemetry into normalized, actionable intelligence — enabling IT teams to detect, investigate, and remediate issues before employees are impacted.
Own the Tia Reporting capability, enabling self-service conversational reporting and dynamic dashboards that replace static analytics with real-time, natural-language-driven insights.
Expand DEX visibility beyond the desktop by leading the strategy for DEX for Mobile (Android and iOS), Exoprise integration for network and SaaS performance monitoring, and future endpoint architecture investments.
Define and track key experience metrics (DEX Score, MTTR, proactive issue resolution rate) and use these to continuously improve platform effectiveness and customer outcomes.

Automations & Workflow Orchestration

Own the vision and roadmap for the TeamViewer DEX Hub automation library — the centralized, single source of truth for OOTB and custom SCALE instructions, automations, and remediation workflows across the organization.
Lead the strategy for Tia Scripting, enabling IT admins to create automations and scripts through natural language — lowering the barrier to automation creation and eliminating dependence on deep PowerShell or Bash expertise.
Define the end-to-end automation lifecycle: from discovery and creation to testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement — ensuring automation is both powerful and safe for enterprise-scale operations.
Collaborate with Engineering and UX to design automation creation workflows that are accessible to IT generalists while remaining expressive enough for advanced users and MSPs.
Identify and prioritize automation use cases with the highest customer impact, grounded in field data, customer interviews, and win/loss analysis.

Cross-Functional & Strategic

Act as the product domain authority for DEX & Automations — representing roadmap priorities to senior stakeholders, customers, and field teams, and translating strategic goals into actionable, well-scoped requirements.
Partner with GTM, Customer Success, and Sales to develop positioning, enablement materials, and go-to-market strategies that communicate the business value of DEX and automation capabilities to economic buyers (CIOs, DEX Program Owners).
Drive customer discovery through interviews, advisory councils, and field feedback loops — continuously synthesizing market signals into roadmap decisions.
Ensure that all roadmap items ladder to TeamViewer's AEM strategic narrative: the journey from reactive support to proactive, predictive, and ultimately autonomous endpoint management.

Requirements

Must Have

4+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, preferably in endpoint management, ITSM, IT operations, or adjacent enterprise software.
Demonstrated experience owning complex, data-intensive product areas with strong analytical ability — comfort with telemetry, metrics-driven roadmapping, and outcome-based KPIs.
Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer problems into well-defined product requirements and ship iterative value in an agile environment.
Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to influence without authority and align cross-functional stakeholders from Engineering to Executive leadership.
Experience working in or alongside GTM, Sales, or Customer Success functions, with the ability to create compelling product positioning and enablement content.

Nice to Have

Hands-on familiarity with DEX platforms (e.g. 1E, Nexthink, Riverbed Aternity) or IT automation tools (e.g. Ansible, PowerShell DSC, ServiceNow Orchestration).
Understanding of AI/ML concepts as applied to IT operations — anomaly detection, predictive analytics, GenAI for scripting or remediation.
Experience in or exposure to the Gartner DEX Management Tools, UEM, or AEM market categories.
Scripting literacy in PowerShell, Bash, or Python — not a hard requirement, but enables faster domain depth and more productive engineering partnerships.
Fluency in German is a plus given the Munich location and regional customer base.

TeamViewer is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome and supported. We C-A-R-E and understand that our diverse, values-driven culture makes us stronger. As we continue to grow as a company, we also focus on enabling our employees to grow both personally and professionally. We are proud to have an open and embracing workplace environment that will empower you to be your best no matter your gender, civil or family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

Senior Product Manager - Search & Analytics Platform

Sumo Logic is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the data, query, and context foundations that help customers and AI agents understand and act on operational and security telemetry.
Effective investigation depends on finding the right data, querying it efficiently, and understanding how it relates to the customer's environment. As AI agents take on more analytical work, they need dependable access to telemetry and context: which service an entity belongs to, what it depends on, who owns it, and what changed. This role owns the shared platform capabilities that make that possible across observability, security, and platform optimization.
You will own established search and analytics capabilities while building toward federated analytics and a richer customer context foundation. This is a technically deep role requiring first-hand experience with data platforms, search, or analytics products, and the judgment to turn a broad platform vision into useful capabilities that teams can adopt.
What You Will Own
The search and query platform. Search and query capabilities, query language and analytical functions, partitions, views, and shared query services. You will own their roadmap, performance, reliability, and competitiveness, balancing analytical depth, ease of use, and cost for both human and agent workloads.
Federated analytics. Define how customers and agents query and correlate Sumo data with data in connected systems. Establish the use cases, supported analytical capabilities, and tradeoffs around data movement, freshness, performance, permissions, and cost, working closely with the teams responsible for integrations and access.
Customer context and the knowledge graph. Build the shared understanding of a customer's environment: entities, services, workloads, ownership, topology, and dependencies. Define how that context is assembled from telemetry, metadata, and connected systems, how relationships are maintained, and how the accumulated context improves investigation and analysis over time.
Data discovery and shared context services. Help people and agents discover available sources, schemas, fields, and relationships, and retrieve the data and context relevant to a task. Own the shared capabilities that make this information reusable across product experiences, with clear provenance, freshness, and permission boundaries.
What You Will Be Doing
Set the multi-quarter vision and roadmap for the data and analytics platform, connecting current customer needs with the requirements of AI-assisted investigation.
Own the health and evolution of shipping query capabilities, partitions, and views, using customer feedback and workload data to prioritize improvements.
Work with engineering and architecture on query execution, distributed analytics, scalability, and cost at enterprise scale.
Define and validate federated analytics use cases, and turn them into phased capabilities with clear behavior and limits.
Develop the entity and context strategy, including how services and resources are identified consistently across data sources and related to one another.
Partner with investigation, security, knowledge, and agent teams to turn their needs into shared platform capabilities and clear interfaces.
Partner with the product and engineering teams responsible for platform governance to ensure query and context capabilities respect established access controls, audit requirements, and cost policies.
Translate strategy into clear proposals, PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and rollout plans.
Measure query success, latency, reliability, cost, context quality, and adoption, and show how platform improvements improve customer outcomes.
What You Bring
6+ years of product management experience, including direct ownership of data platforms, search, query systems, or analytics products. Relevant platform experience is a hard requirement.
Strong technical understanding of query processing, data organization, indexing, schemas, and distributed systems, with depth in one or more of these areas.
Experience running a live product at scale, balancing customer commitments, performance, reliability, and cost while delivering a longer-term roadmap.
Experience building shared platform capabilities, APIs, or services used by multiple product teams or external developers.
The ability to reason about analytical correctness, incomplete data, data freshness, and the limits of what a system can reliably infer.
Familiarity with federated analytics, metadata platforms, entity resolution, knowledge graphs, or retrieval systems. Experience in one or more of these areas is valuable.
An understanding of how AI agents discover data, use tools, and retrieve context, or the ability to ramp quickly. Observability or security analytics experience is a plus.
Strong analytical skills and comfort using SQL, dashboards, and usage data to understand customer behavior and evaluate tradeoffs.
Clear communication across technical and business audiences, and the ability to write proposals that explain options, dependencies, and recommendations.
Must Have Qualities
Platform judgment. Finds common needs across teams and turns them into capabilities others can depend on.
Customer grounding. Connects technical investment to a concrete improvement in analysis, investigation, or cost.
Data correctness and trust. Treats accuracy, consistency, provenance, and freshness as product requirements.
Runs today and builds tomorrow. Keeps current capabilities healthy while delivering the next generation of the platform.
High ownership. Resolves ambiguity, makes tradeoffs explicit, and drives work through delivery and adoption.
About Us
Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www.sumologic.com.
Sumo Logic Privacy Policy. Employees will be responsible for complying with applicable federal privacy laws and regulations, as well as organizational policies related to data protection.

Senior Product Manager, Integrations

Location: Bangalore, India 

About Tekion:

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform. Our platform spans the Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, the Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises, and the Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform, using cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to bring together vehicle manufacturers, dealerships, and consumers. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia, and Europe.

About the Role:

Tekion connects dealerships - the businesses that sell and service vehicles - with the automakers that build those vehicles, such as General Motors, Honda, or Ford. Across the industry these automakers are referred to as OEMs (Original Equipment Manufacturers). The software on each side needs to exchange information automatically and reliably: vehicle orders, inventory, repair records, customer details, and much more. The software that makes this exchange happen is called integration. We are seeking a driven, technically curious Product Manager I to join our Integrations team. You will take ownership of one integration pattern - a family of similar integrations that share the same shape (for example, all the integrations that send vehicle service and repair data to automakers). Your mission is to make every integration in that family measurably healthy and best-in-class, shift more of its delivery from manual building to AI-assisted building, and make sure dealerships actually adopt and benefit from it. This is a hands-on role for an early-career product manager who is comfortable with technical concepts, motivated by measurable outcomes, and excited to help modernize how a decades-old industry connects its software. You will work closely with Engineering, Design, and senior product managers, who will guide and mentor you as you grow into full ownership of your integration pattern.

What You’ll Do:

• Keep your integrations healthy and best-in-class: Define what “good” looks like for your integration pattern, measure it in our Integration Platform (Tekion’s internal health-monitoring system), and drive coverage, reliability, and quality up across all your integrations - benchmarking each against the best competing product in the market.
• Win on AI-powered delivery: Shift your pattern from hand-built integrations toward ones generated with Tekion’s AI-assisted build tools (internally, APC Studio), help sharpen the AI tools you depend on, and own a complete, living set of requirements that any engineering team can build from.
• Drive revenue through OEM certifications: Lead integration patterns toward successful OEM certification so OEM-approved integrations can be adopted by dealers at scale. Drive adoption and reduce support load: Make your integrations easy to install and switch on, raise dealership uptake where it is low, and reduce support tickets by tracking and fixing root causes.
• Partner across teams: Translate the needs of dealers, automakers, and partners into clear requirements, and work day-to-day with Engineering, Design, Support, and Go-to-Market teams to deliver, launch, and measure impact.

What We’re Looking For:

• Around 6+ years of product management experience, or equivalent experience in a technical product, integration, API, or platform role.
• Exposure to integrations, APIs, or platform and marketplace products, with the ability to read technical documentation and discuss APIs, webhooks, and data flows with engineers. (An API is a defined way for two systems to exchange data; a webhook is an automatic notification one system sends another when something happens. You do not need to write code.)
• A strong bias toward measurable outcomes, with comfort using dashboards, metrics, and data to set targets and track progress.
• Clear writing skills - the ability to turn messy, ambiguous requirements into crisp specifications and user stories. • Curiosity about AI and how it can automate technical work, plus the drive to improve the tools you use.
• Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work with both technical and non-technical audiences.
• The ability to manage ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and make thoughtful trade-offs in a fast-paced environment.
• A bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Have:
• Interest in or exposure to AI agents, large language models (LLMs), and automated workflows.
• Familiarity with the automotive retail world - dealerships, the Dealer Management System (DMS, the core software a dealership runs its business on), or automaker (OEM) certification programs.

Why Join Us :
• Modernize an industry: Help modernize how an entire industry connects its software, moving from slow, hand-built integrations to a fast, AI-powered delivery model.
• Work at the frontier of AI delivery: Be hands-on with how AI is used to scope, build, and test real enterprise integrations.
• See measurable impact: Own clear, measurable goals and watch your work show up directly in integration health, adoption, and support metrics.
• Grow with mentorship: Learn from senior product managers and engineers, with a clear path to grow into broader ownership.

Tekion is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.

Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

Our vision: A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.

About the Role:

Wrike is seeking a highly adaptable Senior Product Manager to join our global product organization. As a strategic leader, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of your product area, driving measurable business impact and solving complex problems for millions of users.

We are looking for a versatile generalist who is comfortable tackling diverse challenges as business needs evolve, but who is ready to immediately dive into a high-impact, transformative domain: AI-driven Work Intake.

Your Impact:


Deliver Innovation: Validate and ship solutions that revolutionize how work flows into systems, saving customers time and boosting work quality for both administrators and end-users. Evolve Wrike's work intake experience through platform and agentic capabilities within your first 6 months.
Drive Discovery & Vision: Deeply understand customer workflows and underlying business pains to uncover emerging needs. Paint a compelling product vision and propose pragmatic, innovative solutions — whether through advanced AI, platform capabilities, or a combination of both — that best solve the core problem.
Adapt & Scale: Act as a flexible product leader capable of pivoting to new, critical product domains as our overarching business strategy evolves.


Your Qualifications:


4+ years of hands-on experience in B2B SaaS Product Management, owning customer-facing digital products from ideation to launch.
Customer-Centric Mindset: Strong empathy for customers and a passion for delivering exceptional user experiences.
Product Discovery: You are experienced in conducting market research and user interviews to identify customer needs and pain points. You are also experienced in testing and validating potential solutions with real users to ensure that they effectively address the identified needs.
Practical AI experience: Hands-on experience with leveraging AI technologies to streamline work and experience with the creation of AI-powered features.
Collaboration Skills: Ability to work well with cross-functional teams and communicate effectively with many partners across different parts of the organization.
Advanced English language skills (written and spoken), with the ability to communicate complex concepts clearly to diverse stakeholders.


Standout Qualities:


Experience in the enterprise collaboration, project management, or work management domain.
Proven experience building and delivering AI or LLM-driven product experiences to market.
Demonstrated ability to balance the complex configuration needs of system administrators with a frictionless experience for end-users.


Team Dynamics:


You will operate within a core "Product Trio" model (Product, UX, and Engineering) to guide a tight-knit Scrum team of 6-8 engineers and QA to deliver the product innovations.
You will partner heavily across the organization, pulling in expertise from specialized roles such as AI/ML engineers, Data Scientists, Product Analytics, and Go-to-Market teams to ensure successful launches.
You will have direct access to enterprise customers and admins to conduct continuous research, test early prototypes, and validate hypotheses through tight feedback loops.
The opportunity to operate at the bleeding edge of AI and work management, blending complex, enterprise-grade capabilities with modern, intelligent user experiences.

Who Is Wrike And Our Culture

We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.

Hybrid work mode

Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.

While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.

Our persona 

💡 Smart: We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.

💚 Dedicated: We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too!

🤗 Approachable: We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful.

Our culture and Values 

🤩 Customer-Focused

We care about our customers. We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.

🤝 Collaborative

We work as one and win together, each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.

🎨 Creative

We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions.

💪 Committed

We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization, by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.

Check out our LinkedIn Life Page, Company culture page, Instagram, Wrike Engineering Team, Medium, Meetup.com, Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike.

An emerging industrial technology company leveraging AI, IoT, and advanced software to help water-treatment and industrial facilities operate more efficiently. Its platform connects equipment, sensors, and plant systems to provide real-time operational insights, predictive maintenance, and process optimization.

About Jupiter
Jupiter is a money app for people who are building their lives in India. From one app you can open a savings account with our partner bank, pay on UPI, save towards goals in Pots, borrow, buy insurance, invest, and see where your money actually goes. Our Edge+ CSB Bank RuPay credit card works on UPI and earns Jewels, our rewards currency, on the brands people already shop with.
We are a product company at heart. We obsess over small details, we read what customers tell us, and we would rather do fewer things properly than many things badly.
Why this role exists
AI is already part of how Jupiter works. Our product team uses an in-house assistant that reads our Confluence, Figma, Amplitude, Databricks and support tickets to answer questions and draft PRDs, right inside Slack. Engineering has a bot that turns a Jira ticket into a draft pull request. Marketing has a creative studio that designs ads, critiques its own work against a checklist and tells us what every run cost.
Those started as tools for us. The next step is bigger: putting AI in front of customers in a product that handles their money, where a confident wrong answer is not a small bug. We are looking for a PM who wants to own that problem, with the judgement to know where AI helps and the discipline to prove it before it ships.
What you will do
Find the problems worth solving with AI. Explaining a declined payment, making sense of a card bill, help that actually closes the ticket, a Money tab that answers questions in plain words. You will also say no to the ideas where a better screen would do the job.
Own products end to end. Problem, PRD, evals, launch, and the numbers after launch. You stay with it until it works for customers, not until it is merged.
Write the evals before the feature. Define what good looks like with real examples, build the test sets with engineering, and decide the score that is good enough to ship. When the model changes, you know within a day whether things got better or worse.
Design for the moments AI gets it wrong. What the assistant says when it does not know, when it hands over to a person, and how a customer corrects it. These moments decide whether people trust us.
Keep it safe and compliant. Work with compliance, risk and our partner banks so everything we build respects RBI guidelines, the DPDP Act and our partners' policies. Customer data stays where it belongs.
Treat cost and speed as product decisions. Know what each conversation costs, pick the right model for each job, and cut what does not earn its keep.
Raise the bar for the whole team. Help other PMs, designers and analysts use AI well in their own work, and keep improving the internal tools they already rely on.
Your first 90 days
By day 30: you use Jupiter every day, have read a few hundred support conversations, have sat with ops and compliance, and know our internal AI tools by using them.
By day 60: you have picked one customer problem, made the case for it with real data, and put a working prototype in front of colleagues.
By day 90: you have an eval set, a launch plan with guardrails, and a small rollout to real customers with one clear success metric.
You will do well here if you
Have 4 to 8 years in product, with at least one AI or ML product shipped to real users. A demo does not count; something people used does.
Can explain in plain words how language models fail (making things up, prompt injection, behaviour shifting between model versions) and how you would design around each.
Are comfortable writing prompts, reading a model's outputs in bulk and spotting the pattern in what went wrong.
Use data without being asked. You can write SQL, build a funnel in Amplitude, and tell a real change from noise.
Write clearly. Your PRDs are short, specific and something an engineer can build from.
Care about the person on the other side of the screen, especially when the subject is their money.
Good to have
Experience in fintech, payments, lending or another regulated space.
You have built with the Claude or OpenAI APIs yourself, even on a side project.
Hands-on time with retrieval (RAG), agents that use tools, or eval tooling.
You can sketch a flow in Figma before a designer picks it up.
What you will work with
Claude and other frontier models through our AI gateway, and MCP to connect agents to our systems.
Amplitude, Databricks, Jira, Confluence, Figma and Sense UI, our design system.
A React Native app, and engineers, designers and analysts who like to move quickly and measure what they ship.
How we work
Small teams own outcomes, not tickets.
Decisions are written down with the reasoning, so anyone can pick up the thread later.
We are honest about results. If a launch did not work, we say so and fix it.

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About The Team And The Role

The Digital Services AI Product team is building the foundation for the next generation of help experiences on eBay. We are focused on making support personalized, effortless, fast, and trusted, providing seamless help where and when customers need it.

With hundreds of millions of listings and a global community of buyers and sellers, eBay’s scale creates a unique opportunity to transform how people find help, resolve issues, and navigate an increasingly complex global commerce and regulatory environment. We are developing an ecosystem of AI Agents and composable AI platforms that enable adaptive, scalable help experiences across every customer touchpoint.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will define and lead the strategy for how we design, build, and scale AI-powered help experiences, including capabilities that help eBay address product regulatory compliance requirements and policies at scale. You will work closely with design, engineering, data science, operations, policy, legal, and compliance teams to turn emerging AI capabilities, customer needs, and regulatory requirements into simple, trusted, and impactful products for customers and the business.

What You Will Accomplish

Define the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for AI Agents, composable AI platforms, and capabilities supporting product regulatory compliance and trusted commerce experiences.
Identify opportunities to use AI, automation, and data to improve how regulatory requirements and product policies are understood, operationalized, and surfaced across customer experiences.
Translate customer, business, policy, and regulatory needs into clear, actionable product direction and requirements.
Partner with Legal, Policy, Compliance, Risk, Operations, Engineering, Design, and Data Science to build scalable solutions that balance customer experience, regulatory obligations, and business objectives.
Use data and experimentation to guide decisions, measure impact, identify emerging risks, and drive continuous improvement.
Bring customer insights, regulatory developments, data, and industry trends together to inform product strategy and improve the product experience.
Develop scalable capabilities that can adapt to evolving product regulations, marketplace policies, and requirements across markets and jurisdictions.
Partner closely with design, engineering, and data science to deliver reliable, explainable, and high-quality AI-powered products at scale.
Build alignment and strong partnerships across teams to stay focused on shared goals and drive execution across complex, cross-functional initiatives.
Keep customer trust, safety, and ease of use at the center of product decisions while enabling eBay to meet its regulatory and policy commitments.


What You Will Bring

6+ years of product management experience, ideally including experience with AI/ML, data-driven products, trust, risk, compliance, policy, or marketplace platforms.
Experience applying AI and automation to improve customer experiences and solve complex customer or business problems, such as conversational AI, decisioning, classification, policy interpretation, or workflow automation.
Experience working on product regulatory compliance, trust, risk, policy, or other regulated product domains is highly valued.
Ability to translate complex regulatory, policy, operational, and technical requirements into scalable product capabilities and intuitive customer experiences.
Skilled at using data and insights to uncover opportunities, drive prioritization, assess risk, and measure success.
Technical fluency and foresight to collaborate effectively with engineers, data scientists, and AI/ML teams.
Strong judgment when working with AI-powered products where accuracy, explainability, customer trust, and regulatory compliance are important.
High ownership mindset with a bias for action and focus on creating customer and business impact.
Exceptional leadership, communication, and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical teams, including Legal, Compliance, Policy, and Operations.
Experience building 0→1 products and navigating ambiguity, evolving requirements, and complex stakeholder environments with confidence.
Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, customer support, self-service, trust, risk, or regulatory technology is a plus but not required.


Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. Description

Amazon is seeking a Senior Product Manager – Technical to drive the product strategy for Delivery Signals across IES marketplaces. They will drive what customers see on delivery related surfaces — badges, delivery messaging, trust markers, and the decision logic that determines which signals appear for which customers. This role sits at the intersection of customer experience and ML-driven personalization, shaping how millions of customers perceive Amazon's delivery proposition.

You will define the product vision and roadmap for evolving delivery signals from uniform display (same content to all customers) to personalized, context-aware delivery communication. You will work closely with ML, BIEs, SDEs, and cross-functional platform teams.

We are looking for a technically strong PM-T who can dive deep into system architecture, write detailed PRDs/BRDs, and deliver in complex, cross-team environments. Experience with customer facing CX designs is highly valued. The role offers senior leadership visibility and broad scope across 10 marketplaces.

Key job responsibilities

Define the product vision and roadmap for delivery signals — badging, speed messaging, trust markers, and per-customer signal personalization across IES marketplaces.
Drive the evolution from uniform signal display to personalized, context-aware delivery communication using ML-driven decisioning.
Use experimentation and analytics to validate signal effectiveness and measure perception and conversion impact.
Collaborate with platform teams and partner organizations to integrate signal logic into shared surfaces and systems.
Communicate strategy and progress to senior leaders and align stakeholders across geographies.
Write PRFAQs, BRDs, and technical specifications for new signal types and personalization capabilities.

About The Team

As Amazon’s DEX product team, we are at the forefront of the Customer Experience product thought leadership - working on some of the most difficult Customer Experience problems while partnering with research scientists, software developers, and business leaders. With the focus on driving real impact on Amazon's long-term profitability, we build new analysis from ground up, proposing new concepts and technology to meet business needs, and translating these concepts into robust scalable products that deliver tangible value to our customers and to the A.in business.

Bachelor's degree
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product

8+ years of technical product management, program management or engineering experience

As a Product Manager for Core Infrastructure at Sibros, you aren't just managing a backlog - you are the architect of the foundational pipeline that connects vehicles to the cloud. You will sit at the intersection of embedded automotive systems, distributed cloud computing, and business strategy. We are looking for a highly technical product leader who can navigate the complex, high-stakes landscape of modern vehicle architectures. You will own the core platforms that orchestrate flawless over-the-air (OTA) updates, secure remote diagnostics, and resilient vehicle-to-cloud data ingestion, transforming complex technical constraints into a highly reliable, scalable enterprise platform.

What you’ll do

Own the Core Vehicle-to-Cloud Pipeline: Lead the full product lifecycle for our foundational infrastructure products, including OTA orchestration engines and remote command delivery. You will ensure this core platform acts as a rock-solid, extensible foundation that reliably powers all downstream applications built on top of it, such as advanced troubleshooting, predictive maintenance, and fleet management tools.
Optimize Value Delivery: Ruthlessly prioritize the platform backlog. You’ll make the hard trade-off decisions between technical debt, architectural scalability, security compliance, and OEM feature requests to maximize platform ROI.
Define System Boundaries and APIs: Partner closely with Embedded, Cloud, and Security Engineering to define robust APIs, data contracts, and platform abstractions that allow Sibros to integrate seamlessly into diverse OEM vehicle architectures.
Drive Platform Reliability & Scale: Define and track critical platform KPIs (e.g. OTA success rates, command latency, system uptime) and use technical discovery to address architectural bottlenecks proactively.
Autonomous Decision-Making: Act as the primary authority for your platform infrastructure domain, synthesizing deeply technical constraints and market requirements into a clear, prioritized roadmap without requiring day-to-day tactical guidance.
Cross-Functional Technical Leadership: Interface with Business Development, Solutions Architecture, and Engineering to translate complex OEM infrastructure requirements into scalable, platform-agnostic solutions that serve diverse vehicle segments.

What you should know

Required Qualifications

Professional Experience: 5+ years of Product Management experience in high-growth environments, with a proven track record of delivering deeply technical platform products, infrastructure, or middleware at scale.
Automotive & Mobility Domain Expertise: Strong understanding of the vehicle architecture ecosystem, including telemetry, automotive communication protocols (CAN, Ethernet), and diagnostic standards (UDS, SOVD).
Systems Thinking & Scale: Experience managing backend or platform products that bridge embedded edge environments and distributed cloud infrastructure. You design with the entire ecosystem in mind, ensuring that changes to the core platform account for, support, and align with upstream OEM workflows, downstream applications, and broader data dependencies.
Strategic Autonomy: You are a principled, self-directed leader with a history of making high-stakes technical decisions independently. You excel at navigating ambiguity and establishing clear technical directions in a fast-paced environment.
Technical Communication: Exceptional ability to translate complex architectural constraints and infrastructure concepts into strategic business value for executive stakeholders and OEM partners.

Preferred Qualifications

Automotive Cybersecurity & Safety Standards: Familiarity with functional safety (ISO 26262), automotive cybersecurity (ISO 21434).
Engineering Roots: A background in Embedded Software, Cloud Systems Architecture, or Systems Engineering is highly desirable.
Enterprise Integration: Experience building developer-facing tools, SDKs, or highly flexible APIs used by third-party enterprise engineering groups.

Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. About the Role:

GSK’s Enterprise AI team, a highly skilled applied AI group, translates the promise of AI into measurable impact across every major group at GSK — R&D, Medical, Commercial, Supply Chain, HR, Legal, Finance, and beyond. Bionic pods — AI product managers, forward deployed engineers, full-stack engineers, data engineers, and digital workers — embed directly with scientific and business teams to build AI products that change outcomes.

We are hiring a Staff, AI Product Manager (Director level equivalent role) to own a major slice of our Global Functions portfolio and act as the strategic counterpart to the engineers and digital workers in your pod, setting the forward deployed strategy they execute against. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can identify and shape high-value AI opportunities across the key areas of Global Functions - HR, Legal, Compliance, Procurement, or Finance, build the case to fund and deploy against them, and ensure FDEs are working on what matters most. You will not manage engineers; you will shape what they build in your domain and how we measure whether it worked.

Why This Role Exists:

Forward deployed teams are most powerful when paired with sharp opportunity selection. Enterprise AI has no separate strategy layer: the AI Product Manager sets the forward deployed strategy, and the pod executes it. This role closes that gap at this level by ensuring the engineers we deploy are working on the right things.

In this role you will be the person who:

Owns a clear domain or capability area within the Enterprise AI opportunity portfolio.
Identifies, sizes, and shapes the highest-value AI opportunities in that domain.
Partners daily with forward deployed, full-stack, and data engineering leads to scope and steer engagements end-to-end.
Builds the business and executive alignment the pod needs to land and scale.

How This Differs from Traditional Product Management:

This is not a traditional enterprise product role managing a source system’s roadmap, releases, and backlog. As an AI Product Manager in Enterprise AI, you:

Build new AI products from ambiguous, unsolved business problems rather than evolving an established platform.
Work with probabilistic systems — defining evaluations, acceptable error, and human oversight instead of fixed functional requirements.
Help lead a bionic pod, deciding which work goes to engineers and which to digital workers, and how they hand off.
Prototype hands on and are measured on business outcomes, not features shipped or system uptime.

Key Responsibilities:

Opportunity Identification & Value Sizing:

Hunt for high-value AI opportunities within your assigned domain at GSK; develop a structured pipeline of opportunities ranked by impact, feasibility, and time-to-value.
Quantify value rigorously. Build credible business cases that survive finance and senior business unit scrutiny — cycle time saved, decisions accelerated, revenue uplift, cost avoided, scientific productivity gained.
Develop deep domain pattern recognition so you can spot AI-shaped problems in workflows the business itself hasn’t yet articulated.

Strategic Prioritization & Portfolio Shaping:

Shape the opportunity portfolio in your domain. Maintain a living view of in-flight, queued, and de-prioritized opportunities, with the rationale for each decision, and feed it into the broader Enterprise AI portfolio.
Make trade-off recommendations. When two business sponsors both want an FDE pod, defines the success metrics, run the analysis and recommend where engineers go.
Protect engineering focus. Push back — with evidence — on opportunities that won’t move scalable outcomes. 

Engineering Partnership & Enablement

Be the strategic counterpart to forward deployed, full-stack, and data engineering leads in your domain. Translate ambiguous business problems into crisp problem statements, prototypes, success metrics, and decision frameworks engineers can build against.
Shape engagements end-to-end. Define scope, success criteria, exit conditions, and scaling pathways before kick-off, then stay close as engineers execute.
Surface re-use and platform leverage when a one-off solution should become a reusable capability.
Design the human–digital split. Decide which tasks the pod’s digital workers own, where engineers and business users stay in the loop, and how evaluation and oversight make that safe.

Stakeholder Alignment & Communication

Operate fluently with VP-level business and scientific leaders. Run conversations that turn fuzzy ambitions into concrete, fundable AI engagements.
Build sponsor coalitions that secure data access, change-management commitment, and air cover for your engagements.
Communicate impact clearly in language that connects AI work to patients, science, and enterprise outcomes.

Measurement, Learning & Iteration

Apply Enterprise AI’s value-realization framework to every engagement in your domain and improve it with what you learn.
Run honest post-mortems and feed lessons back into how your domain selects opportunities.

Required Functional Experience:

18+ years of progressive experience spanning some combination of pharma/life sciences, AI/ML product strategy, and senior product management or strategy roles in technology-led organisations.
Demonstrated track record of identifying, scoping, prototyping, and shepherding high-value technology or AI initiatives from problem framing through funding into delivery.
Strong working knowledge of at least one part of the pharma value chain — R&D, clinical, medical, manufacturing, commercial, or an enterprise function — including the data, decisions, and constraints inside it.
Solid technical fluency in modern AI/ML — LLMs, agentic systems, and digital workers, ML lifecycle, data and evaluation patterns — sufficient to leverage evidence from rapid prototyping to challenge engineers, scope realistically, and avoid hype-driven choices.
Experience operating as a senior individual contributor — leading through influence, frameworks, and quality of thinking rather than headcount.
A product management or product-strategy heritage: discovery, opportunity sizing, roadmap shaping, prototyping, and stakeholder alignment — ideally on products whose core behaviour is AI rather than conventional software.

The Role 

Tala is on a mission to unleash the economic power of the global majority. We’re building financial services that give people greater access, control, and agency over their financial lives.

As Tala continues to scale, protecting our customers while creating a seamless experience is more important than ever. We’re looking for aSenior Product Manager, Fraud & Authentication to lead the strategy and execution of the systems that keep our customers and platform safe.

As the Senior Product Manager, Fraud & Authentication, you’ll own Tala’s product strategy for fraud prevention, customer authentication, and identity-related experiences across the customer journey.

You’ll tackle complex problems at the intersection of fraud, risk, machine learning, data, engineering, and customer experience.

Your goal will be to help Tala identify and prevent fraudulent activity while minimizing unnecessary friction for legitimate customers.

You’ll work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Lending, Finance, Customer Care, Marketing, Legal, and other global teams to turn complex fraud patterns and ambiguous problems into scalable products and systems.

This is a highly cross-functional role for someone who enjoys solving difficult problems with data, moving quickly, and building products that have a measurable impact on both customers and the business.

What You'll Do

Own Fraud & Authentication Product Strategy

Define and own Tala’s multi-year product strategy and roadmap for fraud prevention, customer authentication, identity, and related risk capabilities.
Identify opportunities to improve fraud prevention across signup, login, account management, and other high-risk customer actions.
Balance fraud prevention with customer experience by reducing fraud losses and false positives while minimizing unnecessary friction.
Translate complex fraud patterns, emerging attack vectors, and business needs into clear product strategies and priorities.

Build Data-Driven Fraud Products

Partner closely with Data Science and Analytics to define model objectives, evaluate model and feature performance, and identify opportunities to improve detection.
Help determine appropriate fraud decision thresholds and rules based on data and business objectives.
Establish and monitor key metrics such as fraud loss rates, detection accuracy, false-positive rates, customer conversion, and authentication success.
Identify data gaps and work with technical teams to improve the data and infrastructure needed to make effective fraud decisions.
Collaborate on fraud detection models, rules, feature infrastructure, and decisioning systems.

Lead Product Execution

Translate ambiguous fraud and authentication problems into clear product requirements that Engineering teams can execute against.
Lead a cross-functional team of engineers and partners to deliver the roadmap.
Prioritize initiatives based on customer impact, fraud exposure, business value, technical complexity, and data.
Partner with Engineering to understand Tala’s fraud and authentication infrastructure and identify opportunities to improve scalability and reliability.
Drive initiatives from strategy and discovery through launch, measurement, and iteration.

Manage Fraud & Risk Events

Partner with Data Science, Analytics, Engineering, and Operations to investigate fraud incidents and emerging fraud patterns.
Turn lessons from fraud events into proactive product and system improvements.
Develop approaches that allow Tala to respond quickly as fraud patterns and attack vectors evolve.

Collaborate Across Tala

Build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Lending, Finance, Customer Care, Marketing, and Legal.
Communicate complex fraud and risk concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Manage relationships with external vendors and technology partners supporting fraud, authentication, identity, or risk capabilities.
Create alignment across distributed global teams and drive decisions in an environment where information may be incomplete or ambiguous.

What You'll Need

5+ years of Product Management experience, with experience owning complex technical products or platforms.
Proven experience building or managing products related to fraud, risk, authentication, identity, KYC, account security, payments, lending, or financial crime.
Experience partnering closely with Engineering and Data Science to build fraud detection, risk decisioning, authentication, or identity solutions.
Experience using data and metrics to make product decisions and measure outcomes.
Experience managing fraud incidents, emerging fraud patterns, or other high-impact risk events.
Ability to translate complex and ambiguous problems into clear product requirements and actionable roadmaps.
Experience managing external vendors or technology partners.
Strong cross-functional leadership and communication skills.
Comfort operating in a fast-paced, distributed, and highly collaborative environment.

We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.
What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE
Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.
We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 
If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE
We are seeking a Principal Product Manager to lead our Factory Tech within our Sourcing team. Quince is building the operating system for the factories, mills, and vendors that make our products. Factory OS is the software our supply partners run their operations on — planning, scheduling, capacity, quality, and compliance — replacing spreadsheets and disconnected tools with one system of record for how goods actually get made.
As Principal PM, you own this platform end to end: the vision, the roadmap, and the hard calls about what we build, for whom, and in what order. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with vendors and mills on the factory floor, and with our engineering, ops, and sourcing teams, to turn messy real-world production workflows into reliable software. This is a builder's role with outsized scope — you're defining a category, not iterating on a mature one.
Responsibilities
Own the Factory OS product strategy — from vendor/mill discovery through roadmap, specs, and launch — and be accountable for adoption and measurable operational impact (adoption, on-time production, capacity utilization, quality yield, planning accuracy).
Design the core operational workflows — production planning, scheduling, capacity management, order and material tracking — so they hold up under the reality of a working factory, not just a demo.
Build for compliance and auditability from day one. Factory data touches sourcing, labor, quality, and trade requirements. You'll make compliance, traceability, and auditability first-class product surfaces, not bolt-ons — and ensure the system produces the records our partners and Quince are held to.
Drive real adoption on the floor. A system that vendors and mills won't use is worthless. You'll obsess over onboarding, change management, and the gap between "shipped" and "used daily"
Set the AI and automation thesis. Architect Factory OS for a future where every automatable workflow is executed by an agent, not a person clicking through screens. Decide which steps to automate first, design the human-in-the-loop and exception paths, and treat agents, APIs, and humans as composable actors in auditable, business-grade workflows.
Partner deeply cross-functionally with engineering, ML, design, sourcing, and factory operations — translating ambiguous problem statements into shipped products.

Qualifications
Required
10+ years in product management, including senior/principal-level ownership of a complex B2B SaaS or operational software product from zero-to-one or through significant scale
Direct experience building workflow-automation software - you've taken manual, multi-step operational processes and turned them into software that runs them, and you understand the difference between digitizing a workflow and actually automating it.
Domain proximity to manufacturing, supply chain, or factory/operations software (MES/MOM, ERP, planning/scheduling, quality, or sourcing systems). You don't need to have run a factory, but you need to have built for people who do.
A credible point of view on AI and agents in production software - not slideware. You've shipped, or can clearly articulate how you'd ship, agentic and human-in-the-loop automation into a real operational system.
A track record with compliance-sensitive products — you've built software where auditability, traceability, and regulatory or contractual requirements were core to the design.
Hands-on AI fluency — you use AI tools daily for discovery, spec-writing, and prototyping, and you build to think.
Comfort in the field — you'll spend time with vendors and mills, and you're energized (not deterred) by messy, physical, real-world operations
Preferred
Experience building software used by external partners/suppliers (not just internal or single-tenant customers).
Background in apparel, textiles, consumer goods, or hard-goods manufacturing supply chains

WHY QUINCE?
Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

As a technical product manager, the individual will serve as a liaison among various teams, facilitating collaboration between technology, product, and business groups. Primary responsibilities include developing features for existing and new platforms, leading integrations with new businesses, and ensuring that AML & Sanctions requirements meet regulatory obligations while supporting business enablement.

Candidates should demonstrate a strong work ethic, leadership ability, sound judgment, effective time management, and the capacity to work in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment. An understanding of the payment industry and Visa’s Compliance program is required to develop requirements for building new features. The group supports multiple products and verticals across Visa, requiring strong collaboration, relationship-building, and partnership skills with engineering, operations, product, compliance, and other internal teams.

This role requires interest in payment innovation, technology, and product management, attention to detail, and the ability to achieve results within a complex setting. Technical competence in database queries, supporting large-scale platforms, troubleshooting incidents, conducting data analysis, and participating in technical and functional solution development is necessary.

The position also requires familiarity with current industry developments, strong organizational abilities, written and verbal communication skills, analytical thinking, structured problem-solving, and experience in customer or partner interaction, management, and software solution delivery.

Who are we?

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Job Summary

This is a senior individual contributor role with broad influence across the company. You will own the product strategy for Equinix's conversational AI and assistant platforms — chat, voice, and agentic interfaces that employees, customers, and partners interact with directly. You will work closely with engineering and architecture teams on technical decisions while also helping executives understand business implications, investment choices, and risk.

You will serve as a conversational AI product leader across Go to Market, Operations, Product, and Corporate functions. Depending on the initiative, you may advise business leaders, partner with product and engineering teams, or directly lead product strategy and delivery for conversational experiences and the platform capabilities that power them.

The conversational AI market is changing quickly — from single-turn chatbots to multi-agent, tool-using assistants. An important part of this role is evaluating new conversational AI technologies, identifying which capabilities are relevant to Equinix, and translating them into practical product and platform investment decisions.

Responsibilities

Conversational AI, Cloud, and Data Architecture

Bring strong working knowledge of conversational AI, dialogue systems, agent orchestration, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise data architecture to product and platform decisions
Partner with engineering and architecture teams to evaluate large language model architectures, conversational agent design patterns (orchestrator/worker, multi-agent handoff, tool calling), cloud deployment approaches, and enterprise data pipelines
Participate meaningfully in technical and architecture reviews, as well as product and roadmap discussions for the conversational platform
Translate technical choices, constraints, and risks into clear business implications that leaders can understand and act on
Help ensure conversational AI products are designed for enterprise scale, security, reliability, multi-channel support (chat, voice, embedded assistants), and reuse across business functions

Conversation Design, Model Strategy, and Deployment

Guide decisions on prompt design, retrieval augmented generation, conversation flow and dialogue management, model customization, fine tuning, and model selection for conversational use cases
Help teams determine when a smaller model may provide better latency, cost, or control for real-time conversational interactions than a larger model
Partner with AI and machine learning engineering teams on deployment approaches for conversational agents across cloud, private infrastructure, and low-latency environments
Evaluate emerging approaches such as multi-agent coordination, model routing, tool/function calling, memory and context management, and hybrid model deployment for conversational systems
Use conversation quality metrics, containment and escalation rates, model performance data, evaluation results, user feedback, and business outcomes to guide product priorities

Platform Reliability and Responsible AI

Define product requirements for conversational AI system reliability, availability, latency, performance, monitoring, usage limits, and incident response
Partner with engineering teams to improve visibility into conversational agent behavior, model performance, cost, conversation logs, and production issues
Establish requirements that support traceability, explainability, auditability, fairness, privacy, and regulatory compliance across conversational interactions
Work with Legal, Security, Privacy, and AI Governance teams to incorporate company policies and responsible AI requirements into conversational products and platforms, including data handling within chat, voice, and memory features
Partner with Design to create clear conversational UX that explains how AI is being used, manages user expectations, and provides appropriate review, control, hand-off to a human, and approval within the conversation itself

Product Decisions and Risk Management

Lead decisions involving tradeoffs among business value, delivery speed, technical complexity, cost, performance, and risk for conversational AI features
Establish clear and repeatable methods for evaluating major conversational AI product and architecture decisions
Help teams identify risks early — including hallucination, unintended actions, and improper data exposure in conversational contexts — and determine the appropriate level of governance and human oversight
Balance the need to deliver conversational value quickly with the requirements of security, reliability, and responsible AI

Executive and Cross Functional Leadership

Build alignment across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Legal, Information Security, Data, Design, and business functions on the conversational AI roadmap
Influence decisions through expertise, clear reasoning, and strong working relationships rather than direct authority
Explain complex technical topics in clear language that is relevant to both technical and business audiences
Work with senior leaders to connect conversational AI investments to business priorities, customer value, productivity, and operational outcomes
Develop trusted relationships so that teams engage early when evaluating important conversational AI opportunities or decisions

Qualifications

Master's degree or doctorate in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, Physics, or a related field
Experience working with models and platforms from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or the open source community, including agent frameworks and orchestration tooling
Experience with machine learning operations, model evaluation, AI monitoring, or conversational AI observability tools
Experience defining service requirements for conversational AI systems, including availability, latency, performance, monitoring, usage limits, and operational support
Knowledge of responsible AI practices, including explainability, model documentation, evaluation, audit processes, governance, and policy implementation for conversational systems
Experience working with research, engineering, or innovation teams to bring conversational AI capabilities into production
Experience designing conversational AI user experiences that support transparency, consent, user review, and appropriate human control (e.g., escalation to a live agent)
Experience in data centers, cloud infrastructure, telecommunications, or enterprise technology
Experience building AI assistants, chatbots, voice agents, or AI-enabled conversational workflows at enterprise scale
Experience with business software, enterprise platforms, or products designed for developers
