We're looking for a Principal Product Manager This role is Office Based, Hyderabad Office 

Principal Product Manager – Labor Market Intelligence 

About The Role

Cornerstone's Intelligence+ portfolio is building the workforce intelligence layer for the world's largest organizations — connecting skills, roles, people, and external labor market data into a single decision-making fabric. At the heart of this is a family of analytics and insight products that turn complex, multi-source data into trusted answers for enterprise leaders.

We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to bring Labor Market Intelligence (LMI) into the heart of our workforce intelligence product — owning how labor market data and models become customer-facing analytics, visualization, and decision experiences across the Intelligence+ platform. You'll work in close partnership with the data science team that owns the underlying LMI models.

This is a senior IC role for a PM who has built data analytics products — not just shipped software. You know what it takes to earn user trust in a number on a screen: data quality, methodology transparency, the right visualization for the right question, and AI/ML that is explainable rather than magical.

In this role you will... 

Own how the Labor Market Intelligence offering is embedded into the workforce intelligence product — shaping the roadmap for LMI-powered experiences from data ingestion through customer-facing analytics.
Partner with data science on ML models, taxonomy mapping, normalization, and inference — defining evaluation criteria and making explainability a product requirement, not an afterthought.
Collaborate with product teams across the portfolio to bring labor market signal into their own surfaces and workflows.
Design insight and visualization experiences that make complex workforce and market data legible and decision-ready.
Define the analytics measurement framework for the product itself: adoption, insight quality, and demonstrable customer value.
Work directly with enterprise customers to shape requirements, run pilots, and convert feedback into product direction.
Drive GTM readiness with field enablement, packaging, and positioning — including consultative, services-led delivery models.
Operate as an internal and external thought leader on data-driven decision making and AI-powered workforce intelligence.

You've Got What It Takes If You Have…

8+ years of product management experience with wide-ranging expertise, operating at Principal/Lead scope — you determine methods and approaches on new initiatives independently and guide the work of others.
Demonstrated experience building data analytics and visualization products — BI, people analytics, market intelligence, or similar — where the data itself was the product.
Genuine AI/ML product depth: you've shipped features built on models, worked with data scientists on training data, evaluation, and inference quality, and can reason about tradeoffs between deterministic and probabilistic approaches.
Experience limited to managing a standard software development lifecycle is not sufficient for this role.
Strong personal analytical fluency — you can pull the data yourself, sanity-check a methodology, and challenge a dashboard's framing.
Experience with enterprise B2B customers, including executive-level stakeholder management
Excellent written communication — PR/FAQs, customer narratives, and technical specs with equal fluency.
Hands-on, daily use of AI tools — LLMs, AI coding assistants, and agentic workflows — to prototype, analyze data, and ship faster; you model AI-native ways of working and raise the bar for how the team builds.
Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward building: you'd rather put a working prototype in front of a customer than a slide.

Nice To Have

Experience with LLM-based features and agentic product experiences.
Prior experience in HCM, talent intelligence, or people analytics platforms.
Exposure to compliance considerations for AI products (EU AI Act, data privacy).

Why This Role

You'll own a product with direct executive visibility, an enterprise customer base, and a central role in Cornerstone's AI strategy — shaping how enterprises understand and act on their workforce and the market around it.

Our Culture

Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.

Who We Are

At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.

Check us out on LinkedIn , Comparably , Glassdoor , and Facebook !

jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
Our client is on a mission to make school transportation safer for children and communities. As a leader in AI-powered safety solutions, our client brings cutting-edge technology—AI, machine learning, and IoT—to school buses across North America.

Key Outcomes

This role is critical to transforming how our client thinks about the health and lifecycle of our units deployed in the field and the experience of numerous internal and external stakeholders (target users). High-level goals for this new capability include:

Reduce mean time to resolve (MTTR) for bus and hardware issues by 25–50% within 12 months. 
Increase in-field uptime of critical hardware kits (e.g., cameras, sensors, edge devices) by a defined target (e.g., X%) through improved monitoring, diagnostics, and maintenance workflows. 
Clarify and prioritize asset criticality, enabling operations teams to focus on buses and routes with the greatest safety and enforcement impact. 
Improve detection, triage and automated remediation of asset issues (e.g., false alarms, connectivity problems, firmware regressions) through better dashboards, alerts, and root-cause analysis tools. 
Strengthen collaboration between Product, Hardware, Firmware, Data, Operations, and Support, with a shared set of metrics and a transparent roadmap in Jira. 

Responsibilities

Own the Vision & Roadmap

Define the strategy for Asset Health across BusPatrol's hardware portfolio, with a clear, data- driven strategy for reliability, availability, and lifecycle management. 
Balance user empathy with enforcement rigor to drive behavior change. 
Make clear trade-offs between short-term reliability fixes and longer-term platform investments, ensuring we build for scale. 

Lead with Data and Insight

Define and own key performance indicators for Asset Health (e.g., MTTR, failure rates, uptime, alert precision/recall). 
Leverage strong analytical skills to do impact sizing, opportunity assessment, and "Fermi style” estimation to guide decision-making. 
Establish feedback loops with internal users and customers to continuously refine problem definitions, success metrics, and solutions. 

Design for Predictive Maintenance & Operational Excellence

Partner with Hardware, Firmware, and Data teams to design telemetry and diagnostics needed to predict failures before they affect service. 
Define health indicators and thresholds (e.g., error rates, connectivity drops, temperature, performance degradation) and ensure they are surfaced in usable tools. 
Build or enhance internal tools, dashboards, and workflows that help Support and Operations quickly identify, triage, and resolve asset issues. 
Incorporate behavioral design principles so internal users know when to act, what to do, and how to prioritize among competing alerts. 

Drive Experimentation in a Regulated, B2G Environment

Innovate testing to design pilots, phased rollouts, and proxy metrics that work in a B2G context. 
Collaborate with government partners and school districts to validate changes within legal and contractual frameworks. 
Use structured experimentation and strong metrics to de-risk changes that affect enforcement, evidence quality, and service levels. 

Foster Cross-Functional Alignment

Act as a quarterback for a broader set of teams when issues are root caused to various layers in the technology stack, hardware, firmware, software, human process 
Partner closely with many stakeholder groups across the company 
Communicate roadmap and trade-offs clearly to executives and external partners. 

Champion Governance, Safety & Compliance

Ensure asset-related data and monitoring solutions respect privacy, retention, and evidentiary requirements, in collaboration with Legal and Compliance. Especially navigating these challenges from outside the United States. 
Balance the need for rich telemetry and model training data with evolving data privacy and retention constraints. 
Advocate for transparency and auditability in the systems that support enforcement and evidence integrity. 

What You Bring

7+ years in product management, with experience in predictive maintenance, asset monitoring, or similar, especially in B2G. 
Experience working with hardware + software products (e.g., cameras, sensors, IoT devices, edge computing, or telematics). 
Strong analytical skills, comfortable with proxy metrics, impact sizing, and experimentation. 
Ability to navigate ambiguity and regulatory complexity with creativity and rigor. 
Exceptional communication skills for executive and government audiences. 
Experience in automated traffic enforcement or fleet safety is a strong plus. 
A bias for action, the experience to lead from the front, and the wisdom to empower others while leading from the back. 
Proven ability to lead cross-functional strategic initiatives with senior executives. 
Proven experience leading high impact teams across time zones. 
Strong data science and analytical skills with experience in sizing, Fermi style estimation, impact analysis, metrics, experiments, and measurement. 
Comfortable with ambiguity, developing clear and concise priorities and roadmaps. 
Demonstrated track record of leading cross-functional initiatives that involve senior executives and multiple stakeholder groups. 
Experience collaborating with distributed teams across time zones; comfortable working remotely from India while partnering closely with North American counterparts.

Staff Product Manager | Adtech | Retail

About The Role

We're building India's premium retail media platform, taking the commerce and AdTech infrastructure we've built and battle-tested at scale and externalizing it as a high-performance ads platform for brands, sellers and retail partners. This is a rare opportunity to productize proven infrastructure: high-QPS ad serving inside live shopping journeys, rich first-party commerce signals and closed-loop measurement that connects ad spend directly to sales.

We're looking for a Staff product manager who can operate as true owners, people who go deep on the problem, write the doc, align the room, ship, refine and repeat. This is an individual contributor role with outsized scope and direct access to leadership, customers and partners.

What You'll Do

Own the product end-to-end. Break down the vision, define the scope for your area of the retail media stack- from competitor research and seller ecosystem discoveries through PRDs, MVPs, launch and iteration. You write crisp docs, and your docs drive decisions.
Translate business goals into product strategy. Take ambiguous, high-stakes objectives, monetization targets, brand adoption, shopper experience guardrails and turn them into a clear, sequenced roadmap with measurable outcomes.
Ship, measure, refine. Break complex problems into executable slices, run tight sprints with engineering, define success metrics upfront (ROAS, ACOS, relevance scores, incrementality) and iterate fast on real data, delivering at scale and on time.
Build experiences, not just features. Obsess over both sides of the marketplace: brands and sellers who need intuitive self-serve tools, and shoppers whose experience must never degrade for the sake of monetization. Think in ecosystems campaign consoles, APIs, reporting, retail partner workflows, not isolated deliverables.
Balance relevance and revenue. Partner deeply with search, recommendations and data science teams on auction mechanics, product relevance/ranking and ad-load decisions where commerce relevance and monetization meet.
Drive alignment across the company. Work daily with engineering, QA, ops, category, and seller-facing teams and liaise with Legal, Finance, IT, and Regulatory on the things that make or break an ad platform including (but not limiting to) privacy, compliance, billing, fair marketplace policies.
Be the face of the product externally. Engage directly with brands, sellers, retail and tech partners, from discovery conversations to API and feed integration deep-dives and bring their voice back into the roadmap.
Influence without authority. Communicate product vision clearly to senior leadership and key stakeholders and shape how the platform is positioned in the retail media market.

What We're Looking For

4-8 years of product management experience, with meaningful time in retail media or commerce ads. You've built or scaled ad products on a marketplace, e-commerce/q-commerce platforms, retail media networks or commerce DSPs.
Hands-on exposure to the retail media stack. Sponsored products, sponsored brands, PLA/PLP (collection based display ads), Search Ads. Understands ad placements, auction design and bidding (CPC/CPM, second-price), budget pacing and self-serve campaign management for advertisers of every size from enterprise brands to long-tail sellers.
Fluency in commerce data and measurement. First-party shopper signals, catalog and feed integrations, closed-loop attribution, ROAS and incrementality measurement with exposure to clean rooms, audience products with offsite extension to programmatic and social.
Strong grasp of marketplace dynamics and privacy. You understand the tension between ad load and shopper experience, fair-ranking and marketplace-neutrality considerations and the evolving privacy landscape (DPDP, GDPR, consent frameworks, and the post-cookie shift).
Sharp analytical instincts. You're comfortable in data, defining metrics, sizing opportunities, debugging funnel drops and making a quantitative case for your roadmap.

About Us

Perched firmly at the nucleus of spellbinding content and innovative technology, JioStar is a leading global media & entertainment company that is reimagining the way audiences consume entertainment and sports. Its television network and streaming service together reach more than 750 million viewers every week, igniting the dreams and aspirations of hundreds of million people across geographies. JioStar India Private Limited (formerly known as Star India Private Limited) is an equal opportunity employer. The company values diversity and its mission is to create a workplace where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work. The company ensures that the work environment is free from any discrimination against persons with disabilities, gender, gender identity and any other characteristics or status that is legally protected.

Role: Associate Product Manager – Payments (GCC & Global)

Location: Gurugram

About The Function

MakeMyTrip is one of India's leading online travel platforms, and its Global business ( GoMMT ) serves travelers across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, the wider GCC and other international markets. The GCC Product team owns the customer journey from first search to final payment and beyond, working on funnel conversion, monetization , ancillary uptake, payments and NPS.

About The Role

Payment is the moment a customer decides to complete a booking or walk away. As an Associate Product Manager – Payments, you will own journeys at this step for GCC customers who pay in AED, SAR and USD using local cards, wallets, Apple Pay, bank-linked payments and loyalty points.

You will work with a senior product owner, engineering, finance, design, analytics and external payment partners to raise payment success, widen payment-method coverage and manage the cost of every transaction.

What will you be doing

Payment success: analyze drop-offs and failures by payment method, issuing bank, gateway, currency and device; run experiments to lift success rate and checkout conversion. 
Local and alternate payment methods: drive integration and launch of methods preferred in the UAE, KSA and wider GCC, and improve how customers discover them at the payment step. 
Gateway and processor partnerships: work with payment partners on integrations, smart routing, retries and performance reviews. 
Payment cost and P& L: help reduce processing cost per transaction through routing, pricing and mix decisions, without hurting success rate. 
Checkout experience: design, test and improve a fast, clear and trusted payment experience across web , Android and iOS. 
Authentication and compliance: partner with risk, finance and engineering on 3D Secure, tokenization , fraud controls and local regulatory requirements. 
Loyalty and offers at payment: improve how customers redeem points, bank offers and promotions at checkout. 
Metrics and reporting: own dashboards for payment success, conversion, cost and method mix, and turn the data into clear recommendations. 
Delivery: write product requirements, manage releases with engineering, design and QA, and measure impact after launch. 

Qualification & Experience

MBA from a reputable institute; an engineering background is preferred. 
1–3 years of experience in product management, or in payments, fintech, e-commerce, travel or consumer internet. 
Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to break ambiguous problems into clear actions. 
Working knowledge of SQL and dashboards; comfort reading funnel and conversion data. 
Clear written and verbal communication with engineering, business and external partners 
Understanding of payment flows: cards, wallets, bank transfers, 3D Secure, tokenization , authorization and settlement. 
Exposure to the GCC or other multi-currency markets. 
Experience running A/B tests or conversion experiments. 
Familiarity with Adobe Analytics or similar tools. 

Key Success Factors for the Role

Customer centricity: deep interest in why customers succeed or fail at payment. 
Ownership and execution: turns ideas into shipped products with cross-functional teams. 
Analytical rigor : decisions backed by data and clear success metrics. 
Innovation and agility: keen to experiment, learn fast and adapt to new markets. 
Communication and influence: can explain a recommendation simply and bring teams along.

Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Lead Product Manager- Technical

Overview

Are you a product management professional who wants to shape the cloud platform for Mastercard’s products? Do you want to work for a company that offers above and beyond benefits including paid parental leave, flexible work hours, gift matching, and even volunteer incentives? Do you want to work in an inclusive and nurturing culture that encourages your own professional learning and development?

ROLE

We are looking for seasoned Product Management professionals to join our team and help us build towards the future. Product Management-Technical (PM-T) are technical roles and work closely with Technical Program Managers, Software Design Engineers, User Experience, Operations and internal customers to define the details behind the business requirements, the specifications, the user experience, and the API strategy for platform building blocks they own. Our PM-Ts use the Working Backwards process, which is all about is fleshing out the concept and achieving clarity of thought about what will ultimately be built. PM-Ts decompose the requirements into user stories, prioritizing the backlog, and defining the acceptance criteria. PM-Ts are in it for the long term, looking beyond the current project to become experts in their domain. They feed engineering a well groomed and backlog of user stories. Multi Enterprise Interoperability and B2B Integration | Pune India | TraceLink

Role purpose

TraceLink is seeking a Senior Product Manager to define and scale reusable canonical transaction models for multi-enterprise value chains. The role converts complex business workflows and heterogeneous partner messages into standards-aligned, implementation-ready product specifications that can be reused across industries, customers, partners, applications, and integration technologies.

This person will operate at the intersection of product management, multi-enterprise business processes, B2B standards, enterprise applications, and data modeling. Success requires more than gathering requirements: the role must determine the business meaning of a transaction, reconcile industry standards and customer variants, define a durable canonical model, and guide that model through subtype design, transforms, user experience, testing, release, adoption, and lifecycle governance. The resulting models must work across Life Sciences, Pharmaceuticals, Logistics, Medical devices, Healthcare, Food and Beverage, Industrial Manufacturing, Automotive, Consumer Goods, Retail, and other partner-intensive industries.

What You Will Own

A portfolio of canonical transactions across order management, procurement, planning, manufacturing, inventory, warehousing, logistics, transportation, customs, finance, master data, and operational messaging. 
Research the end-to-end business process, including how a transaction is generated and triggered, sender and receiver roles, expected response, exception paths, regulatory implications, and system-of-record behavior for each transaction. 
Normalize equivalent business concepts across such global data standards as JSon and XML, ANSI X12, SAP IDoc, UN/EDIFACT and EANCOM, GS1, ODETTE and VDA, UBL and Peppol, and a variety of ERP system APIs while preserving source-specific semantics, version differences, qualifiers, and implementation constraints. 
Define canonical object structures, reusable components, identifiers, references, parties, locations, dates, quantities, amounts, statuses, code lists, conditions, loops, cardinality, and validation rules.,
Design canonical schema data structures for reuse across partner roles such as buyers, suppliers, manufacturers, contract manufacturers, distributors, warehouses, 3PLs and 4PLs, carriers, automotive OEMs and tier suppliers, retailers, marketplaces, dealers, service providers, customs participants, and regulatory stakeholders. 
Produce canonical designs and documentation, field-level mapping specifications, business rules, sample JSON and XML payloads, subtype requirements, picklists or enumerations, and transformation acceptance criteria. 
Create detailed specifications for transformations between global data standards and TraceLink canonical structures for both inbound and outbound interfaces across a complete range of transactions and business processes, including formats for standard LinkActions that drive connectivity to major ERP systems, reference-data conversion, test data, system reconciliation, and error handling. 
Perform gap analysis against customer and industry implementation guidelines, sample messages, ERP, WMS, TMS, OMS, MES, and commerce-platform structures, and existing TraceLink canonicals; distinguish true canonical gaps from mapping, configuration, reference-data, or source-data issues. 
Partner with Architecture and Engineering on schema design tradeoffs, extensibility, backward compatibility, versioning, performance, UI depth constraints, and migration strategy. 
Create, groom, and prioritize system documentation in Epics and Stories. Define acceptance criteria; review implementations; support QA automation and regression testing with representative customer files, and release readiness. 
Govern the transaction lifecycle by assessing enhancement requests, preventing customer-specific overfitting, maintaining compatibility, standardizing code lists, and measuring reuse, adoption, defects, and delivery speed. 
Serve as the product expert for customers and internal teams, supporting discovery, design reviews, implementation decisions, demos, enablement, and roadmap prioritization. 

Required Qualifications

7+ years of product management, business analysis, solution architecture, integration consulting, or standards implementation experience in multi-enterprise supply chains, B2B integration, ERP, WMS, TMS, OMS, MES, commerce, or manufacturing platforms. 
Demonstrated ability to model complex business transactions and translate process semantics into structured schemas, mappings, validation rules, and testable requirements. 
Working knowledge of at least two enterprise B2B formats or integration ecosystems, such as JSon and XML, ANSI X12, SAP IDoc, UN/EDIFACT, EANCOM, GS1, cXML, OAGIS, ODETTE and VDA, UBL and Peppol, APIs, or ERP-native business objects. 
Strong understanding of multi-enterprise flows across master data, forecasts, orders, schedules, manufacturing, inventory, warehousing, fulfillment, shipping, receiving, transportation, invoicing, settlement, traceability, and exception handling. 
Ability to read implementation guidelines and sample payloads at segment, element, qualifier, loop, and cardinality level and explain their business meaning to technical and nontechnical audiences. 
Experience working with Architecture, Engineering, UX, QA, Services, and customer-facing teams through discovery, specification, delivery, validation, and release. 
Strong analytical judgment: can separate a reusable product requirement from customer-specific configuration and make explicit tradeoffs around scope, compatibility, and time to market. 
Clear written and verbal communication, including concise product requirements, design reviews, customer workshops, executive updates, and enablement content. 

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in one or more partner-intensive industries such as Life Sciences, Pharmaceuticals, Logistics, Medical devices, Healthcare, Food and Beverage, Industrial Manufacturing, Automotive, Consumer Goods, Retail, and other partner-intensive or regulated industries. 
Exposure to such cross-industry concerns as traceability, product and location identification, quality, customs, sustainability, cold chain, recalls, or regulatory compliance is valuable.

Mstack wants its B2B chemicals commerce to run itself. AI agents and automated workflows will handle the routine work, and people will spend their time on decisions that need judgment. We’re hiring a hands-on product leader to own this charter and make it happen.
The level runs from Product Manager to Group Product Manager, depending on your experience.

About the role
You’ll own how Mstack’s chemicals commerce runs from start to finish: a buyer’s first enquiry, then sourcing, shipping, delivery and payment. You’ll work closely with sales, procurement, supply chain, finance, technology, data and operations.
This is a hands-on role. You’ll set priorities with business teams and run the annual plan with technology. You’ll design and build autonomous workflows yourself, then take them to market with the business.

What you’ll own
The charter has four areas, and each one has its own metrics:
Core commerce workflows: lead management, quoting, procurement and supplier sourcing, logistics, fulfilment, invoicing and collections. You’ll track lead-to-order conversion, quote turnaround, order cycle time, on-time-in-full (OTIF) delivery and days sales outstanding (DSO).
Commerce platforms: CRM, ERP, buyer and supplier portals, integrations, and communication with buyers and suppliers. You’ll track adoption, data accuracy, integration uptime and response times.
Intelligence for commerce: business intelligence, demand and price signals, supplier performance and margin visibility. You’ll track forecast accuracy, gross margin per order, time from data to decision, and the share of reports people pull themselves.
Autonomous agentic commerce: AI agents and automations that run workflow steps end to end, with human approval points. You’ll track the share of steps automated, manual touches per order, agent accuracy, exception rate and cost to serve per order.

What you’ll do
Strategy and outcomes
Set product scope and priorities with business leaders, tied to revenue, margin and cost-to-serve goals.
Own the annual operating plan (AOP) for commerce products with the technology team. Run its governance: quarterly roadmap reviews, capacity planning, delivery tracking and trade-off calls.
Set the charter’s metrics, track them and report progress to leadership.
Building autonomous commerce
Work with sales, procurement, supply chain and finance to map how work runs today and where it breaks.
Rethink business intelligence and process workflows for an AI-first operation, rather than digitising the current process as it is.
Build autonomous workflows yourself: design agents, write prompts and evals, set human approval points, and prototype with AI and automation tools.
Run go-to-market with business teams, covering rollout plans, training, adoption tracking and feedback after launch.
Leadership and orchestration
Lead and coach PMs or analysts, depending on the level of the hire.
Bring engineering, data, design, operations and business teams together behind one shared plan.
Make prioritisation and trade-off decisions across teams, and resolve conflicts quickly.
Give leadership clear, numbers-first updates on progress, risks and results.

What we’re looking for
3 to 10 years in product management on B2B commerce, supply chain, procurement or enterprise workflow products.
Experience working directly with sales, procurement or finance teams to define and ship workflows.
At least one AI or automation product shipped to production with a measurable result, such as hours saved or cycle time cut.
Strong SQL. You’re comfortable with LLM APIs, prompting and evals, and you’ve personally used workflow tools such as n8n, Zapier or Make.
Experience running a roadmap or annual plan with an engineering team, including prioritisation and governance.
Clear writing and a habit of making decisions with data.

Nice to have
Experience in chemicals, industrial goods or cross-border trade.
Multi-step AI agents built and running in production.
Exposure to ERP, CRM or procurement systems such as Dynamics, Bitrix24 or HubSpot.
A background in engineering, data science or consulting.
Experience taking a B2B product from 0 to 1.

What success looks like in your first 180 days
By day 30: Map the core workflows from lead to cash with business teams, set baselines for the charter’s metrics, and ship one automation that removes manual work.
By day 90: Agree priorities and the AOP with business and technology, and launch the first autonomous workflow in one area, such as quoting or procurement.
By day 180: Have autonomous workflows live in two or more areas, with measurable cuts in manual touches or order cycle time. The governance cadence is running and business teams are using the new workflows.

If you want to build agentic commerce yourself and not just write specs for it, we’d like to hear from you. Apply here or message us directly.

The Data Platform Product Owner is responsible for helping define, prioritize, and drive the evolution of the enterprise data platform as a product. The role will help ensure that the platform is designed to address business needs and is tailored to the organization structure and scale, while simultaneously being an advocate for data-driven decision-making and the enablement of the platform across the organization.

Acting as the bridge between business domains, data platform teams, and engineering, the Product Owner translates business needs into clear platform requirements, defines priorities, and ensures delivery of capabilities that maximize business value. The role is accountable for maintaining a clear product vision, roadmap, and backlog for the platform, balancing strategic initiatives (e.g., data products, governance, marketplace, migration) with operational stability and efficiency.

The Product Owner works closely with platform engineering, data architects, other Product Owners and DevOps teams to ensure that platform capabilities are delivered in a standardized, reusable, and scalable manner. They also collaborate with business stakeholders and product teams to define how the platform is consumed, ensuring clarity in delivery models, ownership, and support structures.

A key responsibility of the role is to establish and enforce ways of working for the platform, including intake processes, prioritization frameworks, and governance standards. This includes ensuring that data product ownership, privacy-by-design, and compliance requirements are consistently embedded across all platform use cases.

As a key figure in a global, organizational-scale software initiative, the Data Platform Product Owner must be a promoter of the Agile mindset and a champion of continuous delivery and feedback, cooperating with the DevOps teams to implement practices that generate incremental and steady feature delivery at scale that adapts quickly to feedback and business changes.
The role contributes to the continuous improvement of the platform by identifying gaps, driving enhancements, and aligning platform evolution with broader strategic initiatives such as data mesh adoption, data governance, and cloud transformation.

Working closely with delivery leads, architects, and business product owners, the Data Platform Product Owner ensures a clear and transparent roadmap, enabling high-quality, secure, and scalable solutions that support both current operations and future growth.

Main Responsibilities

Vision & Product Strategy
Define and maintain a clear product vision for the platform, balancing innovation, scalability, and operational stability.
Own and manage the Data Platform product roadmap and backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic initiatives.
Monitor platform adoption and usage, identifying gaps and driving continuous improvements.

Stakeholder & Business Engagement
Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders, data product teams, and platform engineering.
Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements and priorities.
Foster an understanding of product goals and vision. Ensure alignment on expectations, ownership, and delivery outcomes across stakeholders.

Product Delivery & Advocacy
Lead and coordinate platform-related initiatives end-to-end (e.g., data products, governance, marketplace, migration), ensuring delivery against agreed scope, timelines, and expected business outcome.
Drive project management activities, including planning, tracking, risk management, and escalation handling.
Champion the promotion of the platform across the business functions and advocate for its usage in upcoming analytics or data-driven initiatives across domains.

Operating Model & Governance
Define, implement, and continuously improve the platform operating model (delivery models, ownership, support).
Establish and govern intake, prioritization, and demand management processes.
Ensure transparency on capacity, trade-offs, and prioritization decisions.

Platform Standards & Compliance
Ensure adoption of platform standards, including data product frameworks, privacy-by-design, and governance requirements.
Work with relevant teams to embed compliance and data ownership practices across all use cases.

Collaboration with Engineering & Architecture
Collaborate with architects and engineering teams to ensure scalable, reusable, and maintainable platform capabilities.
Align platform evolution with enterprise architecture and long-term technology strategy
Contribute to identifying and prioritizing technical improvements and platform enhancements.

Communication & Reporting
Provide clear and consistent communication to stakeholders and leadership.
Share roadmap updates, delivery progress, risks, and key decisions.
Ensure transparency and alignment across all platform-related initiatives.

Other responsibilities / duties as assigned.

Own the Intelligence roadmap, OKRs and delivery, with two or three big bets each quarter. You make the prioritisation calls, own the business outcome behind the backlog, and write the release notes when things ship.
Set the evaluation bar for AI across Osome: eval datasets, confidence thresholds, human-review sampling and go/no-go gates.
With our Security team, set the safety and data-handling bar for AI across Osome: escalation rules, pre-action checks on agents, fail-open vs fail-closed behaviour, privacy and retention, client data isolation, and provider governance (e.g. zero data retention agreements).
Define the success metrics for each AI product before it ships, then keep checking the data yourself after launch to see whether it's working. Brief the analyst on what to build, and review the result. Use that evidence to make model and provider calls, e.g. benchmark a new model against our own labelled documents before switching.
Break epics into clear stories and tasks that engineers can pick up without a meeting. Pair with product teams' engineers to build AI features, and define what "successfully handed over" means.
Be the team's liaison with Operations: run training and feedback rounds, collect baseline data, and drive adoption until the AI version beats the manual process.
Run a small research track: test new techniques and approaches (e.g. retrieval, memory or agent patterns) on our own problems, and write up what we should adopt and what we should skip.
Represent this team's priorities to senior stakeholders.
As the team grows, mentor other PMs and help manage them.

Who You Are
Evaluated against our PM capability framework. At the Senior PM level, that means:
Strategic impact: you can define and drive a strategy spanning 12 months or more for a platform-style team whose customers are other teams, tied to a company-level goal such as gross margin.
Domain ownership: you own the OKRs, roadmap and business outcome of a complex, ambiguous, cross-functional area. You understand applied LLM/ML products deeply (evaluation, retrieval, memory, agent safety), and can become credible in our accounting and operations domain within two quarters.
Collaboration: you drive high adoption of new tools with operations teams, including the processes needed to run them. You build consensus among senior leaders with conflicting goals, and you can say no while leaving the stakeholder feeling heard.
Problem-solving: you map ambiguous, system-level problems, and know when a rule, a classifier or an LLM is the right tool.
Execution: you reliably ship complex, cross-functional launches involving Operations and other product teams. You prototype to de-risk before committing engineering time, and you spot risks early.
AI-literacy: hands-on well beyond prompting. You build prototypes and ship small PRs with AI coding tools, build eval datasets and run model experiments, read traces, and judge where models fail.
Leadership: you shape direction across teams you don't manage, improve how the team works, and are ready to mentor at least one other PM as a player-coach.

What you bring
AI/ML features shipped to production, with quality measured after launch (accuracy, coverage, deflection).
Experience building evaluation datasets and running model experiments: thresholds, go/no-go gates, human-in-the-loop decisions, and reading traces in an observability tool (we use Langfuse) to see where models fail.
Experience shipping AI features that handle sensitive or financial data, and deciding when they should escalate to a human or stop.
Daily use of AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) to read code and ship small changes.
Strong SQL. You can pick the right metrics for a product and explain what you need to an analyst. Data modelling is not required.
Experience working directly with operations teams: running training, collecting feedback, and proving time saved against a manual baseline.
A track record of good calls under ambiguity, and of checking afterwards whether they were right.
(Nice to have) Setting company-wide safety and data-handling rules for AI: fail-open vs fail-closed policies, privacy and retention, and client data isolation, including knowing when a new AI vendor needs a security review before it sees any data.
(Nice to have) Bookkeeping or accounting literacy: enough double-entry, chart-of-accounts and GST/VAT knowledge to judge whether an AI accounts review or document check is right. Either a qualification or hands-on bookkeeping experience counts.
(Nice to have) Document AI/OCR in production: classifying or extracting invoices, bank statements and receipts, and the trade-offs between coverage, accuracy, confidence thresholds and cost.
(Nice to have) Agentic systems or MCP in production: agents or tools that take real actions, with permissions, human approval steps and multi-step evaluation.

Charles River Development | Platform UI Framework

Who We’re Looking For

We are seeking an Associate Technical Product Manager to lead roadmap execution for foundational user interface capabilities within the Charles River and Alpha Platforms.
This role is ideal for a technically minded product professional with 9+ years of experience across product management, business analysis, quality assurance, software development, UX, or related technology disciplines who is curious, hands-on, and comfortable using modern tools to solve problems independently. We are looking for someone fluent in generative AI tools, modern web technologies, APIs, data, and user experience, and who naturally looks for faster and better ways to get work done.
You do not need to be a software engineer, but you should be comfortable working with technology directly. For example, rather than defaulting to a PowerPoint presentation, you might use AI-assisted tools to quickly create a more compelling interactive presentation. Rather than requesting a new report, you might use an available API and tools such as VS Code and GitHub Copilot to prototype a simple web application that answers the question. 
Rather than manually analyzing a large set of product feedback, you might use an LLM to help identify themes and then validate the results yourself.
We are looking for someone who combines this builder mindset with strong product judgment, an understanding of user experience, and the ability to lead product discovery and execution in a complex enterprise environment.


Why This Role Is Important to Us

You will join the Platform UI Framework team within the Charles River Investment Management Solution (CRIMS), a market-leading SaaS platform that powers front-to-back investment workflows for some of the world’s largest financial institutions.
As we scale our platform, your talent will be critical in evolving our foundational UI capabilities, improving developer and user experiences, and enabling rapid innovation across the organization.
Your ability to combine product leadership with practical technical fluency will help the team investigate product questions, communicate ideas, and validate solutions more quickly.

Qualifications

About Tekion 

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform. Our platform spans the Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, the Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises, and the Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform, using cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to bring together vehicle manufacturers, dealerships, and consumers. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia, and Europe.

About The Role

Tekion connects dealerships - the businesses that sell and service vehicles - with the automakers that build those vehicles, such as General Motors, Honda, or Ford. Across the industry these automakers are referred to as OEMs (Original Equipment Manufacturers). The software on each side needs to exchange information automatically and reliably: vehicle orders, inventory, repair records, customer details, and much more. The software that makes this exchange happen is called integration. We are seeking a driven, technically curious Product Manager I to join our Integrations team. You will take ownership of one integration pattern - a family of similar integrations that share the same shape (for example, all the integrations that send vehicle service and repair data to automakers). Your mission is to make every integration in that family measurably healthy and best-in-class, shift more of its delivery from manual building to AI-assisted building, and make sure dealerships actually adopt and benefit from it. This is a hands-on role for an early-career product manager who is comfortable with technical concepts, motivated by measurable outcomes, and excited to help modernize how a decades-old industry connects its software. You will work closely with Engineering, Design, and senior product managers, who will guide and mentor you as you grow into full ownership of your integration pattern.

What You’ll Do

Keep your integrations healthy and best-in-class: Define what “good” looks like for your integration pattern, measure it in our Integration Platform (Tekion’s internal health-monitoring system), and drive coverage, reliability, and quality up across all your integrations - benchmarking each against the best competing product in the market.
Win on AI-powered delivery: Shift your pattern from hand-built integrations toward ones generated with Tekion’s AI-assisted build tools (internally, APC Studio), help sharpen the AI tools you depend on, and own a complete, living set of requirements that any engineering team can build from.
Drive revenue through OEM certifications: Lead integration patterns toward successful OEM certification so OEM-approved integrations can be adopted by dealers at scale. Drive adoption and reduce support load: Make your integrations easy to install and switch on, raise dealership uptake where it is low, and reduce support tickets by tracking and fixing root causes.
Partner across teams: Translate the needs of dealers, automakers, and partners into clear requirements, and work day-to-day with Engineering, Design, Support, and Go-to-Market teams to deliver, launch, and measure impact.

What We’re Looking For

Around 3+ years of product management experience, or equivalent experience in a technical product, integration, API, or platform role. Strong early-career candidates with a technical background are encouraged to apply.
Exposure to integrations, APIs, or platform and marketplace products, with the ability to read technical documentation and discuss APIs, webhooks, and data flows with engineers. (An API is a defined way for two systems to exchange data; a webhook is an automatic notification one system sends another when something happens. You do not need to write code.)
A strong bias toward measurable outcomes, with comfort using dashboards, metrics, and data to set targets and track progress.
Clear writing skills - the ability to turn messy, ambiguous requirements into crisp specifications and user stories.
Curiosity about AI and how it can automate technical work, plus the drive to improve the tools you use.
Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work with both technical and non-technical audiences.
The ability to manage ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and make thoughtful trade-offs in a fast-paced environment.
A bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Have

Interest in or exposure to AI agents, large language models (LLMs), and automated workflows.
Familiarity with the automotive retail world - dealerships, the Dealer Management System (DMS, the core software a dealership runs its business on), or automaker (OEM) certification programs.

Why Join Us 

Modernize an industry: Help modernize how an entire industry connects its software, moving from slow, hand-built integrations to a fast, AI-powered delivery model.
Work at the frontier of AI delivery: Be hands-on with how AI is used to scope, build, and test real enterprise integrations.
See measurable impact: Own clear, measurable goals and watch your work show up directly in integration health, adoption, and support metrics.
Grow with mentorship: Learn from senior product managers and engineers, with a clear path to grow into broader ownership.

Define product vision, strategy, and roadmaps for AI-native products, and make clear calls on what to build, buy, or leave to a foundation model.

The Agile Product Owner Advisor is a strategic and collaborative leader within an agile development team, responsible for managing the product backlog and ensuring that development efforts align with customer needs and business goals. Translates sometimes ambiguous business questions and existing reporting requirements into standardized entities, measures, dimensions, relationships, KPIs, and semantic definitions that can be reused across products and customers.

Balances standard product requirements against ERP-specific and customer-specific requirements and identifies where extensions to the governed model are required.

Works through dependencies across Product, Engineering, Architecture, domain SMEs, Professional Services, customers, and other stakeholders to move semantic-model and Analytics Package work from discovery through validation.

This reflects the actual scope in the resourcing case: reusable semantic models are intended to span Finance, Sales, Procurement, Manufacturing, Inventory, Quality and other domains, with iteration occurring across ERPs and eventually non-Aptean systems.

Supervision

Works with a high degree of independence within defined product priorities and objectives.

Receives strategic direction from the Director, Product Management - Analytics & Data Products and independently drives assigned semantic-model domains and Analytics Package workstreams.

Coordinates work across technical and business stakeholders but does not initially have direct people-management responsibility.

Escalates significant product, data, architecture, and prioritization decisions where broader alignment is required.

Principal Duties And Responsibilities

Define business semantics and domain models. 
Lead discovery with product SMEs, customers, and internal stakeholders to understand business processes, entities, relationships, terminology, business questions, metrics, and KPIs. Translate these inputs into detailed, reusable semantic-model requirements and domain definitions. 
Analyze source data and define source-to-semantic mappings. 
Work with Product and Data Engineering teams to understand existing products and ERP schemas, including relevant tables, fields, keys, relationships, and business logic. Define and document how source data maps to standardized business entities, dimensions, measures, and relationships within the semantic model, and identify gaps requiring transformation or extension. 
Define Analytics Packages 
Translate business questions, KPIs, reporting requirements, and semantic-model capabilities into reusable Analytics Packages across functional domains such as Finance, Sales, Procurement, Manufacturing, Inventory, and Quality. Define package requirements, measures, dimensions, reporting experiences, acceptance criteria, and dependencies. 
Driving semantic-model requirements through Engineering 
Partner closely with Data Engineering and Architecture to convert product requirements into implementable semantic-model capabilities. Clarify requirements, resolve data and business-rule questions, review model implementations against intended business semantics, identify gaps, and support prioritization through delivery. 
Validate models and packages with customers and SMEs 
Plan and conduct validation sessions with domain SMEs, customers, and implementation teams to confirm that semantic definitions, KPIs, business rules, and Analytics Packages accurately represent real-world processes and reporting needs. Convert validation findings into prioritized product requirements and model improvements. 
Standardize capabilities across products and customers 
Compare requirements and source structures across ERP products and customer environments to distinguish reusable business concepts from product- or customer-specific requirements. Help establish canonical definitions while identifying where governed extensions are necessary. 
Maintain product artifacts and semantic-model documentation 
Create and maintain clear product artifacts including business definitions, entity and relationship definitions, KPI specifications, source mappings, requirements, acceptance criteria, decision logs, Analytics Package specifications, and supporting documentation required by Engineering and downstream product teams. 
Support analytics and AI product evolution 
Use customer feedback, product usage, implementation learning, and emerging requirements to identify opportunities to improve semantic models and Analytics Packages. Support the evolution of the semantic layer as a governed business context for analytics, natural-language analytics, Analytics Agents, and broader AI and Decision Intelligence capabilities. 

Education

Bachelor's degree, Preferred fields: Computer Science, Information Systems, Data/Analytics, Engineering, Business Analytics, or a related quantitative/technical discipline. 
Master's degree: A Master's degree in a relevant technical, analytics, or business discipline is preferred but not required. 

Shift: UK Shift

Recommended: 12+ years of relevant professional experience in product management, product analysis, business analysis, data/analytics, enterprise software, or a related discipline.

Experience should include meaningful hands-on work translating business requirements into data, analytics, reporting, or semantic-model requirements.

Experience working with enterprise applications, ERP data, analytics products, data platforms, or complex relational data environments is strongly preferred.

Experience collaborating directly with software/data engineering teams and business/domain stakeholders through discovery, requirements definition, implementation, and validation is strongly preferred.

Knowledge

Strong understanding of relational data concepts, including tables, keys, joins, relationships, normalization, and dimensional/analytical modeling. 
Understanding of semantic modeling, including business entities, dimensions, measures

The Product Owner (PO) within Kroll’s Chief Data Office (CDO) is accountable for the end‑to‑end ownership, delivery, and adoption of enterprise data products. This role serves as the single point of accountability for product vision, stakeholder alignment, roadmap execution, and experience quality across assigned data domains.

The Product Owner partners closely with Business stakeholders, Data Engineering, BI/Reporting, Data Science, Governance, and Platform teams to ensure data products are reliable, intuitive, scalable, and aligned with Kroll’s strategic priorities. The role emphasizes clarity of ownership, predictable delivery, and measurable business impact in a complex, enterprise data environment.

Key Responsibilities

Product Ownership & Accountability

Define and own the product vision, roadmap, and backlog for enterprise data, analytics, or AI product areas.
Serve as the single point of accountability for product outcomes, delivery health, and user experience.
Define and communicate product goals, success metrics, and value drivers to stakeholders and delivery teams.
Ensure products operate with clear ownership, release discipline, and lifecycle management, behaving like true products—not one‑off projects.

Stakeholder Engagement & Business Alignment

Act as the primary interface between the CDO and business, finance, and functional leaders for assigned domains.
Partner with stakeholders to prioritize demand, manage tradeoffs, and align delivery to business timelines.
Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements without compromising data integrity or architectural standards.
Establish and maintain trusted relationships that enable fast decision‑making and alignment.

Backlog, Roadmap & Delivery Management

Own and maintain a prioritized, well‑defined backlog with clear acceptance criteria and readiness standards.
Work with Program Managers, Scrum Masters, and delivery teams to plan releases and manage dependencies.
Balance short‑term delivery needs with long‑term product health, scalability, and maintainability.
Surface risks, constraints, or scope trade‑offs early to enable leadership decisions.

Governance, Quality & Standards

Partner with Data Governance, Data Stewards, and Platform Owners to ensure:
Consistent KPI definitions and metric logic
Data quality, lineage, and trust standards
Alignment with enterprise data architecture and security policies
Ensure products meet operational readiness standards prior to release and are supported post‑launch.
Adoption, Value & Continuous Improvement

Drive product adoption by ensuring solutions is intuitive, reliable, and aligned to real user workflows.
Define and track usage, adoption, and value realization metrics.
Collect feedback and iterate to continuously improve product experience and impact.
Support leadership by providing a clear narrative on what is delivered, what value it creates, and what comes next.

Required

Qualifications & Experience

5+ years of experience in Product Ownership, Business Analysis, Analytics, or Data‑centric roles.
Proven ability to own roadmaps, backlogs, and stakeholder relationships in a complex enterprise environment.
Strong understanding of data, reporting, analytics, or BI platforms (e.g., Power BI, Databricks, data warehouses).
Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery models with engineering and analytics teams.

Preferred

The Product Owner is a critical enabler of CDO’s product‑led operating model, ensuring that data and analytics investments deliver consistent, trusted, and measurable value to the firm—while reducing dependency on informal workarounds, fragmented ownership, and vendor‑driven execution.

Role Title: Lead Consultant - S/4HANA – IT Product Manager - Tax

Location: Chennai

We are one purpose-led global organisation. The enablers and innovators, ensuring that we can fulfil our mission to push the boundaries of science and discover and develop life-changing medicines. We take pride in working close to the cause, opening the locks to save lives, ultimately making a massive difference to the outside world.

AstraZeneca (AZ) is in a period of strong growth and our employees have a united purpose to make a difference to patients around the world who need both our medicines and the ongoing developments from our science. In this journey AZ must continue to work across borders and with partners and new colleagues in a fast and seamless way. The ambition, size and complexity of the organisation, coupled with the opportunities afforded by new technology, has led the Board to approve a large-scale transformation programme – Axial.

The Axial Programme will be powered by S/4HANA a new ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) system which will be implemented right across the organisation and will provide our business with standardised processes, enhanced financial management, common data and real time reporting, transforming the way we work through our entire supply chain - from bench to patient.

The new system will be used by more than 20,000 employees daily, is foundational to all AZ entities and is central to most core business processes. This is a once in a generation programme for AstraZeneca and will shape our ways of working globally for many years to come.

The Axial programme needs the best talent to work in it. Whether it’s the technical skills, business understanding or change leadership, we want to ensure we have the strongest team deployed throughout. We are aiming to deliver a world class change programme that leaves all employees with a fuller understanding of their role in the end-to-end nature of our global company. This programme will provide AZ with a competitive edge, to the benefit of our employees, customers and patients.

The S/4HANA Product Manager – Tax assists in the technical solution design for the Tax capability or as part of a multifunctional component. It is a key position within the Axial Programme IT Design Team, with a central role in defining AstraZeneca’s global template in line with our Fit-to-Standard ambition, using SAP standards. You will be part of the wider Axial IT Design Team responsible for shaping the technology that supports our global standardised business processes.

The Product Manager will primarily align to a capability associated with the Record to Report (R2R) Enterprise Process Owner (EPO) domains or, in some cases, a cross-domain capability. During the global process design phase, you will develop the Tax solution and act as the central point for defining the integrated approach for your area, connecting business process requirements, SAP functionality and SAP data objects.

You will be responsible for ensuring the global standard is accurately documented and tested in accordance with project requirements, while guiding the core design through the appropriate governance forums. You will collaborate with IT Enterprise Business Partners and other Product Managers to effectively integrate the Tax capability into the wider AstraZeneca template. This will also involve partnering with SMEs from external organisations to ensure the AZ solution adopts standard, cutting-edge technology to deliver required business capabilities and outcomes.

As the project moves into deployment, you will continue to play a pivotal role in ensuring that localisation requirements for individual operating units are appropriately reflected while maintaining the integrity of the Fit-to-Standard best-practice template. You will support deployment teams through the business change journey, migration and cutover to the standard model for each entity. You will also be a key participant in hypercare, helping resolve capability-related issues in a timely and effective manner.

In this role, you will apply extensive knowledge of SAP best practices to enable core business capabilities through a standard global template utilising SAP DRC, EDICOM and a Tax Engine.

What You’ll Do

Lead the IT solution underpinning the global standard process for the Tax capability / lead area, including integrations.
Be accountable for aligning system design and best practices with business capability requirements within the Tax domain.
Partner with business process teams to maintain alignment with S/4HANA best practices and SAP standard functionality.
Represent the Tax process domain in senior internal and external forums as required, supporting strategic direction and identifying relevant solution and technology opportunities.
Support the data team in the successful definition, migration and creation of data objects required for the AZ global template across the application landscape.
Prioritise activities in line with the overall deployment strategy, project imperatives, Business Technology Group portfolios and BAU services.
Maintain alignment between existing and new AZ IT projects outside the Axial Programme and the overall Tax domain/capability architecture.
Partner with AZ Architecture teams to align solution and data design with the strategic direction for IT applications.
Collaborate with Non-SAP Systems and Integration teams to effectively deliver integration requirements across the internal and external IT landscape.
Proactively consider the latest industry and SAP capabilities within Tax and the wider programme, supporting the IT Enterprise Business Partner in the R2R domain.
Partner with programme teams to document and test the solution in accordance with AZ compliance standards.
Report progress against plan and handle RAID items within your area, calling out to the Enterprise domain as appropriate.
Champion the Tax capability design through relevant governance forums.
Represent IT as an SME and leader in relevant programme and business data forums.

Essential For The Role

Solid understanding of indirect tax business processes and tax touchpoints across the end-to-end supply chain.
Ability to analyse and interpret indirect tax requirements, including VAT and GST, across domestic transactions, free trade zones, exports and imports.
Experience in end-to-end design and configuration of External Global Tax Engine integrations with S/4HANA.
Solid understanding of SAP data elements and data points required to drive appropriate tax treatment through an external tax engine.
Good knowledge of digital compliance regulations, including e-invoicing and e-reporting, ideally using SAP DRC and EDICOM.
In-depth knowledge of the SAP S/4 landscape and Global Tax Engine concepts.
Recognised SME in SAP and associated technologies, with a consistent track record of delivering sophisticated designs for large-scale business transformation programmes.
Demonstrated ability to successfully deliver IT change across multiple global locations and/or Business Functions, including translating technical information into clear business language.
Strong partner management and communication skills across Business and IT, with demonstrated ability to influence key partner groups.
Collaborative teammate who can work effectively across programme teams and communicate confidently in both business and IT terms.

Desirable for the Role

Tax certification with SAP S/4HANA.
Experience working in a hybrid environment with internal and external resources across multiple geographical locations.
Experience delivering S/4HANA implementations for sophisticated global organisations, from design through to deployment.

Job Title: Product Manager - Data & AI

About The Role

As our Product Manager - Data & AI, you'll own the journey from the data we collect to the AI-powered experiences we deliver to customers. You'll work across product and engineering to determine what information we should collect, how it should be used, and how we can turn it into useful, reliable AI features.

This is a hands-on product role. You won't just define requirements and hand them to a technical team, you'll work with engineering to analyze AI performance, define how AI should behave, and establish the measures we use to determine whether our products are actually delivering value.

What You'll Do

Own the Attendee Data Platform (ADP) to AI-feature value chain end-to-end, from determining what signals and data we should collect through to how that data powers customer-facing AI experiences.
Partner closely with engineering to define the data required to build and improve AI-powered features.
Use SQL, notebooks, and other analytical tools to run analysis, explore data, identify patterns, and answer product questions.
Build and maintain datasets used to develop, evaluate, and improve AI features.
Conduct error analysis on AI outputs to understand where models are performing well, where they fail, and what we can do to improve them.
Write clear, precise product specifications that can be reliably interpreted and executed by both engineers and AI coding agents.
Design consent, privacy, and data-use considerations as an intentional part of the product experience, not as something addressed after the fact.
Define meaningful product and AI performance metrics and establish how we will measure success.
Decide where AI genuinely earns its place and where a simpler, deterministic approach serves the customer just as well at a fraction of the running cost — and be able to show the reasoning behind the call.
Work closely with engineering, design, and leadership to turn complex technical capabilities into useful customer experiences.
Continuously evaluate our AI products and data practices to identify opportunities to improve quality, reliability, and customer value.

What We're Looking For

Significant product management experience, ideally working on data-intensive, AI-powered, or technically complex products.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to independently work with data using SQL and notebooks.
Experience building products where data is a core part of the product experience.
A strong understanding of how AI systems are developed, evaluated, and improved, including experience analyzing AI errors and outputs.
A pragmatic view of AI — you can tell the difference between a problem that needs a model and one that needs a rule, and you treat running cost as a product constraint rather than an engineering detail.
Exceptional ability to translate ambiguous problems into clear, precise requirements and specifications.
Experience working closely with engineering and data teams and the ability to comfortably engage in technical discussions.
An understanding of data privacy, consent, and responsible data use, with the ability to incorporate these considerations directly into product decisions.
A metrics-driven approach to product management, with the ability to define meaningful measures of success.
Strong judgment and curiosity, with a willingness to get hands-on and investigate problems yourself rather than relying entirely on others for the analysis.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to bring product, technical, and business perspectives together.

Highly Desirable
Experience within construction, infrastructure, engineering technology, BIM, CDE or Information Management.

Why Join Us?

You’ll help shape digital products used by major construction and infrastructure teams to deliver some of the world’s most complex projects, giving you the chance to work on technology that has a real-world impact beyond the screen.

At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

About Broadridge:

Broadridge Financial Solutions is a global fintech leader providing technology, communications and data-driven solutions that power the financial services industry. We help businesses improve operational efficiency, enhance client experiences and make better decisions through innovative technology and data solutions.

At Broadridge, we believe our people are at the heart of our success. We foster a culture built around collaboration, innovation, accountability and continuous learning, where employees have the opportunity to work on meaningful, business-critical solutions and build long-term careers.

Job Summary

The Finance Data Product Lead – Data & Analytics owns the design and support of data products, interfaces and processes in the Finance data ecosystem, spanning upstream systems (ERP and homegrown), the enterprise data platform, and consuming application integration.

This role is accountable for defining, supporting and governing scalable data products and processes, ensuring data integrity and reliability at enterprise scale, and acting as a trusted speaking partner to IT, Finance, and external service providers.

The role also focuses on monitoring, issue resolution, process standardization, data governance, and stakeholder communication, while guiding Level 1 resources and working closely with Level 2/3 IT support teams to drive long-term stability and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Lead product discovery by gathering requirements from stakeholders, users, and technical teams.
Design, implement, and govern data quality controls, reconciliation frameworks, and exception management mechanisms.
Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for data products aligned with business goals.
Translate business needs into clear product requirements, user stories, and delivery plans.
Prioritize initiatives based on business value, technical feasibility, user needs, and strategic fit.
Identify high-impact opportunities where data products can improve decision-making, operations, or customer experience.
Partner with data engineers, analysts, and business leaders to deliver data products.
Drive implementation of data products in data platforms, dashboards, semantic layers, self-service analytics tools, APIs, and ML-enabled solutions.
Establish KPIs and success metrics to measure adoption, usability, data quality, and business impact.
Champion data quality, governance, documentation, and trust across products.
Ensure data products are intuitive, accessible, and fit for purpose for target users.
Manage stakeholder communication, expectations, timelines and risks.
Continuously improve products through feedback, usage insights, and performance measurement.
Support data ownership, governance frameworks, privacy, and compliance requirements where applicable.

Qualifications & Skills

7–10+ years of experience in data product management, data, analytics, or platform delivery.
Extensive hands-on and architectural experience managing enterprise-scale data platforms handling high-volume, business-critical Finance data.
Strong understanding of data architecture, analytics workflows, and reporting ecosystems.
Ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.
Strong prioritization, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Familiarity with data governance, metrics design, and data quality principles.
Experience delivering internal or external data-driven products.
Advanced proficiency in SQL and Snowflake, including performance tuning, complex validations, reconciliation logic, and troubleshooting.
Strong experience with data warehousing, ETL frameworks, and cloud data platforms.
Preferred understanding of enterprise Finance systems and ERP platforms such as Oracle (EBS / Fusion) and SAP (ECC / S/4HANA).
Proven experience working with workload scheduling and automation tools such as Apache Airflow and Control-M.
Solid understanding of data governance, data quality, controls, and reconciliation frameworks in Finance environments.
Demonstrated experience acting as a stakeholder-facing lead, managing cross-functional dependencies across Finance, IT, and external vendors.
Strong ability to translate Finance business logic into data rules, controls, and permanent technical solutions.
Excellent communication, documentation, and executive-level articulation skills.
Proven track record of driving complex issues to resolution across multiple teams and vendors.

Why Join Broadridge?

Work on meaningful, business-critical solutions: Contribute to Finance data products and platforms that support enterprise-scale financial operations.
Be at the intersection of Finance, Data & Technology: Work across Finance, IT, data engineering, analytics and business teams.
Drive transformation: Play a key role in improving data quality, governance, automation and decision-making.
Collaborative environment: Partner with diverse teams and senior stakeholders across the organization.
Growth & learning: Build expertise across data products, cloud platforms, Finance systems, analytics and emerging technologies.
Global exposure: Work with teams, stakeholders and technology ecosystems supporting Broadridge's global business.
Innovation-driven culture: Be part of an organization that continuously invests in technology, data and better ways of working.

Join Us

If you are a data and technology professional who understands Finance data, enjoys solving complex business problems, and can bridge the gap between Finance, Data and IT, we would love to hear from you.

Join Broadridge and help shape the future of Finance Data Products.

In this role, you will work closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional delivery teams to define product direction, manage priorities, and ensure successful execution. You will bridge business needs and technical delivery by turning complex requirements into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and actionable backlogs. Working within an Agile environment, you will guide sprint activities, oversee deliverables, and coordinate testing and release readiness.
