This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on how teams use technology to support business objectives.

Accountabilities

Product vision and roadmap: Define, communicate, and maintain the Salesforce product vision and roadmap, ensuring that priorities remain aligned with business objectives and stakeholder expectations. 
Backlog ownership: Own, refine, and prioritize the product backlog. Translate business needs into clear features, user stories, and acceptance criteria that provide actionable direction for development teams. 
Stakeholder engagement: Work with business stakeholders to understand their workflows, analyze existing processes, identify opportunities for improvement, and translate requirements into scalable Salesforce solutions aligned with platform best practices. 
Agile delivery: Lead sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and release planning. Make timely decisions on scope and priorities while supporting effective delivery within an Agile environment. 
Quality assurance and release readiness: Review and accept completed work, coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT), and validate that deliverables from vendors and project resources meet requirements and are ready for release. 
Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with architects, developers, administrators, and integration teams on solution design, data flows, and Salesforce platform governance. 
Risk and dependency management: Manage stakeholder expectations, identify delivery risks and dependencies, and support timely resolution of issues that may affect project outcomes. 
Process improvement and documentation: Evaluate existing project management and delivery practices, drive continuous improvement, and develop clear, efficient, repeatable processes and supporting documentation. 

Requirements

At least 8 years of experience working with Salesforce, including a minimum of 5 years in a Product Owner or Business Analyst role. 
Experience delivering at least one end-to-end Salesforce implementation. 
Mandatory hands-on experience with at least one of the following Salesforce solutions: Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or Marketing Cloud. 
Strong working knowledge of SAFe Agile and Scrum methodologies, including practical experience with backlog management tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps. 
Demonstrated ability to interpret and analyze business needs and translate them into technical requirements, features, and well-defined user stories. 
Knowledge of integration design, including data flows and interactions between different systems. 
Proven ability to build and foster a collaborative, team-oriented environment, with strong leadership and management capabilities. 
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work creatively and analytically in complex business and technical environments. 
Strong written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence, negotiate, and manage relationships with stakeholders at all levels. 
A proactive, solution-oriented approach and a genuine interest in working within an information systems environment. 
Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business, or an equivalent field. 
Preferred certifications: Salesforce Administrator, Salesforce Business Analyst, or Salesforce Platform App Builder certification. Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager (POPM) certification is also considered an advantage. 

Benefits

Fully remote working arrangement in India. 
Opportunity to take ownership of Salesforce product direction and contribute to platform strategy and business priorities. 
Exposure to cross-functional collaboration with business stakeholders, architects, developers, administrators, and integration teams. 
Opportunity to influence delivery practices, improve processes, and support the ongoing development of enterprise Salesforce solutions.

India Hybrid: Bengaluru

This is a hybrid role. This model requires the ability to work in a hybrid mode from our office in Bengaluru(2 to 3 times/ week). Our office culture is designed to foster in-person innovation, collaboration, and connection with team members, local and visiting, from other global offices.

The Opportunity

Robotics foundation models need millions of hours of dense, real-world data—and simulation alone won't cut it. TELUS Digital is solving the Physical AI bottleneck, capturing highly calibrated, real-world data at scale across hundreds of devices to power the world's leading hyperscalers.

We are hiring a Group Product Manager for the Physical AI Robotics product team. You will own the tooling this runs on: capture applications, operator workflows, session management, review and QA, and customer delivery. Champion pilots as the default way to test a change. Small cohort, clear hypothesis, fixed window. Scale what works and stop what does not.

The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.

The Role

Aspen Technology, a business unit inside Emerson Corporation, is a leading industrial software company, serving over 3,000 customers with over $1 billion in annual revenue, more than 60 locations worldwide, and nearly 4,000 employees. AspenTech solutions address complex environments where it is critical to optimize the asset design, operation and maintenance lifecycle. Through AspenTech’s unique combination of deep domain expertise and award-winning innovative software suites, customers in asset-intensive industries can improve their operational excellence while achieving sustainability goals.

The AspenTech Performance Engineering Solution provides a market leading integrated suite of products to optimize the performance of process industry assets across the CAPEX and OPEX cycles and is powered by flagship process modeling products such as Aspen HYSYS and Aspen Plus with a proven track record of value creation over several decades.

Your Impact

As a Release Train Product Manager working within the Scaled Agile Framework, you are responsible for turning vision into reality by managing the program backlog, prioritizing features, and collaborating with Solution Product Management to deliver solutions that align with business goals with the shortest lead time.

Execution Strategy: Responsible for the Program Backlog, working with Solution Product Management, the System Architect, and the Release Train Engineer to prioritize the backlog to maximize the delivery of value over time.

Feature Definition: Responsible for turning product vision into concrete deliverable features. Working with the Product Owner team to refine backlog items into items of incremental value delivery.

Team Leadership: Leading and growing a team of Product Owners. You will be responsible for hiring, coaching, and retaining top talent, and for ensuring that the team is continuously improving.

What You'll Need

10+ years of progressive product-centric software development leadership, including a demonstrated record of success delivering value with quality.

Experience in communicating product vision and road maps to development teams. 
Experience leading Agile development teams, working within the SAFe® framework a plus.
Proven ability to analyze reports, dashboards, and other tools to make critical decisions and recommendations to help the company to achieve its goals. Strong analytical skills

MrQ is an award-winning online casino, launched in 2018 and growing fast. We’re big on tech, big on performance and even bigger on fun.

As a commercially minded Product Manager, you own how players find us, sign up and make their first deposit, from ad click to their first week with us. This is a specialist growth role where marketing and product meet. You’ll work alongside Marketing, read the numbers first, and run the experiments that bring in more of the right players.

If you love funnels, tracking and conversion more than backlogs, this one’s for you.

What You Will Do

Run the full funnel, from public site and landing pages to sign-up, FTD and first-week activation.
Shape welcome offers and Refer a Friend, and test them for player quality as well as volume.
Drive web-to-app acquisition, with installs and attribution tracked properly.
Set martech strategy with Marketing: every channel measured, clean data from ad click to FTD, and fully GDPR-compliant.
Run registration experiments on fields, steps, messaging and verification, then make the call on what ships.
When FTDs dip, be first with the answer: product, channel, verification or spend?
Partner with performance, affiliates, SEO/ASO, PPC and paid social, so paid traffic is never put at risk.
Track second deposits and first-week activity, and flag channels or offers that don’t stick.
Build a roadmap on ROI, CPA and player value.
Lead an engineering and design squad focused on outcomes.
Keep login, navigation and My Account fast and reliable.
Make onboarding feel unmistakably MrQ while covering age and ID checks, GAMSTOP, geo-restrictions and marketing consent. You’ll work with Payments & Verification on KYC.

What We’re Looking For

Growth experience in a consumer business such as iGaming, fintech or e-commerce, or a marketing background (PPC, SEO, CRO, mobile UA) that moved into product.
Commercial acumen. You think in CPA, conversion, payback and LTV.
Martech know-how. You understand tracking, tagging and attribution, and where data breaks.
Experience running A/B tests on funnels and reading the results honestly.
Comfort with numbers. You dig into the data yourself.
Trust from performance, affiliate or growth teams, and the confidence to hold your own with a head of marketing.
Comfort with regulated onboarding. We’ll teach you the gambling rules.
Player instinct. You care whether a change is right for the player, not just whether it converts.
Nice to have: KYC, welcome offers or referral schemes, GA4, Amplitude, tag managers or CDPs, and AI prototyping tools.

We’re an equal opportunity employer and want a team as varied as our players. At MrQ, everyone gets a fair shot, whatever their age, disability, gender identity, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation.

Job Summary
The RD Domain Data Product Manager develops recommendations for and activates the approved data product strategy for an assigned biopharma RD domain. Working with the Data Domain Owner and scientific, clinical, data, architecture, governance, engineering and platform stakeholders, the role identifies high-value user and business needs and translates them into a coherent portfolio of reusable data products. It establishes proposed product boundaries, value hypotheses and roadmaps, incorporates quality and governance expectations defined with data stewards and relevant specialists, and recommends investment priorities for approval by the Data Domain Owner. The role owns domain-level product discovery, portfolio prioritization recommendations, product mobilization and cross-product dependency management within approved priorities and investment guardrails. It coordinates validation of scientific relevance and consumer needs with scientific and clinical stakeholders; technical feasibility and interoperability with architecture, modeling, engineering and platform teams; and quality, governance, privacy and analytical and AI-use readiness with data stewards, governance specialists and relevant privacy and technical authorities. Once a product is approved and sufficiently defined, detailed delivery and lifecycle accountability transitions to a designated Data Product Owner. The Domain Data Product Manager retains responsibility for domain-wide portfolio coherence, cross-product dependencies, portfolio-level value tracking, identification of reuse opportunities and alignment with the approved domain strategy.


Responsibilities and Accountabilities
  • Partner with the Data Domain Owner to translate domain outcomes, use cases, investment priorities, and OKRs into a clear domain data product vision, roadmap, and strategic backlog.
  • Establish and continuously refine a prioritized domain backlog covering candidate data products, domain blueprint work, source dependencies, data contracts, governance needs, and enabling platform capabilities.
  • Work with the Domain Data Architect and Domain Data Modelers to develop and maintain the domain blueprint, product decomposition, canonical/semantic modeling priorities, interoperability needs, and reusable architecture patterns.
  • Facilitate use-case decomposition into required data products, MVP boundaries, capabilities, sequencing, business value hypotheses, and measurable success criteria.
  • Coordinate demand intake, opportunity evaluation, value/effort prioritization, dependency mapping, and escalation of cross-domain or platform constraints; make trade-offs transparent to the Domain Owner.
  • Maintain a consolidated view of domain initiatives, product status, backlog readiness, delivery milestones, capacity assumptions, risks, decisions, and strategic dependencies.
  • Engage the Foundation Data Platform team to align on source availability, ingestion needs, technical readiness, shared standards, and planned capability changes without taking ownership of platform engineering.
  • Partner with Data Governance Specialists and stewards to embed ownership, business glossary, metadata, data quality, lineage, contract, certification, privacy, and AI-readiness


Required Qualifications
  • Bachelors or master s degree in information systems, Data Science, Computer Science, Life Sciences, or a related discipline.
  • Seven or more years of relevant experience, including at least three years directly defining or managing data, analytics, platform, scientific-informatics or AI-enabled products
  • Demonstrated experience translating business outcomes and use cases into roadmaps, strategic backlogs, product definitions, and phased delivery plans.
  • Experience facilitating prioritization, managing cross-team dependencies, and coordinating stakeholders across business, architecture, governance, platform, and engineering teams.
  • Understanding of domain-oriented data products, data contracts, canonical models, metadata, governance, and medallion architecture.
  • Working knowledge of scientific and regulated-data principles, including provenance, traceability, FAIR practices, privacy by design and, where applicable, GxP and ALCOA+ expectations.
  • Strong facilitation, communication, executive storytelling, negotiation, and Agile/product delivery skills.


Preferred Qualifications
  • Broader experience across multiple pharmaceutical or biotechnology RD functions and data domains.[MCR7.1]
  • Experience with scientific, clinical, operational, safety or regulatory data products and AI-enabled RD use cases.
  • Experience with federated or data-mesh operating models, domain blueprints, product certification and enterprise governance.
  • Familiarity with Databricks, Unity Catalog, Jira or Azure DevOps, metadata and catalog platforms, product analytics, SQL or business-intelligence tools.
  • Experience defining responsible-AI, model-evaluation, data-suitability or AI-observability requirements in regulated or high-impact settings.
  • Experience incorporating privacy, security, cross-border data-use constraints and purpose-based access requirements into global data-product planning.
  • Experience leading global, geographically distributed teams and organizational change.

  • This role is for early-career problem-solvers with hands-on vulnerability management experience who want to grow into a full product manager. You'll own well-scoped features end to end and learn alongside senior PMs, engineering and Threat Research.

1. Product definition and roadmap

  • Collaborate with engineering to define product requirements and specifications: PRDs, user stories, prioritization logic, workflows, wireframe annotations and acceptance criteria.

  • Translate concepts such as CVSS vs. EPSS vs. QDS, asset criticality, toxic combinations, SLA breaches and MTTR into product features with measurable risk reduction.
  • Test and validate features before release: scans, detections, QQL queries, dashboards, reports and APIs.

3. Customer reporting and insight

  • Partner with SMEs, SSAs/TAMs, support and customers to refine requirements, triage escalations, validate assumptions and iterate fast.

thumpN is where the show begins.

At thumpN, we build products that make discovering and experiencing live entertainment effortless. From the moment a fan opens the app to the second they walk through the venue gates, every interaction is a product decision.

As we grow into new cities and categories, we need someone who can bridge customer insight and business need—translating both into product improvements that ship. This role is for someone who is curious, analytical, and execution-focused. Someone who enjoys making decisions with data, working across teams, and building things users actually love.

Real responsibilities, not a wish list

Product Ownership and Strategy

Own a product area (such as discovery, ticketing and checkout, or organizer tools) and its key metrics.

Product Execution

User Research and Analysis

Run user research with fans, artists, venues, and promoters to find the biggest opportunities. 
Set success metrics for every launch, measure results, and decide what to iterate on or kill. 
Track competitors and market shifts, and bring a point of view on where thumpN should play. 

Leadership and Collaboration

Align Design, Engineering, Marketing, Operations, and leadership around what we are building and why. 
Mentor Associate PMs on problem framing, PRDs, and data-driven decision-making. 
Communicate product direction and progress clearly to the wider team. 

What You Bring

Curiosity, rigour, and the drive to ship

Required

3-6 years of product management experience, with at least one product or major feature you owned end to end.

Strong analytical skills and comfort working directly with data. 
Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing stakeholders, including senior ones.

Experience building two-sided products, or tools for businesses alongside consumer apps.

A genuine love for live entertainment and consumer technology. 

NON-NEGOTIABLES

You are obsessed with solving user problems, not just shipping features. You start with the problem, not the solution.

About the Role: Product Manager - RASP

You will own Bureau RASP (Runtime Application Self-Protection). It is a rare chance to take a category-defining security product from launch to scale.

Sophisticated mobile fraud now executes inside the app itself. Bureau RASP answers with a four-layer Zero Trust framework embedded in the customer's app:
Application integrity: code obfuscation, anti-tampering and anti-debugging, powered by XVM, our proprietary virtualization engine.
Runtime and environment: detection of root, jailbreak, emulators, cloned apps, hooking and overlay attacks.
Network and data channel: protection against MITM, packet sniffing, geo spoofing and VPN or proxy bypass.
Visibility and policy: monitor, warn or block per threat from a dashboard, with immutable audit logs.

It is built at the OS level, goes live in minutes with no code changes, and feeds runtime signals into Bureau's Graph Identity Network. You will decide where it goes next.

What you’ll be doing

Own the RASP vision, strategy and roadmap across Android and iOS.
Track the mobile threat landscape and turn new attack patterns into shipped protections.
Partner with security, SDK and platform engineers to deliver detections that are accurate, hard to bypass and light on app performance.
Shape the customer experience: zero-code onboarding, the policy engine, alerts and audit reporting.
Connect RASP signals with Device Intelligence, Behavioural Biometrics and the Graph Identity Network to create value no standalone RASP can match.
Work with sales, solutions and marketing on positioning, pricing, demos and competitive wins.
Spend time with CISOs, fraud heads and app teams at banks, fintechs and e-commerce firms to learn what they need.
Define success metrics such as adoption, detection efficacy, false positives and integration time, and report on them.

What You’ll Bring

Must have

4-6 years in product management, with at least 2 years on a B2B security, fraud or mobile SDK product.
Working knowledge of mobile app security: Android and iOS internals, reverse engineering, rooting, hooking and tampering.
Comfort going deep with engineers on technical trade-offs, and going wide with customers on business outcomes.
A record of taking a product from early release to enterprise adoption.
Clear writing and sharp prioritisation.

Good to have

Experience with RASP, app shielding, device fingerprinting or mobile threat defence.
Exposure to BFSI or fintech customers and regulatory expectations for app security.
An engineering or security research background.

Our Culture

We hire self-motivated people and get out of their way
We value performance, not hours worked
Speed, ownership, and impact matter most

Compensation

Competitive salary + potential equity
Health benefits, flexible PTO, learning budget

Role : Product Manager, Trading Infrastructure.

You will own the professional and algo trading surface of Arrow: the products where latency, data depth and execution quality are the whole point.

Five areas sit in your remit, and each one is a product in its own right.

TBT charts: In-house tick-by-tick charting: sub-second candles, order-flow and footprint views, replay, with chart latency held close to feed latency.
HFT algos: In-house algos and a strategy marketplace retail traders can deploy on co-located infrastructure, with risk guardrails and exchange approvals built in.
API latency: The trading and market-data APIs: round-trip order latency at p50/p95/p99, WebSocket feed delivery, SDK ergonomics, rate limits, sandbox.
Colocation access: Productizing exchange co-lo for clients: rack and VM offerings, provisioning, cross-connects, pricing and compliance.
Tick-level data: Dissemination of full-depth, tick-by-tick market data: live feeds, snapshots, historical tick archives, entitlements and fan-out at scale.

This is the first dedicated Product Manager on the Arrow team.

You will work directly with the CTO, the HFT desk, the quant team and exchange-connectivity engineers, and you will set the product process as much as run it.

Expect to spend as much time with latency histograms and order-book data as with roadmap documents.

What You'll Do

Own the TBT charting roadmap.
Define what a tick-by-tick chart must do for a scalper that a one-second chart cannot: sub-second aggregation, order-flow and footprint views, volume-at-price, replay, and multi-instrument sync.
Set and track the chart-update latency budget against the raw feed.
Bring in-house HFT algos to retail.
Scope the first algos and the strategy marketplace: which strategies ship first, how traders discover, configure and deploy them on co-located infrastructure, what the kill switches and position limits look like, and how each algo clears SEBI and exchange approval before launch.
Own API latency as a product metric.
Define the order round-trip and feed-delivery SLOs at p50, p95 and p99, instrument them end to end (client, gateway, OMS, exchange), publish them transparently, and drive the engineering backlog that moves them.
Run the developer experience for the trading API: Go and Python SDKs, WebSocket market-data streams, docs, sandbox, rate limits, static-IP and algo-tagging requirements, and onboarding for API clients from first key to first live order.
Productise colocation access.
Turn exchange co-lo into something a professional client can buy: rack, VM and managed-server tiers, provisioning SLAs, cross-connects, pricing, and the compliance and audit trail each exchange requires.
Own tick-level data dissemination.
Define the market-data products: full-depth live feeds, TBT versus snapshot tiers, historical tick archives, entitlements and billing, and the fan-out architecture needed to serve thousands of clients without adding latency.
Talk to professional traders every week: scalpers, option market-makers, quants and API users.
Turn what they say and what their order flow shows into specs engineers can build from without a second meeting.
Write crisp PRDs with success metrics, latency budgets, failure modes and exchange-rule constraints (algo approval, order-to-trade ratios, throttles, circuit limits, square-off timings) spelled out.
Partner with the CTO, the HFT desk and exchange-connectivity engineers on trade-offs between latency, throughput, reliability and features; a feature that adds 200 s to the hot path is a product decision, not just an engineering one.
Define and track the metrics that matter: order latency and feed latency by percentile, API uptime, active API clients, algo deployments and their P&L distribution, co-lo utilisation, and tick-data subscriptions.

What We're Looking For

4 - 8 years in product, trading-systems engineering or quant/HFT trading, with at least 3 years owning a technical or fintech product end to end.
You understand market microstructure.
Order books, tick data, matching-engine behaviour, order-to-trade ratios, what co-lo buys you and what it does not.
You know why a scalper cares about the difference between 1 ms and 3 ms.
Hands-on with trading APIs.
You have built or run something against a broker or exchange API, understand REST versus WebSocket versus binary protocols, and can read a latency histogram and say where the time went.
Fluent with data.
You can write SQL, pull your own latency and order-flow data, and argue a prioritisation call with numbers rather than opinions.
Shipped in a regulated environment.
You can read a SEBI or exchange circular on algo trading, API access or market data and turn it into a product requirement.
Clear writer.
Your PRDs, SLO definitions and API docs get read and acted on by engineers and traders alike.
Bias for shipping.
You have taken a feature from a trader complaint to production in weeks, not quarters, and iterated after launch.

Nice To Have

Worked at an HFT or prop firm, an exchange, a market-data vendor or an algo trading platform.
Familiarity with NSE/BSE TBT and snapshot feeds, exchange co-lo offerings and the NNF/API order-tagging framework.
Have run a live strategy through a broker API, even a small one.
Options knowledge beyond the basics: Greeks, market-making, hedged-position margin.
Python or Go, enough to prototype an API call, parse a tick file or build your own latency dashboard.

What We Offer

A real execution edge to build on: co-located infrastructure and a 17-year HFT track record that no other retail broker in India starts with.
First dedicated PM in the seat.
You define the role, the process and the roadmap, and you report to the CTO.
Direct access to the HFT desk, quant team and exchange-connectivity engineers; the people who built the engine sit a few desks away.
Offices in Mumbai (Andheri East); market hours mean an early start and a clear end to the day.

About the Role
Delhivery moves millions of shipments a day across one of the most complex physical networks: pickups, line-haul, sorting, last-mile, returns, and cross-border. Every one of those steps generates data, decisions, and money on the table. We believe the next decade of logistics will be won by whoever applies AI most intelligently to the physical world.
We are building a team of Product Managers who will reimagine logistics with an Agentic first approach. You won't be bolting a chatbot on a dashboard. You will own problems where a better model or a smarter agent changes unit economics, customer experience, or network reliability at national scale.
.What You’ll Do
Find the right problems. Spend time in hubs, with riders, ops leaders, and merchants. Translate messy operational pain into opportunities for creating a seamless flow that scales.
Own outcomes, not outputs. Define success metrics tied to cost per shipment, delivery success, NPS, or revenue, and be accountable for moving them.
Ship AI products that real operators use. Design human-in-the-loop workflows, fallbacks, and feedback loops so models earn trust on the ground and keep improving after launch.
Drive adoption across the org. Work with Operations, Sales, Finance, and Customer Experience to embed AI into how teams actually work.
Partner deeply with data science and engineering. Shape problem formulation, data requirements, evaluation methodology, and model-versus-rules trade-offs. Understand precision/recall, drift, latency, and cost well enough to challenge and be challenged.
Run rigorous experimentation. A/B tests, shadow deployments, and phased rollouts across geographies and hubs, with clear go/no-go criteria.
Stay at the frontier. Evaluate new LLM, agentic, and vision capabilities, and decide pragmatically what to build, buy, or fine-tune.
The kind of problems you could own
Network intelligence: demand forecasting, capacity planning, dynamic routing, and ETA prediction across the network
Last-mile optimization: address intelligence and geocoding, delivery-attempt prediction, route and slot optimization, rider productivity
Computer vision on the ground: shipment damage detection, automated weighing and dimensioning, sort-center throughput, proof-of-delivery verification
Generative AI and agents: autonomous customer support, ops copilots for hub managers, document and invoice automation, internal knowledge assistants
Risk and trust: fraud, RTO (return-to-origin) prediction, NDR resolution, and merchant risk scoring
Pricing and commercial intelligence: dynamic pricing, serviceability, and yield optimization
You will be matched to problem statements based on impact, your strengths, and the stage of each problem. Expect to work across more than one.

What We’re Looking For
Experience
2–5 years in product management, ideally with at least 1–2 years shipping ML or AI-driven products (or a strong data science, ML engineering, or analytics background that you have transitioned into product)
A track record of taking a product from ambiguous problem to measurable business impact
Strong academic grounding; engineering degree from a top-tier institution preferred, MBA a plus but not required
Skills
Working fluency in ML concepts: model evaluation, training data quality, feedback loops, and the practical differences between classical ML, deep learning, and LLM-based systems
Hands-on comfort with data: SQL is a must, Python or notebooks a plus. You pull your own numbers.
Experience with, or sharp point of view on, GenAI product design: prompt and eval design, RAG, agents, guardrails, and cost/latency trade-offs
Excellent structured thinking and the ability to communicate with engineers, data scientists, and frontline ops leaders equally well
Bias to action, ownership, and comfort operating in complex, high-volume, real-world environments
Pedigree signals we value
Prior experience at product-led or AI-forward companies (marketplaces, e-commerce, mobility, fintech, SaaS, or AI-native startups)
Evidence of impact: shipped models or AI features with quantifiable results, side projects, or published work
Curiosity about the physical world: supply chains, operations, and hardware-meets-software problems

You will manage every stage of the product development lifecycle from ideation through development, GTM delivery and launch. You will also drive the identification and measurement of KPIs and closely monitor success of your product deliveries. The ideal candidate is an experienced Product Manager with real-world experience working at SaaS/technology companies, leading a product that is technical in nature, targeted for Developers.

The Technical Product Manager will be a product champion, a great team player who works with encouraging approach with cross functional teams. Curious, motivated, forward-thinking can-do attitude could join the team.

This is an individual contributor role. Within the role, your key responsibilities will be to:

Own one or many developer products (e.g.: APIs, client libraries, webhooks, gateways, middleware, and developer portals.) from product definition and planning through production, GTM, release, distribution, maintenance, and end of life. 
Build the product roadmap based on clearly articulated customer and business value, with a focus on understanding Product-market fit, developing effective go-to-market processes, including pricing strategies, training plans, and ensuring effective delivery of Product propositions in new markets. 
Build collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders within operations, marketing, sales, and other cross functional teams to drive product success. 
Engage and interact with clients during feedback sessions, focus groups and requirements gathering sessions. 
Contribute to the product vision and strategy, act as the evangelist for your product with senior leadership and be the lead advocate for investment in the strategy. 
Be able to roll up the sleeves and decipher the architecture and determine if it meets product needs. 
Collaborate closely with engineering to design and build scalable, high performing developer facing products. 
Effectively prioritize the backlog managing competing business needs for new features, small enhancements, bug fixes and all other design and development activity related to your products.

What You'll Bring

We are looking for a dynamic, creative, hands-on Product innovator with the following attributes.

Deep product management experience at a fast-paced company in the financial services sector, ideally payments domain. 
Proven hands-on experience with APIs, webhooks, 3rd party integrations, as a developer, architect, or product manager. 
You have a strong understanding of developer community, and interest in developer-focused thought leadership and evangelism. 
You have a customer-centric approach, have intuition for great user experiences and have an amazing ability to understand the customer’s challenges and can articulate a vision to solve challenges to make an impact. 
You have led new software features and/or new software products from ideation through GA/launch in an Agile environment, worked on commercialization, pricing strategies, drive adoption, growth of your API products 
You have a strong work ethic and know how to knock down barriers to achieve your objective. 
You can work effectively with distributed teams in multiple time zones across US, Europe, and Asia Excellent verbal and written communication skills to technical and non-technical audiences of various levels in the organization, e.g., executive, management, individual contributors Proficiency in problem solving and time management skills managing multiple deadlines. 
Proficiency to operate independently and within a multi-disciplinary team with minimal supervision and guidance from Product Leadership Bonus if you have: 
Experience with API formats, design patterns, cloud technologies and API SDLC tools. 
What we offer you: A competitive salary and attractive benefits package A multifaceted job with a high degree of responsibility and a broad spectrum of opportunities 
A modern, international work environment and a dedicated and motivated team 
The chance to work on some of the most challenging, relevant issues in financial service

About The Team

Our inclusive and global teams win together every day. We’re proud to have the best minds in the industry, who you can learn from as you grow your career. The people, the energy, the connections – it’s unmatched. Come and be part of an ever-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.

What makes a Globalpayer?

Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative – always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.

Does this sound like you? Then you sound like a Globalpayer. Apply now to take your career global.

We are looking for someone who has built consumer-facing products, brings strong analytical depth, has worked on data-heavy problem spaces, has built AI-first products and personalisation experiences, and can solve complex product problems through structured thinking and workflows. Candidates from Tier 1 institutes such as IITs, BITS, NITs, and IIMs are strongly preferred.

About The Role

As Product Manager - II at ShopDeck, you will work closely with the Founder and Leadership team to build AI-first products that help Indian D2C sellers operate and grow their businesses more effectively. You will own complex seller problems end-to-end from understanding user pain points and defining product strategy to shipping solutions, driving adoption, and delivering measurable business impact.

This is not a conventional product role focused only on writing PRDs, managing backlogs, or coordinating feature delivery. It is a high-ownership mandate for someone who can identify the right problem, use data and customer insights to make decisions, work closely with Engineering and Design, and stay accountable for the business outcome after launch.

The role will involve building AI-native and workflow-led products across seller management, business automation, growth, conversion, onboarding, and operational efficiency. You should be equally comfortable speaking with sellers, analysing funnels, designing experiments, challenging technical possibilities, and driving execution in an ambiguous environment.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on product management experience in an e commerce, marketplace, consumer-tech, or B2B SaaS company. Experience building AI powered products, agentic workflows, seller-facing platforms, growth products, or products designed for Indian SMBs will be a strong advantage.

What You'll Do

→ Product Strategy & Problem Discovery

→ AI-First Product Development

→ Seller Experience, E-commerce & Growth

→ Product Execution

→ Cross-Functional Leadership

Experience & Background

3 – 6 years of total experience, including at least 2+ years of hands-on product management experience.
Tier - 1 Pedigree (IIT's, BIT's, NIT's & IIM's)
Experience independently owning a significant product, customer journey, or business charter from discovery through measurable impact.
Experience in an e-commerce, marketplace, consumer-tech, or B2B SaaS company.
Strong preference for candidates who have built products for merchants, sellers, SMBs, business users, or large-scale Indian consumer segments.
Experience with one or more of the following:

→ AI products, AI agents, LLM-based experiences, or intelligent workflow automation

→ Seller, merchant, or business-management products

→ B2B SaaS platforms and operational workflows

→ Growth, acquisition, activation, conversion, or retention products

→ Checkout, discovery, decision-to-buy, or transaction journeys

→ CRM, onboarding, reporting, or process-automation products

Strong analytical capability, including practical experience with SQL, product

analytics, funnel analysis, cohort analysis, and experimentation.

Demonstrated success in improving metrics such as conversion, retention, adoption,

revenue, GMV, customer satisfaction, or operational efficiency.

Experience working closely with Engineering and Design teams in a fast-moving product environment.
A strong academic background from a leading engineering, technology, or management institution is preferred.
Prior experience in companies such as Meesho, Flipkart, Amazon, Razorpay, CARS24, Zomato, Swiggy, Urban Company, GoKwik, Chargebee, Freshworks, Cogoport, or similar product-led businesses will be relevant.

Skills & Mindset

Problem-First Thinking – Starts by identifying and validating the real customer or

business problem before proposing a feature.

Customer Obsession – Builds a deep understanding of sellers and remains close to

their actual workflows and pain points.

Business Ownership – Connects product work to GMV, revenue, conversion, retention,

cost, or seller success—not just feature delivery.

AI-First Thinking – Recognises where AI can materially improve a workflow and

distinguishes meaningful applications from superficial additions.

Product Judgment – Makes sound prioritisation and experience decisions despite

imperfect information and competing demands.

Analytical Depth – Uses data to identify problems, form hypotheses, measure impact,

and understand trade-offs.

Experimentation Mindset – Runs structured tests, learns quickly, and changes

direction when evidence does not support the original hypothesis.

Execution Ownership – Takes responsibility from problem discovery through launch,

adoption, iteration, and final business impact.

Technical Fluency – Works effectively with Engineering and understands technical

constraints without needing to be an engineer.

Structured Communication – Communicates complex problems and decisions clearly

through writing, data, and logical reasoning.

Cross-Functional Influence – Aligns multiple teams around shared outcomes without

depending on hierarchy.

Startup Agility – Operates effectively with ambiguity, limited structure, evolving

priorities, and tight timelines.

Bias for Action – Moves quickly from insight to experiment while maintaining clarity

on the expected outcome.

High Standards – Challenges weak assumptions, incomplete thinking, and low-quality execution while remaining pragmatic about speed.

At ShopDeck, You'll

Build AI-First Products: Create AI-powered products and agentic workflows that solve real operating and growth problems for Indian D2C sellers.
Own Meaningful Business Outcomes: Work on products directly connected to seller growth, GMV, conversion, retention, and operational efficiency.
Partner with Leadership: Work closely with the Founders and Product leadership on ShopDeck's product strategy and most important business problems.
Build from Zero to One: Discover new opportunities, validate ideas, launch products, and build repeatable product systems from the ground up.
Operate at Scale: Build for a diverse base of Indian sellers with different levels of business and technology maturity.
Work Across Functions: Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Growth, Sales, and Operations to deliver complete outcomes.
Own Outcomes, Not Outputs: Be accountable for product adoption and business impact not simply the number of features shipped.
Shape the Product Culture: Raise the bar for product thinking, experimentation, customer understanding, execution, and written clarity at ShopDeck.

ABOUT THE ROLE
Autocar India is India's oldest and most trusted automotive media brand, now operating as a full-stack digital product. We are building a product that does more than publish content — it guides users through the entire new car buying journey, from discovery to decision.

Drive execution of Autocar's core product experience improvements, with a focus on mobile usability, navigation, vehicle research journeys and user engagement. Work closely with the SPM to deliver immediate UX improvements while supporting the development of new decision-making experiences.

Skills Required
Strong fundamentals in Product Management, user experience and customer problem-solving.
Ability to translate user problems into clear product requirements, user stories and actionable specifications.
Good understanding of mobile and web product journeys, navigation, search, filters and comparison experiences.
Working knowledge of product analytics tools such as GA4, Mixpanel, Amplitude or equivalent platforms.
Familiarity with funnel analysis, A/B testing, usability testing and product performance metrics.
Ability to collaborate effectively with designers, engineers, QA and business stakeholders.
Strong execution discipline, attention to detail and ability to manage multiple product initiatives.
Basic understanding of APIs, technical architecture and product development processes.

Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Business or a related discipline.
3–5 years of relevant experience in Product Management, preferably in consumer-facing web or mobile products.
Experience working on consumer internet, marketplace, e-commerce or content/discovery platforms preferred.
Demonstrated experience shipping product features and improving user experience or engagement metrics.
Strong analytical aptitude and structured problem-solving ability.

For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own DataMesh, one of Smartsheet’s most widely used cross-sheet data capabilities and a critical part of how enterprise customers build and run their solutions today. DataMesh sits at the centre of a multi-year shift in Smartsheet’s data model, as we evolve towards column links and, ultimately, relational data capabilities.

You Will

Own the product strategy and roadmap for DataMesh, balancing near-term stability and customer needs against the longer-term migration strategy
Own the operational stability and serviceability of DataMesh, partnering with engineering and Support to prioritise defects, performance issues, and escalations
Shape and execute the migration path from DataMesh to column links, working closely with the Data Links PM on feature parity, the advanced column links roadmap, and report-as-a-source as a critical dependency
Lead customer and user discovery with enterprise personas (work admins, solution builders, system administrators, and power users) to understand how DataMesh is used in practice, identify migration blockers, and validate decisions before they ship
Partner with Customer Success and GTM to plan communications, enablement, and migration support for enterprise accounts that depend on DataMesh
Work with one or more engineering squads, navigating dependencies and making clear scoping and sequencing decisions across a complex, interconnected backlog
Author clear product briefs, requirements docs, and feature specs that design and engineering can execute on without ambiguity
Define success metrics for everything you ship, including DataMesh usage, migration progress, and quality indicators, and partner with data and analytics teams on instrumentation and reporting
Represent DataMesh in leadership reviews, WBRs, and customer conversations, including enterprise account engagements
Perform other duties as assigned

You Have

4+ years of product management experience delivering features within enterprise SaaS or B2B software products
Experience with data management, data modelling, workflow automation, platform integrations, or cross-sheet data referencing is a strong plus
Experience managing a mature product through sustain, deprecation, or migration phases is a plus
Strong customer instincts: you can run structured discovery, synthesise customer feedback, and turn it into well-scoped, validated product decisions
A track record of writing product briefs, requirements docs, and specs that engineering and design can act on without ambiguity
Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional alignment across engineering, design, GTM, and Customer Success
Comfort working with engineering teams across time zones, including stakeholders in North America
A data-driven mindset: you define adoption and quality metrics before you ship and use post-launch data to guide iteration
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including confidence presenting in leadership reviews and speaking directly with enterprise customers
Familiarity with API-driven product development or working alongside platform engineering teams is a plus
Legally eligible to work in India on an ongoing basis

Get To Know Us

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information.

If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.

At U.S. Bancorp India, we’re on a journey to do our best. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bancorp India gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

Job Description

Product Managers at U.S. Bank are customer obsessed in driving product visioning, planning and development to deliver on our human + digital product strategy and staying one step ahead of evolving economic, technological, and customer needs. As a Product Manager, you will:

Identify, analyze and interpret business data using various kinds of techniques to meet business needs and requirements.
Activate the connective tissue between U.S. Bank, customer experience, digital, technology, and business line strategy to identify and prioritize product / portfolio opportunities, and establish the product vision, charter and roadmap.
Defines product outcomes and Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) to prioritize Features/Epics and breaks down work into actionable steps to facilitate product discovery, design, development and delivery.
Manages the end-to-end product lifecycle and drives the product roadmap leveraging OKRs (Objectives and Key Results).
Creates the product in conjunction with agile, experience design, technology and risk partners to achieve business and customer outcomes.
In the case of technical products, understands and cares for the technical features, debt reduction and modernization of the technical product with expertise in the technology required of the product


Basic Qualifications

Product Management experience


Preferred Skills/Experience

Expertise on the critical interdependencies among product model system elements that help and hinder performance; ability to plan and design solutions that synchronize resources to achieve business results using business metrics, key performance indicators, design systems, service blueprints, and reusability
Ability to anticipate shifting market priorities, internal and external customer needs in a manner that consistently adds value
Strong customer centricity to implement strategies and techniques used to ensure that customers have a positive experience with the organization's products and services at every touch point
Knowledge of technical aspects of software products; ability to design, configure and integrate technical aspects of software products
Knowledge of Agile ways of working, knowledge of processes, tools and techniques for assessing and controlling an organization's exposure to risks of various kinds; ability to apply knowledge of risk management appropriately to diverse situations
Preferred skills: product PnL, product strategy, vision and planning, product discovery, product development, channel alignment and management, adoption, customer experience research, insight and execution, agile ways of working, go to market and sales channels, performance measurement and optimization, marketing and analytics, customer centricity


If there’s anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants.

Posting may be closed earlier due to high volume of applicants.

This is an U.S. Bancorp India posting. U.S. Bancorp India is a part of the U.S. Bank family.

Cin7 is a fast-growing global software company that provides solutions for modern-day product sellers. We help these sellers keep track of their inventory at scale, and help them sell their products across multiple sales channels around the world.

Cin7 is expanding very quickly with a mission to become the leading Inventory Management Software brand in the world, and we are looking for a motivated and driven individual to join the team.

Cin7 India is proud of our culture and has been officially recognised with Great Place to Work® Certification™.

How You'll Make An Impact

As a Product Manager with AI experience, you are the link between our users and our engineering team. You will work with users to understand what they need, and you will have the technical skills to work with engineers to deliver it. A key part of the role is finding where AI can save our customers time and effort in inventory management, and turning those opportunities into features that enterprise users love and trust.

You will explore and shape product ideas by interviewing customers, studying competitors, and testing new technology, including AI models, tools, and open source options. There are many good ideas, but only some can be built. You will work with UX, engineering, and leadership to choose the ones that matter most, and to decide where AI is the right answer and where a simpler solution works better.

This position requires that you reside in Ahmedabad, India or Pune, India.

What You'll Do

Turn business goals into clear software requirements. 
Find and define AI use cases for Core, such as forecasting, data entry, search, and automation of routine tasks, and write the requirements for each. 
Rank features based on market research, customer need, and company strategy. 
Manage project scope by making trade-offs between time and cost, and between security and speed. 
Set success measures for AI features, such as accuracy, time saved, and user adoption, and track them after launch. 
Work with engineers to decide how to build, test, and monitor AI features, including how we handle wrong or unexpected results. 
Work with Security, Legal, and Engineering to handle customer data responsibly in AI features, including privacy, data use, and cost of running the models. 
Rank feature requests from the development teams. 
Set the product vision and work closely with the technical team to define specifications. 
Make sure the product meets business goals and user needs. 
Track progress against plan and fix variances as soon as they appear. 
Make trade-offs between features, schedule, and cost, based on business goals, company policies, software architecture, and team capacity. 

What You'll Bring

Proven work experience in product management or as an associate product manager, preferably in B2B SaaS, with inventory management, supply chain, or ecommerce domain experience a plus. 
Hands-on experience shipping at least one product or feature that uses AI or machine learning, including large language models. 
Working understanding of how AI features are built and tested, such as prompts, model selection, evaluation, accuracy, and data quality. You do not need to write code. 
Awareness of AI risks, including incorrect answers, bias, privacy, and cost, and how to reduce them. 
Proven track record of managing a successful product through its full lifecycle. 
Proven ability to develop product and marketing strategies and present recommendations to executive management. 
Structured approach and experience with agile methods. 
History of working with development teams to get results. 
Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to roll up your sleeves. 
Skilled at working with cross-functional teams in a matrix organization. 
Enthusiasm for new technology and a practical view of what it can and cannot do. 
Ability to be productive in a globally distributed team through self-discipline and self-motivation. 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 

Why Work for Us?

We are a fast growing business going through a huge amount of growth. 
You’ll have the opportunity to work on products that are used by our global customer-base and at the same time you’ll be growing your career and developing new skills.
Work From Anywhere for 30 days in a six month period
Celebrate your birthday with a paid day off
A Global Cin7 Day celebrated companywide, providing you a dedicated holiday to focus on your own wellbeing.
Recruitment referral bonus
Work for a Great Place to Work®

₹25,00,000 - ₹34,00,000 a year

Why CIN7?

CIN7 is a leader in one of the most exciting software verticals right now, and we're growing exponentially. We're looking to add people to our team who are passionate about working with a fast growth tech company.

At CIN7, we make great products available to everyone. Every month, millions of sales orders flow through our platform reducing the cost, effort and time for product sellers so they can quickly get products to customers and build their brands without worrying about their operations. We pride ourselves on providing Inventory Management and Supply Chain software to help medium-large product businesses thrive in a highly competitive, digital world. CIN7 centrally manages inventory across multiple locations and channels, connecting 500+ systems to support receiving, selling and shipping stock.

We value diversity at Cin7, and bring people into the heart of everything we do. We hire, recruit, and promote without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, pregnancy or maternity, veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law. We understand the importance of creating a safe and comfortable work environment and encourage individualism and authenticity in every member of our team. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Our Culture

#RunwiththePack

At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to end cyber risk.

We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity.

More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference.

We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level.

About The Position

Position Overview and Objective

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to oversee our network appliance and fleet management infrastructure.

The Senior Product Manager: Network Appliance will contribute to our Product Management organization by leading the strategy, roadmap, and execution for the applications and capabilities we deploy and support on our network appliance platform as well as the infrastructure required to manage our fleet at scale.

Responsibilities

Own the strategy and roadmap for the applications and capabilities deployed and supported on the platform.
Drive Datapath capabilities, including IDS, syslog ingestion & pre-parsing, network ML.
Own on premises features that bridge Arctic Wolf’s cloud to the customer environment via the network appliance platform.
Define and own licensing, entitlement & SKU structure for product and service sales and pricing.
Own the customer portal and public APIs, including the customer user experience and interaction with our products and services through both the customer portal and public API usage.
Own the end-to-end lifecycle of software on the fleet – from imaging and configuration, to release management and device upgrades, to fleet-wide monitoring and operations.
Define and drive the strategy and roadmap for appliance imaging & configuration, including build processes, manufacturer infrastructure deployment, fleet configuration & feature flag management, and zero-touch provisioning.
Own release management & device upgrades, including fleet rollout practices, containerized application delivery systems (e.g., Docker, ECR) as a reusable platform capability, and the over-the-air (OTA) upgrade experience.
Own the base OS lifecycle for our Linux RTK OS – major version migration planning, patch cadence, and LTS/EOL policy, and the upgrade infrastructure for the existing fleet.
Drive fleet management capabilities: dashboards, telemetry aggregation and analysis, and fleet-level configuration and feature-flag operations. Building product features to ensure the scalability and maintainability of our fleet.
Own vulnerability and CVE patch management, including the field escalation feedback loop from Support & Security teams and engineering.
Partner with Engineering Managers, Technical Leads, to translate strategic initiatives into executable engineering plans for a dedicated feature team.
Partner with peer product managers to ensure network appliance platform capabilities support the deployment and monitoring of your roadmap initiatives.
Collaborate with sales on new feature and configuration support.
Author and maintain detailed functional and technical specifications in product briefs and requirement documents, and support backlog grooming and sprint planning.
Conduct competitive and technical research to inform roadmap decisions and differentiate our appliance services offering.

Experience & Requirements

10+ years of prior product management experience, ideally in network security, cybersecurity, or appliance/edge software.
Engineering or technical background, such as Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or Software Engineering.
Experience with network detection/datapath technologies, API design, or licensing/entitlement systems.
Experience with Jira, agile planning tools, and product analytics platforms.
Good To Have: Experience with intrusion detection systems, network traffic analysis, or deception technology.

Benefits

All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:

Equity for all employees 
18 days annual leave, flexible holidays & festivals, and paid volunteer days 
Training and career development programs 
Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance. 
A modern workplace in Helios Business Park in Bengaluru

Security Requirements 

At Arctic Wolf, protecting our people, customers, and data is fundamental to how we operate. All employees are expected to uphold our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance by following internal information security policies, standards, and controls designed to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business, customer, employee, and other confidential information and to support compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

Depending on the role and where permitted by applicable law, employment may be subject to background verification and additional regulatory, security, or compliance requirements, including obligations related to data protection and export control laws, and authorization requirements where applicable.

Your next big opportunity starts here — apply today and help us end cyber risk.

About Chargebee

Chargebee is a leading provider of billing and monetization solutions, empowering businesses with recurring revenue models to streamline revenue and finance operations, capture actionable insights, and drive growth.
Chargebee is trusted by businesses of all sizes, including Zapier, LegalZoom, Lambda, Freshworks, DeepL, Condé Nast, and Pret a Manger, and is proud to have been consistently recognized by customers as a Leader in Subscription Management on G2.
With headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, our team members are based primarily in India, the U.S., and Europe.

About the Team

Chargebee's Platform Product & Engineering teams are responsible for ensuring our technical platform and infrastructure meets the expectations of businesses who rely on Chargebee to run their most important revenue operations. These businesses depend on our technical platform to be robust, extensible, performant, reliable, stable, secure and scalable in order to process billions of dollars (and Euros, and other currencies) worth of transactions with enterprise-class service levels. Our Platform Product Managers make sure we consistently meet and exceed what merchants expect of our technical platform, working closely with engineering and technical and non-technical operations teams to do so.


About the role (Job Summary)

As a member of the platform product team, you will support our ongoing strategic focus on modernizing our platform — a series of initiatives in which we are investing significant resources. We're building a microservice architecture that powers a series of loosely-coupled capabilities used across Chargebee's product lines. Our modernized platform will support throughputs an order of magnitude higher than our legacy platform, with lower latency and higher service levels and will be built to enable rapid development cycles with built-in trust and integrity controls. The modernized platform runs on a standardized and abstract cloud fabric. In addition to runtime transactional components, the modernized platform will also include enterprise data management (including data science and machine learning applications), observability and analytical, and developer productivity components.

What you'll do (role and responsibilities)

Drive planning and prioritization for your feature area within a platform domain, define and track key metrics, and work closely with engineers to define feature functionality and execute against the roadmap.
You'll focus on one or more of the following domains: APIs (endpoints & contracts, workflows, orchestration, frameworks and infrastructure); core platform services (including IAM, queue and job management, auditing, search, notifications, etc.) and service frameworks; transactional data management, enterprise data, DS/ML, and analytical systems; cloud fabric (containers, compute, storage, etc.); path-to-production (build, quality, release gates, automated testing and validation, deployment); observability, telemetry, proactive platform health management and incident processes; and platform initiatives (security, privacy/data protection; technical standards and governance and SLAs/SLOs).
Engage with internal partner teams (and external customers, where relevant) to gather product requirements and feedback through discussions, presentations, and preview programs, and translate that input into clear, detailed requirements.
Own the product lifecycle for your assigned features and services end to end — from discovery through requirements, build, launch, and iteration — shipping consistently against an established roadmap.
As you build fluency in your domain, increasingly help shape near-term roadmap decisions for your feature area in partnership with Staff and Principal PMs, making sure your recommendations align with the broader platform strategy they've set.
Manage the product lifecycle for your feature area, working with cross-functional partners (technical and non-technical) to solve concrete problems faced by Chargebee, our developers, merchants, and our merchants' end users.
Communicate progress, trade-offs, and value delivered clearly to your immediate stakeholders and cross-functional partners.
Conduct technical product discovery at the feature level: understand customer needs (internal and external) and technical constraints well enough to write sound requirements and make day-to-day prioritization calls.
Create detailed product requirements and acceptance criteria (within Agile Kanban or Scrum processes); manage your portion of the roadmap; prioritize within your assigned feature area.
Working with an analytics partner, track the input and output metrics (technical and business) relevant to your feature area and report on progress.
Working with a program management partner, follow operational processes and support staged, incremental roll-out plans.
Help uphold SLAs and SLOs relevant to your feature area.
Operate with growing autonomy within a matrix environment; escalate and help resolve blockers, and build strong working relationships across engineering, program management, and operations.


What you'll bring (required skills and experience)

Minimum Qualifications

Domain-appropriate knowledge: e.g., APIs (REST, GraphQL, etc.); streaming, OLTP and OLAP data systems; service frameworks; CI/CD, etc. (You are not expected to have full domain depth on day one; you should be a fast learner.)
Foundational systems thinking: ability to understand how the parts of a technical system fit together at the feature/service level, with growing ability to reason at a broader system level.
Background in platform product management with 3-5+ years of practical experience.
Strong written and oral communication skills; ability to listen and understand what drives people.
Experience working in a remote, distributed, global (cross-time-zone) company in a rapidly changing business environment, or a strong willingness and ability to adapt to one.
Ability to work with ambiguity and in gray spaces, with support from more senior PMs.
Solid critical thinking, problem-solving, and analytical skills.
Experience with ecommerce, SaaS, or related software applications running on the internet; exposure to complex/distributed systems and cloud technologies (e.g., AWS, Kubernetes, etc.) is a plus.
Experience or demonstrated ability collaborating with cross-functional teams outside your reporting line.
Past experience as a software developer or SDET, or equivalent technical exposure, is a plus.
Higher education in a technical field (CS, EE, Information Systems) or equivalent experience.


Benefits we offer

Job Summary

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Product Manager to support the product team in planning, developing, and delivering innovative digital products. The ideal candidate should have strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills with an interest in product management and technology.

Roles & Responsibilities

Gather, analyze, and document business and product requirements.
Prepare Product Requirement Documents (PRD), user stories, and functional specifications.
Assist in product roadmap planning, feature prioritization, and product strategy.
Collaborate with Engineering, QA, UI/UX, Business, and Project teams to ensure timely product delivery.
Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to understand business needs and provide product updates.
Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and customer research to identify product opportunities.
Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, product reviews, and backlog management.
Perform product validation, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and quality checks before product releases.
Track product development milestones, timelines, and project progress.
Monitor product performance, analyze user feedback, and recommend product enhancements.

About Company: FynTune Solution Private Limited is a fintech startup founded by alumni of IIT, IIM, and veterans from the insurance industry with actuarial science and strategy backgrounds. FynTune Solution has expertise in building technology platforms for insurance companies and insurance intermediaries. Based out of Turbhe (Vashi, Navi Mumbai), FynTune is bringing disruption in the insurance space by making technology easily accessible and affordable to all.

Description

Are you energized by defining product strategy in ambiguous spaces and building teams that deliver meaningful results at scale? We are looking for a Senior Manager, Product Management - Technical to lead a product management organization at Amazon. In this role, you will own the strategic vision and multi-year roadmap for a product portfolio that directly impacts how customers experience Amazon's technology. You will set direction in environments where the problem and opportunity may not yet be fully defined, translating complex inputs from customers and stakeholders into a clear, actionable product strategy. Your work will span system design, roadmap prioritization, and cross-functional alignment — all while building and developing a high-performing team of product managers and leaders.

Key job responsibilities

Define and communicate the long-term product vision and strategy for your portfolio, working backward from customer needs to identify problems worth solving and aligning your roadmap to organizational goals.
Lead, coach, and grow a team of product managers and people leaders, setting the standard for talent development, onboarding, and performance management across your organization.
Drive clarity in ambiguous problem spaces by decomposing complex challenges into actionable plans, distinguishing reversible from irreversible decisions, and making informed trade-offs across opportunity, resources, and sustainability.
Partner with engineering, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver scalable technical solutions, integrating generative AI and emerging technologies where they accelerate customer value.
Establish mechanisms to inspect product quality, operational performance, and customer experience, using data to continuously improve outcomes and communicate progress to senior leadership.

A day in the life

You start your morning reviewing a product narrative ahead of a leadership review, sharpening the strategy with your team before presenting to senior stakeholders. Mid-morning, you join a roadmap prioritization session with engineering and science partners, working through trade-offs on upcoming launches. After lunch, you hold a one-on-one with a direct report to discuss their career growth and coach them through a challenging stakeholder alignment. Later, you evaluate a proof-of-concept for a new AI-driven feature, assessing feasibility and customer impact before wrapping up with a cross-team sync to unblock a dependency.

About The Team

Our team builds technology products that serve Amazon customers at scale. We operate in a collaborative, inclusive environment where product leaders are empowered to define strategy, experiment with new approaches, and drive meaningful business outcomes. We value thoughtful debate, clear written communication, and a genuine commitment to growing the people around us. We are focused on solving complex problems through innovation and are investing in areas like intelligent automation and generative AI to shape the future of our products. If you are excited about building both great products and great teams, we would love to hear from you.

Basic Qualifications

6+ years of team management experience
Bachelor's degree
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

Preferred Qualifications

Experience delivering consumer software products and services in a high growth environment

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
