HackerOne is a global leader in Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) and the only solution provider that pairs the simultaneous trust of the Fortune 500 and the world's largest community of security researchers to secure the AI-native enterprise. The H1 Platform unites agentic AI solutions with security researchers ingenuity to continuously discover, validate, prioritize, and remediate exposures across code, cloud, and AI systems. Through solutions such as agentic and human offensive security testing, AI red teaming, code security, validation, and remediation, HackerOne delivers measurable, continuous reduction of cyber risk for enterprises. Industry leaders, including Anthropic, Crypto.com, General Motors, Goldman Sachs, Lufthansa, Uber, UK Ministry of Defence, and the U.S. Department of Defense, trust HackerOne to safeguard their digital ecosystems. HackerOne was recognized in Gartner’s Emerging Tech Impact Radar: AI Cybersecurity Ecosystem report for its leadership in AI Security Testing.

HackerOne Values

HackerOne is dedicated to fostering a strong and inclusive culture. HackerOne is Customer Obsessed and prioritizes customer outcomes in our decisions and actions. We Default to Disclosure by operating with transparency and integrity, ensuring trust and accountability. Employees, researchers, customers, and partners Win Together by fostering empowerment, inclusion, respect, and accountability.

AI Product Manager, Agentic Vulnerability Elimination

Location: Pune, India (In-office)

Working timing : UK Shift

Position Summary

HackerOne is seeking a hands-on, technically curious Product Manager to join the team building Agentic Vulnerability Elimination (AVE). AVE is how HackerOne brings AI agents and human expertise together to validate, prioritize, and remediate vulnerabilities at scale. The agents do the heavy lifting on every finding, while our triage analysts and security researchers keep them accurate and trustworthy. In this role, you will drive improvements to the quality and performance of these agents and the harness they run in, working closely with our Pune triage and offensive security teams and partnering closely with product development teams based in India, the Netherlands, and the U.K.

This is an ideal role for someone who is energized by AI, comfortable getting into the details of how an agent actually behaves, and motivated by close collaboration with the operators, security researchers, and customers who use and pressure-test our products every day.

This hybrid role is located in Pune, India, and reports to the Principal Product Manager for Agentic Vulnerability Elimination.

Primary Responsibilities

Success in the Product Manager role will be accomplished by delivering on the responsibilities below in alignment with the Values and Principles that define how we work at HackerOne:

Lead the definition and delivery of improvements to AI agent quality, performance, and cost management across validation, prioritization, exploitation, deduplication, and remediation, balancing model capabilities, operational workflows, customer outcomes, and engineering tradeoffs.
Own the evolution of the evaluation framework and agent harness, establishing scalable evaluation methodologies, quality gates, and feedback loops that improve agentic capabilities over time.
Partner with triage, engineering, offensive security researchers, and product teams to align priorities, influence product direction, and translate operational workflows into scalable, AI-driven product capabilities.
Work closely with our offensive security researchers to validate exploitability, adversarially stress-test agent decisions, and improve how the agents reason about real-world attack scenarios.
Partner with customer-facing teams in EMEA and the US to join customer calls and understand user workflows, gather feedback, and keep agent improvements grounded in real-world needs.
Define the product health metrics for your area, design experimentation frameworks, and use evidence to make prioritization decisions that improve customer and business outcomes.
Own significant product initiatives, independently defining problem statements, success metrics, and execution plans while influencing the broader product strategy alongside senior product leadership and partnering closely with development teams based in India, the Netherlands, and the U.K.
Navigate ambiguous product problems where customer needs, AI capabilities, and security workflows are still emerging, bringing structure, prioritization, and clear execution plans to cross-functional teams.

Minimum Qualifications

5+ years of product management experience, ideally on technical or AI/LLM products at high-growth tech or SaaS companies.
A track record of building products with close cross-functional collaboration across engineering, design, and operations.
Hands-on experience with LLM-based solutions, including prompting, evaluations, quality control, and the practical realities of building features on top of generative AI.
Strong analytical skills and comfort working directly with data to define metrics, run experiments, and make decisions.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build alignment among technical and operational staff.
Experience working with distributed/async product development teams in different time zones.
Based in Pune or willing to relocate, and able to work on-site there on a hybrid basis.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Experience building agentic systems, evaluation pipelines, agent harnesses, or human-in-the-loop workflows.
Familiarity with cybersecurity, vulnerability management, DevSecOps, or bug bounty and penetration testing.
Prior experience working closely with an operations or triage team, or directly with security researchers.
Comfort with SQL or light scripting to pull and analyze your own data.

Compensation Band

INR 43-50 LPA

Equity stock options
Retirement plans
Paid public holidays and unlimited PTO
Paid maternity and parental leave
Leaves of absence (including caregiver leave and leave under CO's Healthy Families and Workplaces Act)

Company Description

Publicis Sapient is a digital transformation partner helping established organizations get to their future, digitally enabled state, both in the way they work and the way they serve their customers. We help unlock value through a start-up mindset and modern methods, fusing strategy, consulting, and customer experience with agile engineering and problem-solving creativity. United by our core values and our purpose of helping people thrive in the brave pursuit of next, our 20,000+ people in 53 offices around the world combine experience across technology, data sciences, consulting, and customer obsession to accelerate our clients’ businesses through designing the products and services their customers truly value.

About Tradl AI

Tradl AI is building India's first AI broker, with our own foundation model for quant-reasoned trading decisions in natural language.

93% of individual F&O traders in India lose money — emotion, poor timing, no systematic risk management. Most "AI trading tools" are thin wrappers that hallucinate on numbers. We're building the opposite: a foundation model for real-time quant analysis, paired with integrated broking on our own license, cash and F&O.

Live today: AI screening chatbot, strategy builder (Sensibull × AI), option chain analytics (IV skew, GEX, gamma), live pattern detection, position risk copilot, and in-house charts with our edge model.

Next: AI backtesting, Scalper Max, and broking.

We've closed a seed round from marquee investors, and the founding team brings deep markets experience — systematic investments at Goldman Sachs, business leadership at a major credit platform, crypto, and investment banking. We're squarely in the 0-to-1 journey, keeping the team small and the bar high.

Why This Role Exists

In 1973, Black and Scholes published a formula that changed how traders think about options. Most remember it as a pricing model, but it was deeper. The one thing in an option's price you cannot observe is volatility. Hedge away the direction and you are trading volatility, not direction. Price is the surface. The real game sits one layer underneath.

Most broking apps never show you that layer. They earn more the more you trade, so they hand you a price chart, call it analysis, and nudge you to trade more rather than think deeper. A gamble table with better UI.

The easy answer is to show more data. That's not the job. The craft is building a product that carries all that depth underneath, yet is so simple that a 15-year-old picking up trading understands it instantly.

Take the hardest thing in the room and make it feel obvious. That is the job.

What We're Looking For

6–8 years in product, with at least one consumer product you took from a blank page to something people genuinely loved and used. Fintech preferred.
You trade. Broking or active F&O, with your own money on the line. You've felt the gap between what your app showed you and what you actually needed to know.
You see the layer underneath. Implied vol, greeks, skew, payoff structure — well enough to argue about them, not just define them.
Obsessive about simplification. You can take IV skew or gamma exposure and make it land for someone who started trading last month, without flattening it into something wrong.
End-to-end ownership. You write the spec, sit with the designer, argue with the engineer, and watch the funnel after ship. No handoffs, no throwing it over the wall.
Comfortable in the data. You pull your own numbers, define your own metrics, and know the difference between a real signal and a nice-looking dashboard.
Judgment on what not to build. At 0-to-1, the cut list matters more than the roadmap.

Bonus Points

You've been early at a 0-to-1 startup. You know what it costs and you want to do it again.
You've shipped AI/LLM-powered products to real users — and dealt with the evaluation, latency, trust, and hallucination problems that show up after the demo.
You've worked inside a broker, exchange, or trading platform.
Design sensibility strong enough to sketch the flow yourself before anyone opens Figma.
You've built specifically for the Indian retail audience and understand how differently they think.

Why Join

You'll own the hardest and most differentiated part of the product, on a small team where your product decisions stick. Direct line to the founders, real scope, and problems nobody in the Indian market has solved yet.

About GoCharting

GoCharting is a web-native charting and trading workflow platform with institutional-grade orderflow and DOM tools — footprint/cluster charts, volume/market profile, cumulative delta, imbalance charts, DOM trading. We are the only platform that delivers these capabilities fully on the web. Comparable to TradingView for general charting, but differentiated as the leader in the professional orderflow niche. PE-acquired and funded in 2025, profitable, 3M+ registered traders globally, with a mandate to scale 10x over 4 years. A US rebrand is underway and multi-asset coverage (US equities and options) is being added — the platform is entering its most important chapter, and the backend is where that growth is won or lost.

The Role

This is a senior, hands-on product role at the core of how GoCharting works. The product's moat is technical — real-time market data, orderflow, and the systems that move it — and this role owns the part of the roadmap that makes that moat deeper. You will run backend and platform product work and own our third-party data integrations end-to-end: the exchange feeds, broker connections, and market-data vendors that everything traders see is built on.

You are the product counterpart to a backend engineering team we are scaling right now — new senior engineers on the payments/billing platform, on market-data and broker connectivity, and on the core platform and SDK. Your job is to sequence and scope that work into a coherent roadmap, write the specs engineers build from, and hold the line on quality and reliability. You report to the Head of Product and partner daily with the CTO and his engineers, with Business Development (who sign the deals), and with QA and Support. This is an individual-contributor role — no direct reports, plenty of ownership.

You move fast, write clearly, and make decisions with engineers, not over them. You are comfortable in the technical detail — APIs, data contracts, latency, schemas — without needing to be told what matters. In year one, success looks like a backend roadmap that ships, faster and more reliable data integrations, and a platform that stops being the thing users complain about.

What you'll do

Own the backend & platform roadmap — market-data services, real-time pipelines, APIs, the SDK, and the systems behind charts, alerts, and trading — write clear specs and acceptance criteria, and partner with engineering from design through ship
Own third-party data integrations end-to-end — exchange feeds, broker connections, and market-data vendors, from evaluation through onboarding to production — and build the playbook so the tenth integration is faster than the first
Manage the provider relationship on the product side — scope, data quality, licensing constraints, SLAs, and the day-to-day of keeping feeds healthy (BD owns the commercial deal; you own the technical delivery)
Make the trade-offs that matter — latency, reliability, cost, and coverage — and defend them with data
Run dependency management — work across Product and Engineering so backend work is well understood, scoped, and scheduled to unblock other teams, sequenced against US expansion and ROI
Treat quality and reliability as product features — define what "good" means, measure against it, triage data and platform issues with engineering, and close the loop with Support and power users

What we're looking for

Must-haves:
6–9 years in product management, with real depth on backend, platform, API, or data-heavy products — you've owned infrastructure/data as a product, not just user-facing features
Trading, investing, fintech, or financial-data background — you understand market data and the audience
You are technical — comfortable with APIs, data models, schemas, and latency/reliability trade-offs, and able to hold your own in an engineering discussion (you read specs and schemas natively; you don't need to write production code)
You have shipped third-party or data integrations end-to-end — evaluating providers, onboarding feeds, and owning data quality in production
Strong written communication — you write specs and decisions engineers can build from without a meeting
Sharp prioritization — you sequence ambiguous, interdependent work and make defensible trade-offs, and you say no
Hands-on operator — you work with engineering, not through layers; you get into the detail and ship
Comfortable in a lean, fast-scaling team — high ownership, little hand-holding

The Client Services Digital and AI organization is dedicated to transforming and automating business processes across the end-to-end client service journey, making client and employee interactions with Visa straightforward, intuitive, and rewarding through the design, development, and delivery of enhanced digital experiences. As a member of the Digital and AI team, you will play a pivotal role in driving process improvement, automation, and digitization across Client Services, spanning onboarding, implementation, configuration, testing, licensing, service delivery, issue resolution, and optimization processes.

We are seeking a Product Manager to own the strategy, roadmap, and end-to-end delivery of high-impact digital, AI, and automation products that improve processes across Client Services. The ideal candidate is a skilled product manager with deep product management experience, strong technical fluency, and demonstrated success applying rigorous critical thinking to ambiguous, multi-stakeholder problems. About The Role

Condé Nast is seeking a Senior Product Manager, Trusted Data Products to help transform how data powers insights, innovation, and decision-making across our global portfolio of brands. As AI reshapes how businesses interact with data, we are evolving our data platform to make trusted information more accessible, actionable, and intelligent. This role will help build the foundations that allow teams to move beyond traditional reporting toward AI-powered analytics, conversational insights, and better business decisions.

You will own the evolution of key capabilities within our enterprise data platform, including curated data products, and AI-enabled analytics experiences such as conversational data exploration. Working with Data Engineering, Analytics, and business teams around the world, you will turn complex data into reliable, accessible products that help people answer questions, uncover opportunities, and act on insights.

This is a highly collaborative, technically focused product role that combines hands-on execution with forward-looking thinking. You will help shape how data is structured, connected, and delivered for both human and AI consumption, while keeping the platform reliable, scalable, and responsive to changing needs. Your work will directly influence how Condé Nast uses data and AI to understand audiences, evaluate performance, identify opportunities, and make more informed decisions.

What You'll Do

Enable BI and analytics platform evolution.

Drive technical enhancements that support BI, insights enablement, and AI-powered data experiences, working with global stakeholders to align platform improvements with business needs.
Partner with Analytics and business teams globally to identify recurring challenges and translate them into reusable platform capabilities that improve data accessibility, self-service, and decision-making.
Manage engineering delivery, dependencies, release readiness, technical risks, and ongoing platform health; track measurable outcomes and communicate progress clearly.

Build trusted, AI-ready data products

Drive development of curated, business-ready Gold-layer data products that help teams move from fragmented reporting toward consistent, AI-powered insights and decision-making.
Partner with Engineering, Analytics, and Data Governance on data contracts, definitions, quality standards, lineage, documentation, certification, and monitoring.
Identify opportunities to enhance and manage existing data products, such as Identity Resolution and Single Customer View, in partnership with their stakeholders and owners.

Develop Conversational Analytics And AI Capabilities.

Drive development and continuous improvement of conversational AI capabilities, including the curated datasets needed to support trusted natural-language analytics.
Work with Analytics and Engineering to improve semantic definitions, metadata, context, and data readiness so AI-generated answers are accurate and useful.
Establish evaluation, testing, feedback, and monitoring practices for conversational data access; identify opportunities to expand conversational analytics, AI assistants, and other capabilities that make insights more accessible and actionable.

What You Bring

6+ years of product management experience, including significant work on data platforms, analytics infrastructure, or technical data products.
Hands-on familiarity with Databricks and modern lakehouse architecture or comparable platforms is highly desirable; experience with Databricks Genie or comparable conversational analytics capabilities is highly desirable.
Strong understanding of SQL, data modeling, pipelines, medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold), data quality, lineage, observability, and access controls.
A track record of partnering closely with data engineers to deliver dependable platform capabilities, curated datasets, and technical improvements.
Ability to turn broad goals into crisp requirements, priorities, acceptance criteria, and executable plans while exercising independent product judgment.
Understanding of semantic and metrics layers, metadata, and the foundations needed for trustworthy AI-enabled analytics.
Experience supporting BI and analytics tools and collaborating with analysts to solve recurring data-access and usability problems.
Strong communication skills and experience working across global Engineering, Product, Analytics, and business teams.
A systems mindset, curiosity about emerging AI capabilities, and a practical focus on platform reliability, adoption, and business value.
Experience in media, publishing, advertising, subscriptions, or consumer data ecosystems is a plus.

About the Opportunity
At Taglynk, we partner with category-defining startups to build their core product and engineering teams. We are currently hiring a Senior Product Manager for one of our premier clients—a fast-growing, dynamic consumer healthcare startup revolutionizing how individuals and families manage their personal and family health.
Our client is building a trusted ecosystem offering high-quality, personalized healthcare options, credible medical content, and uncompromising data privacy. You will play a pivotal role in their growth journey by owning a core product charter end-to-end.
The Role
You will take complete ownership of one of the core product charters—defining a distinct part of the product, driving user outcomes, and steering the roadmap from problem discovery to launch alongside a dedicated squad of designers and engineers.
Key Responsibilities
Own Your Charter’s Direction: Set the product strategy and roadmap, ruthlessly prioritize what matters now versus later, and align stakeholders on the "why."
Problem Before Solution: Conduct deep user research, analyze behavioral data, and define sharp problem statements rather than jumping straight to feature lists.
Ship with the Team: Author crisp PRDs and user flows that engineers and designers can execute against; stay closely embedded through grooming, build, and release.
Drive Outcomes, Not Output: Define clear success metrics for every launch, instrument tracking, analyze post-launch learnings, and iterate rapidly.
Build Safe, Compliant Health Products: Operate seamlessly within healthcare guardrails—covering data privacy, user consent, clinical safety, and health content standards—to design for high user trust.
Shape Shared Foundations: Collaborate with fellow PMs across interconnected charters on shared user flows, design components, and product team best practices.
What We Are Looking For
Proven Product Ownership: 6–8 years of experience in product management with a strong track record of owning a consumer-facing product area end-to-end.
AI & Agentic Product Experience: Hands-on experience shipping AI-powered or agentic features to production (beyond prototypes). You know how to design around model limitations through output testing, human-in-the-loop review, and strict safety guardrails for health use cases, and you actively use AI tools in your daily workflow.
Technical Fluency: Strong grasp of systems, APIs, and data models to debate architectural trade-offs with engineers, spot hidden complexity, and write rock-solid specs (no specific technical degree required).
Sharp User Judgment & Design Sense: Ability to uncover the real job-to-be-done behind user requests, turn ambiguous research into decisive action, and collaborate closely with designers in Figma on fine-grained UX details.
Data-Driven Mindset: Comfortable setting up event tracking, analyzing funnels and dashboards (e.g., Mixpanel), and letting evidence guide decisions.
High Ownership in Ambiguity: You frame unstructured problems, make confident calls, course-correct quickly, and stay hands-on with specs and sprint grooming.
Crisp Communication: Your PRDs, strategy docs, and stakeholder updates are concise, structured, and actionable.
Bonus / Preferred Qualifications
Prior experience in Indian Healthtech—specifically around personal health records (PHR), care coordination, or consumer health.
Working familiarity with healthcare interoperability and standards such as ABDM, FHIR, or SNOMED CT.
Practical understanding of India’s DPDP Act or broader health data privacy frameworks.
Personal empathy for the problem space—having acted as the primary health manager for your own family or closely supported someone who does.
Why Apply Through Taglynk?
Direct Access: Fast-tracked interview process directly with the founding and product leadership team.
Dedicated Representation: End-to-end guidance, role insights, and interview prep from Taglynk’s specialist tech recruitment team.

jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your Mission

Shape the future of agentic automation. UiPath is evolving from RPA to the world’s first Agentic Orchestration platform, enabling enterprises to deploy autonomous AI agents at scale. You’ll own one of the foundational layers that power it: Data Fabric and Ontology, the data and context layer that every other product on the platform (agents, workflows, and RPA) depends on to do its job. Your charter is to define where the data layer sits in the agentic stack, make it the obvious and trusted choice for developers and customers, and prove that value with real production adoption.

This is a high-agency, AI-native role. You won’t be running status meetings. You’ll be deep in the product: building agentic automations, prototyping with coding agents, talking with customers and FDEs, and turning what you learn into crisp direction for the engineers who build it.

The Platform You’ll Shape

You’ll join the team building the foundational layers of UiPath’s agentic platform, the layers every agent, process, and workflow depends on. Data Fabric gives agents and workflows governed, real-time access to enterprise data. Ontology models those raw records into business entities and a connected semantic layer that automations can reason and act over. The work ahead: turning data into connected context agents can navigate, and making that context the backbone of how the platform reasons.

What You’ll Do At UiPath

Own the strategy and positioning for UiPath’s data layer. Set the point of view on what the data layer is and why it matters in the agentic era. Turn that into the narrative leadership, marketing, and the field rally behind.
Own the vision and roadmap for Data Fabric and Ontology, making sharp tradeoff decisions on complex, ambiguous problems and proposing a clear path forward rather than just surfacing the ambiguity.
Drive adoption across every consuming surface. Partner with peer product and engineering teams to make Data Fabric and Ontology the default, and treat internal adoption as seriously as external demand.
Drive external go-to-market. Partner with marketing and sales on positioning, enablement, and demos; create demand and get your wins in front of the field and customers.
Be the customer’s champion. Engage directly in account conversations, get deep into real scenarios, and turn what you learn into validated use cases and roadmap decisions.
Own outcomes end to end. Take accountability from problem definition through launch, adoption, and the metrics that prove value: production adoption, breadth of connected data sources and entity coverage, consumption across platform surfaces, and query performance and trust.
Get technical. Work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering on design decisions, dogfood the product yourself, and stay credible on the underlying technology.
Make it agent-ready. Translate the fast-moving agent landscape (LLMs, coding agents, orchestration frameworks, MCP, evals) into a coherent UiPath point of view and a shipping product.
Raise the bar for the broader product team through thought leadership, a strong point of view in forums, and mentoring, setting the standard for how the platform thinks about data and context.

What You’ll Bring To The Team

8+ years of product management on technical, platform, or developer products, ideally in B2B SaaS or enterprise software.
Data and semantic depth. Hands-on experience with data platforms and with modeling business objects as entities; familiarity with semantic layers, knowledge graphs, or ontologies is a strong advantage.
A builder’s instinct. You’ve shipped infrastructure that other builders rely on, and you’d rather prototype and dogfood than write a spec and wait.
Technical depth. You go deep on technical design with engineering and are comfortable in the product yourself, not just managing from the roadmap.
Hands-on with AI, not conceptual. You have built or integrated AI/ML into live products yourself, and you use LLM-based tools (copilots, coding agents, prototyping tools) in your own daily work.
A strategic narrative. You can define a category and a point of view, and tell a clear “why now” and “why us” story that executives, the field, and customers buy into.
A genuine customer-champion mindset. You seek out direct customer conversations and let real scenarios drive what you build.
GTM drive. You’ve created demand and driven adoption, not just delivered features
Crisp, decision-rich communication and the ability to influence across engineering, design, sales, and marketing without authority.
Bias to ownership and action. You take ambiguous, high-stakes problems and drive them to a result with minimal direction.

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy.

Overview

If you think in systems, work well with ambiguity, and want your output to have real stakes, this team is where you will do your best work.

About the Role
Innovaccer is building the Gravity Platform, a next-generation healthcare data and application platform that powers interoperability, intelligence, and secure collaboration at scale. The InCore services form the foundation of Gravity, enabling identity, access, security, governance, and data control for all applications, services, and AI-driven tools on our platform.
We are looking for an experienced Product Manager to own and drive InCore components that power platform-scale capabilities, including user management and authentication (SSO, Smart-on-FHIR), platform management (customer contracts, tenants, configurations and observability), metadata and the unified asset catalog, access governance (RBAC and ABAC) across platform, data, APIs and AI/ML entities, centralized multi-channel communication, billing metering, audit logging, security and compliance controls, and external app integrations across EHRs, partner apps and AI tools.
This is a high-impact role requiring cross-functional leadership, technical depth, and user-centric thinking to define, deliver, and scale platform services critical to healthcare transformation.

A Day in the Life
Define the vision and strategy for InCore services, aligned with Gravity platform goals, regulatory requirements such as FHIR, SMART-on-FHIR, MARS-E and HIPAA, and customer needs.
Own the roadmap for key components including IAM, SSO, metadata, access governance, security and compliance, usage metering, audit logging, and AI access control.
Drive the design and delivery of enterprise-scale access governance and security frameworks for applications, data, and AI/ML assets.
Lead platform-level integrations including Smart-on-FHIR, external apps, SSO through OpenID and SAML, and partner tools.
Lead delivery of a centralized communication service that lets apps and services send messages across email, SMS, Slack, WhatsApp and IVR, with analytics, templating, and compliance controls.
Work with engineering, design, security, compliance, and customer teams to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions.
Define success metrics and continuously measure outcomes to guide iterations.
Ensure platform self-service capabilities, such as access policy setup, SSO configuration, audit dashboards and billing reports, that delight customers and reduce operational overhead.
Stay ahead of platform trends across identity, access, governance, compliance, and AI safety.

What You Need
5+ years of product management experience, ideally in platform, infrastructure, or security products.
Experience designing SaaS platform services at scale, with multi-tenant architectures and external integrations such as EHRs and third-party apps.
Strong technical understanding of API design, distributed systems, security controls, and enterprise architecture.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally across engineering, design, security, legal, compliance, and GTM teams.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
Passion for building secure, compliant, scalable platforms that power mission-critical applications.
Prior experience in healthcare platforms or data platforms is a plus.
Demonstrated success managing core platform services such as identity and access management, RBAC and ABAC, SSO, metadata and catalogs, usage metering, audit logging, and security frameworks is a plus.
Familiarity with standards including FHIR, SMART-on-FHIR, OpenID Connect, SAML and OAuth is a plus.
Exposure to AI governance frameworks and managing access and security for AI entities such as LLM agents and ML models is a plus.
Experience working on developer platforms or cloud infrastructure products is a plus.
Familiarity with billing metering and enterprise usage reporting for SaaS is a plus.

We offer competitive benefits to set you up for success in and outside of work.

Here’s What We Offer
Generous Leave Benefits: Enjoy generous leave benefits of up to 40 days.
Parental Leave: Experience one of the industry's best parental leave policies to spend time with your new addition.
Sabbatical Leave Policy: Want to focus on skill development, pursue an academic career, or just take a break? We've got you covered.
Health Insurance: We offer health benefits and insurance to you and your family for medically related expenses related to illness, disease, or injury.
Pet-Friendly Office*: Spend more time with your treasured friends, even when you're away from home. Bring your furry friends with you to the office and let your colleagues become their friends, too. *Noida office only
Creche Facility for children*: Say goodbye to worries and hello to a convenient and reliable creche facility that puts your child's well-being first. *India offices

Where and how we work
Our Noida office is situated in a posh tech space, equipped with various amenities to support our work environment. Here, we follow a five-day work schedule, allowing us to efficiently carry out our tasks and collaborate effectively within our team.

Innovaccer is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity, and we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where all employees, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, marital status, or veteran status, feel valued and empowered.

Disclaimer: Innovaccer does not charge fees or require payment from individuals or agencies for securing employment with us. We do not guarantee job spots or engage in any financial transactions related to employment. If you encounter any posts or requests asking for payment or personal information, we strongly advise you to report them immediately to our HR department at px@innovaccer.com. Additionally, please exercise caution and verify the authenticity of any requests before disclosing personal and confidential information, including bank account details.

About noon
We’re building an ecosystem of digital products and services that power everyday life across the Middle East—fast, scalable, and deeply customer-centric. Our mission is to deliver to every door every day. We want to redefine what technology can do in this region, and we’re looking for a Product Manager — Middle Mile, who can help us move even faster.

Noon’s fastest hyper-local delivery platform, Noon Minutes, offers a localized assortment of FMCG & grocery products with delivery within 15-minutes. Currently live across the UAE and Saudi Arabia, offering thousands of products to customers in record time.

noon’s mission: Every door, every day.

What you'll do:
Team noon has some of the fastest, smartest, and hardest-working people we've encountered. With a young, aggressive, and talented team, we're driving major missions forward.

As PM for Middle Mile, you will own the product roadmap for inter-warehouse logistics — building systems that optimize transportation, improve network visibility, and drive down costs across noon's fulfillment operations.
Own and drive the product roadmap for middle-mile operations, including inter-warehouse transportation, line-haul planning, and real-time shipment visibility.
Partner with engineering, operations, and data teams to define requirements, prioritize features, and ship solutions that improve SLA performance and reduce transportation costs.
Lead end-to-end product discovery — from identifying operational pain points to designing, testing, and iterating on scalable logistics solutions.
Build and maintain performance dashboards that give operations teams clear, actionable visibility into middle-mile metrics.
Collaborate with data science and ML teams to explore AI/ML-driven use cases in route optimization, capacity planning, and carrier management.
Work closely with WMS and TMS stakeholders to ensure seamless system integrations across the logistics network.
Communicate clearly across cross-functional teams and leadership, aligning on goals, trade-offs, and delivery timelines.

What you'll need:
2–3 years of product management experience in a tech-driven, fast-paced environment.
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate complex operational problems into clear, actionable product requirements.
Exposure to supply chain or logistics systems; prior experience with WMS, Supply Chain or TMS platforms is a strong plus.
Experience with data-driven products and analytics tools — SQL proficiency or familiarity with BI dashboards is preferred.
Exposure to optimization, AI/ML use cases in logistics or supply chain is an advantage.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across engineering, operations, and leadership.
Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver in ambiguous, high-velocity environments.

Who will excel?
We're looking for people with high standards, who understand that hard work matters.
You need to be relentlessly resourceful and operate with a deep bias for action.

noon is not for everyone; readiness to adapt, pivot, and learn is essential.

jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
About The Team

Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers - ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.

Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us. 😉

We are driven by a ‘user-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ & delivery - not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.

But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs, to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who is passionate about solving high impact problems in a fast paced start-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as analytics, data engineering, business and product management, etc to solve complex problems for the organization.

What You Will Do

Market & Customer Understanding: Understand the domain and technology landscape deeply through landscape analysis, user interviews/research, competition analysis and other qualitative/quantitative techniques.
Problem Identification & Prioritization: Adopt a structured approach to identify what problems need to be solved and break them down into smaller chunks. Prioritize what problems need to be solved now vs. later. 
Vision: Ability to set forward looking vision and roadmap for the charter aligned with company’s goals 
Solution Discovery: Facilitate a process to come up with the best technology-led ideas to solve the prioritized problems. Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engg., business, etc. Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc. 
Product Delivery: Define detailed product requirements and work collaboratively with a cross-functional team (analytics, engineering, business, etc.) to bring a product to life. Ensure high product quality through processes such as user acceptance testing, etc. 
Go-to-Market Planning: Create a go-to-market plan working with business/marketing stakeholders to maximize product adoption and success. 
Adoption & Metrics: Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously. Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction. 
Team Leadership: Manage a small team of product analysts and associate product managers, and guide them towards product execution. 


What You Will Need

Overall experience of 7+ yrs with at least 4+ yrs in product management in a tech-led company with experience in data, analytics, engineering etc.
Exceptional problem solving skills based on first principles thinking 
Good understanding of technology and data landscape, and comfort with product management processes such as writing product requirement documents, managing product backlogs, and creating roadmaps

Own enterprise Voice AI Agents end-to-end, taking them from concept to production and driving continuous optimization.

Write, test, and refine prompts to deliver accurate, natural, contextual, and brand-aligned conversations.

Why should you consider us seriously?

Freedom and Responsibility 🦅
Entrepreneurial Team 💪
Exponential Growth 📈
Healthcare (Physical & Mental Wellness) 😌

Please Note
SquadStack.ai is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. SquadStack .ai is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

At Arctic Wolf, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you will help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We’re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Bartner Peer Insights and IDC MarketScape – but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform.

If you’re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high-growth company that’s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you!

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager – Exposure Management to help achieve this mission.

The Senior Product Manager – Exposure Management will contribute to our Product Management organization by leading the strategy, roadmap, and execution of Arctic Wolf’s Aurora Exposure Management platform. This role requires deep familiarity with Exposure Management technologies, specifically vulnerability detection and content generation methods. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience working with engineering and user experience teams to decompose business needs into detailed technical requirements and ensure consistent value delivery.

In This Role, You Will

Align product requirements with strategic objectives for Aurora Exposure Management, ensuring clarity and traceability from concept to delivery.
Partner with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, Technical Leads, and Program Managers to translate strategic initiatives into executable engineering plans.
Collaborate with stakeholders across engineering, security operations, threat research, customer success, and leadership teams to prioritize initiatives and evaluate trade-offs.
Author and maintain detailed functional and technical specifications in product briefs and detailed product requirement documents.
Decompose high-level product goals into actionable development tasks and user stories, ensuring completeness and clarity.
Conduct competitive and technical research to inform roadmap decisions and differentiate Arctic Wolf’s Aurora Exposure Management offering.
Support backlog grooming and sprint planning with a focus on technical feasibility and business value.
Support enablement of all impacted stakeholders for new product releases.

You Will Be Successful In This Role If

You have significant experience in Product Management within cybersecurity or security operations environments.
You have a strong understanding of vulnerability management, scan technologies, vulnerability content, asset discovery, and remediation technologies.
You have a good understanding of breach and attack simulation, adversarial security, or penetration testing.
You have experience managing complex product roadmaps that span multiple engineering teams and stakeholders.
You are skilled at prioritization, trade-off analysis, backlog management, and agile product delivery.
You have a strong understanding of software development processes, agile methodologies, and product lifecycle management.
You are comfortable analyzing telemetry, usage metrics, adoption trends, and operational costs to guide product decisions.
You can clearly communicate product strategy, roadmap priorities, and business value to both technical and non-technical audiences.
You have strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build trusted relationships across engineering, product, and business teams.
You have a proven ability to identify risks, resolve ambiguities, and drive alignment across complex initiatives.

Must Have

6+ years of prior product management experience, ideally in exposure management, vulnerability management, or endpoint and network security.
Engineering or technical background, such as Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or Software Engineering.
Familiarity with cloud-native, multi-tenant platforms and large-scale distributed systems.
Experience with Aha, Jira, agile planning tools, and product analytics platforms.

Good To Have

Experience with breach and attack simulation, adversarial security, or penetration testing.
An MBA degree.

Do not meet all the requirements? That is okay. We still encourage you to apply. We have many opportunities and are always looking for strong talent.

On-Camera Policy

To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.

At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace United States, Best Places to Work United States, Great Place to Work Canada, Great Place to Work United Kingdom, and Kununu Top Company Germany. Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 10,000 customers worldwide and more than 2,000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains a trusted name in the industry.

Our Values

Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion and value the unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. By protecting sensitive data and working to end cyber risk, we contribute to an industry that serves the greater good.

We celebrate diverse perspectives through our Pack Unity program and encourage employees to participate in or create new alliances.

We also believe in corporate responsibility and have joined the Pledge One Percent movement to give back to our communities.

All Employees Receive Compelling Compensation And Benefits Packages, Including

Equity for all employees
Flexible annual leave, paid holidays, and volunteer days
Training and career development programs
Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance equal to three times compensation, and personal accident insurance
Fertility support and paid parental leave

Arctic Wolf is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics, or any other basis forbidden under applicable law. We are committed to fostering a welcoming, accessible, and inclusive environment.

Security Requirements

Conduct duties in accordance with Arctic Wolf information security policies, standards, and controls.
Background checks are required for this position.
This role may require access to information protected under United States export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations. If applicable, an offer of employment will be conditioned upon authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these regulations.

Company Description Flowy is an AI-native HRMS, founded in 2026, that centralizes HR workflows from hire to retire. The platform is designed to make HR more human by reducing manual, repetitive tasks and streamlining complex processes. Flowy enables HR professionals to spend less time managing systems and more time supporting people across the organization. The product offers a thoughtful, people-first alternative to traditional, feature-heavy HR technology and is focused on delivering intuitive, modern experiences for HR teams and employees.
Role Description This is a full-time, remote Product Manager role. The Product Manager will own the end-to-end product lifecycle, from discovery and definition to launch and iteration, for key areas of Flowy’s AI-native HR platform. Day-to-day responsibilities include conducting user research with HR teams and employees, defining product requirements and roadmaps, writing clear user stories, and collaborating closely with design, engineering, and data teams to deliver high-quality features. The role involves prioritizing the backlog based on user impact and business goals, monitoring product performance and usage data, and continuously refining the product through experiments and feedback. The Product Manager will also work with go-to-market teams to ensure successful releases, documentation, and stakeholder alignment.
Qualifications
Experience in product management, including defining roadmaps, writing user stories, and managing the product lifecycle in a SaaS or B2B environment.
Strong skills in user research, requirements gathering, and translating customer pain points into clear, actionable product solutions.
Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, data, and go-to-market functions in a remote setting.
Comfort with data analysis, experiment design (e.g., A/B testing), and using metrics to inform prioritization and measure product success.
Familiarity with HR technology, HR processes, or people operations is highly beneficial.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and documentation skills, with a focus on clarity and inclusion.
Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, organize multiple initiatives, and deliver outcomes in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (such as Business, Computer Science, Human Resources, or a related discipline), or equivalent practical experience.

jobs.sourceTitle: Digital Product Manager - API Management Platforms (Apigee & IBM DataPower)
jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Digital Product Manager to drive the strategy, roadmap, adoption, and lifecycle management of our enterprise API Management platforms, including Apigee and IBM DataPower. The ideal candidate will possess a strong blend of product management, API ecosystem, integration architecture, platform governance, and stakeholder management experience.

This role will be responsible for defining the product vision, prioritizing platform capabilities, driving modernization initiatives, enabling development teams, and ensuring the platform delivers secure, scalable, and reliable API services across the enterprise.

Key Responsibilities

Define and own the product strategy, vision, and multi-year roadmap for API Management platforms including Apigee and IBM DataPower.
Partner with business, architecture, security, operations, and engineering teams to identify platform needs and translate them into prioritized product features and capabilities.
Drive API platform adoption across enterprise teams by promoting best practices, standards, and self-service capabilities.
Manage product backlogs, feature prioritization, release planning, and stakeholder communications.
Establish API governance, security, lifecycle management, and onboarding standards.
Lead modernization initiatives involving API gateways, cloud-native architectures, AI-driven integrations, and developer experience enhancements.
Work closely with engineering teams to define platform requirements related to scalability, resiliency, performance, observability, and operational excellence.
Define and track platform KPIs, adoption metrics, API consumption trends, and customer satisfaction measures.
Collaborate with vendor partners and internal leadership to evaluate emerging technologies and platform enhancements.
Drive continuous improvement through feedback loops, platform analytics, and operational insights.
Support budgeting, capacity planning, and investment decisions related to API management platforms.

Required Skills & Experience

12+ years of experience in Product Management, API Management, Integration Platforms, or Enterprise Middleware technologies.
Strong experience with Apigee API Management and IBM DataPower Gateway platforms.
Proven track record of managing enterprise platform products and driving platform adoption at scale.
Deep understanding of API design, REST services, API lifecycle management, developer portals, and API governance.
Experience working in Agile product management environments with responsibility for roadmap planning and backlog prioritization.
Strong understanding of API security concepts including OAuth, JWT, mTLS, OpenID Connect, and Zero Trust principles.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
Knowledge of observability and monitoring platforms such as Datadog, Splunk, Grafana, or similar tools.
Understanding of enterprise integration patterns, microservices architecture, and event-driven systems.
Experience partnering with senior business and technology stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with AI Gateway capabilities and GenAI platform integrations.
Exposure to Kong, MuleSoft, Azure API Management, or other API gateway technologies.
Experience with Kubernetes, container platforms, and DevOps practices.
Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and CI/CD pipelines.
Relevant certifications in Product Management, Cloud, Apigee, or Agile methodologies.

Leadership & Soft Skills

Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to influence decisions across cross-functional teams without direct authority.
Strategic thinker with a customer-first mindset.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Demonstrated ability to lead large-scale platform transformation initiatives.
Excellent presentation, negotiation, and organizational skills.

Success Measures

Increased API platform adoption and developer satisfaction.
Improved platform reliability, scalability, and security posture.
Delivery of roadmap commitments aligned to business priorities.
Reduction in API onboarding time and operational overhead.
Enhanced observability, governance, and compliance across the API ecosystem.

Primary Skills

Business Case Analyses, Product Management, Product Roadmapping, Product Strategies, Systems Thinking

Shift Time

Recruiter Info

Yateesh B G

ybgaa@allstate.com

About Allstate

Joining our team isn’t just a job — it’s an opportunity. One that takes your skills and pushes them to the next level. One that encourages you to challenge the status quo. One where you can shape the future of protection while supporting causes that mean the most to you. Joining our team means being part of something bigger – a winning team making a meaningful impact.

The Allstate Corporation is one of the largest publicly held insurance providers in the United States. Ranked No. 84 in the 2023 Fortune 500 list of the largest United States corporations by total revenue, The Allstate Corporation owns and operates 18 companies in the United States, Canada, Northern Ireland, and India. Allstate India Private Limited, also known as Allstate India, is a subsidiary of The Allstate Corporation. The India talent center was set up in 2012 and operates under the corporation's Good Hands promise. As it innovates operations and technology, Allstate India has evolved beyond its technology functions to be the critical strategic business services arm of the corporation. With offices in Bengaluru and Pune, the company offers expertise to the parent organization’s business areas including technology and innovation, accounting and imaging services, policy administration, transformation solution design and support services, transformation of property liability service design, global operations and integration, and training and transition.

Learn more about Allstate India here.

Yubi, formerly known as CredAvenue, is re-defining global debt markets by freeing the flow of finance between borrowers, lenders, and investors. We are the world's possibility platform for the discovery, investment, fulfillment, and collection of any debt solution. At Yubi, opportunities are plenty and we equip you with tools to seize it.

In March 2022, we became India's fastest fintech and most impactful startup to join the unicorn club with a Series B fundraising round of $137 million.

In 2020, we began our journey with a vision of transforming and deepening the global institutional debt market through technology. Our two-sided debt marketplace helps institutional and HNI investors find the widest network of corporate borrowers and debt products on one side and helps corporates to discover investors and access debt capital efficiently on the other side. Switching between platforms is easy, which means investors can lend, invest and trade bonds - all in one place. All of our platforms shake up the traditional debt ecosystem and offer new ways of digital finance.

Yubi Credit Marketplace - With the largest selection of lenders on one platform, our credit marketplace helps enterprises partner with lenders of their choice for any and all capital requirements.
Yubi Invest - Fixed income securities platform for wealth managers & financial advisors to channel client investments in fixed income
Financial Services Platform - Designed for financial institutions to manage co-lending partnerships & asset based securitization
Spocto - Debt recovery & risk mitigation platform
Corpository - Dedicated SaaS solutions platform powered by Decision-grade data, Analytics, Pattern Identifications, Early Warning Signals and Predictions to Lenders, Investors and Business Enterprises

So far, we have on-boarded over 17000+ enterprises, 6200+ investors & lenders and have facilitated debt volumes of over INR 1,40,000 crore.
Backed by marquee investors like Insight Partners, B Capital Group, Dragoneer, Sequoia Capital, LightSpeed and Lightrock, we are the only-of-its-kind debt platform globally, revolutionizing the segment.

At Yubi, People are at the core of the business and our most valuable assets. Yubi is constantly growing, with 1000+ like-minded individuals today, who are changing the way people perceive debt. We are a fun bunch who are highly motivated and driven to create a purposeful impact. Come, join the club to be a part of our epic growth story.

Role:

We are seeking a dynamic and driven Product Manager to lead the development and enhancement of our financial technology products. The ideal candidate will have understanding of the fintech landscape, a passion for innovation, and the ability to translate market needs into actionable product strategies. As a Product Manager, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver products that meet customer needs and drive business growth.
Key Responsibilities:
Product Strategy and Vision: Develop and articulate a clear product vision and strategy for our fintech products, aligned with company goals and market opportunities.
Market Research and Analysis: Conduct thorough market research to identify customer needs, market trends, and competitive landscape. Use insights to inform product development and positioning.
Roadmap Planning: Create and maintain a product roadmap that prioritizes features and enhancements based on business objectives, customer feedback, and market demands.
Feature Definition: Clearly define and prioritize product features, ensuring they meet the requirements of B2B clients and contribute to the overall success of the product.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with engineering, design, marketing, sales, and customer support teams to ensure successful product development and launch.
Requirements Gathering: Collect and document detailed product requirements from stakeholders and customers. Translate these requirements into clear and actionable tasks for the development team.
Project Management: Oversee the product development lifecycle, from ideation to launch, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality products. Manage project timelines, resources, and budgets.
User Experience Focus: Advocate for the end-user by ensuring products are intuitive, user-friendly, and deliver a seamless experience. Conduct user testing and gather feedback to drive continuous improvement.
Performance Monitoring: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure product success. Use data-driven insights to make informed decisions and adjustments.
Compliance and Security: Ensure that products comply with relevant financial regulations and industry standards. Prioritize security and data privacy in product design and development.
Stakeholder Communication: Maintain transparent and effective communication with stakeholders, providing regular updates on product status, milestones, and changes.

Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, or a related field. MBA or equivalent advanced degree is a plus.
2+ years of product management experience, preferably in the fintech industry.
Strong understanding of financial services, payment systems, banking, or related domains.
Proven track record of successfully launching and managing fintech products.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Ability to think strategically and execute methodically.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.
Proficiency in product management tools and methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum, Jira, Trello)

Job Description

Thousands of UK accountancy practices rely on our software every day to run their firms, serve their clients and meet their compliance obligations. As Product Manager, you will own part of that portfolio and help take it from a set of well-run products to a connected, AI-enabled platform that practices and partners can build on. This is a build-and-converge mandate, not a maintenance role.

The Product Manager role is changing. AI is changing the way we work: the time from idea to working software is shrinking, prototyping is moving towards real development with tools like Claude Code, and the lines between product, engineering and design are blurring. The successful candidate will be flexible and willing to lean into that change, and will partner heavily with engineering and design, shaping, prototyping and building alongside them rather than handing over documents.

You will use the latest AI tools to move from idea to validated prototype faster than traditional product management allows, in a team that treats AI as part of its everyday toolkit.

The Opportunity

Practices are consolidating fragmented point tools into one connected workflow and want a single partner to deliver it.

About Commotion
Everyone’s chasing speed, but true conversation isn’t just fast, it’s human.
People naturally pause around 200-300 ms between turns. That’s the rhythm where dialogue feels alive. Most voice systems lose reasoning and tone when they push below 500 ms.

At Commotion, we’re building full-duplex, speech-to-speech models that listen, reason, and speak at the same time. We’re achieving emotionally rich, natural turn-taking at around 500 ms, a latency that doesn’t just sound quick but feels human.

Our flagship product, Voice AI, lets anyone create autonomous voice agents that connect to multiple knowledge sources, tools, and systems to get real work done, through voice, chat, APIs, webhooks, and events. Think of it as giving every person or business their own digital teammate, and we’re just getting started.

Your Team Responsibilities

We are seeking an AI Product Manager to own the building and commercialization of new AI solutions across our Sustainability and Climate (S&C) product suite. Responsibilities will include owning and expanding our new MCP / MSCI AI Insights solution and leading the build and commercialization of new AI agents for the S&C business.

The ideal candidate combines strong product management capabilities with a deep understanding of data, data distribution (API, Snowflake, etc), emerging AI applications, and the needs and workflows of investors and other regulated financial services clients. You will work closely with Product, Research, Engineering, Data Operations, Legal and Client Coverage colleagues to define and deliver AI-powered capabilities that unlock value at scale. You will interact with clients to understand their evolving needs in relation to AI, and with potential third party partners to establish new business growth opportunities.

Your Key Responsibilities

Product & solution vision (cross-functional leadership): Own the product vision for AI interfaces and agent solutions — including S&C data AI-readiness, MCP, AI Insights and agentic workflow tools — identifying client needs and use cases, sizing opportunities, creating prototypes with relevant cross-functional stakeholders and validating ideas with clients, translating prototypes into requirements and acceptance criteria for engineering, and leading launch and commercialization with cross-functional colleagues.
Ownership of the S&C MCP and AI Insights interface: Own the ongoing running and enhancement of our new S&C MCP, and accompanying AI Insights platform experience on MSCI ONE. 
Partnership with Product, data, and research experts: Work closely with product, data, and research experts to define target use cases, understand client workflows (today and in future AI-first world) and ground truth for AI products, and map the datasets, dashboards, and sources those features draw from. 
Documentation and enablement: Own and build documentation for internal training, client enablement, and ongoing feature updates, keeping it aligned with the underlying data model as datasets, factors, and dashboards evolve.
Sustainability and climate data expertise: Maintain a working understanding of MSCI's S&C datasets and the data structures and taxonomy unique to each, using that expertise to validate AI-generated outputs against methodology before they reach clients.
Distribution and delivery mechanisms: Understand how S&C data reaches its clients via API, Datafeeds, Snowflake, and platforms such as MSCI ONE, and partner with engineering on the data architecture questions that affect how MCP tools and AI Insights query and present that data, and ensure S&C data is AI-ready for consumption by client AI assistants and third-party AI connectors. Partner closely with the Product owner for S&C Data Distribution to ensure all S&C datasets are transformed to be “AI-ready” and high-performing within our AI tools. 
Senior stakeholder communication: Present product vision, roadmap, and business cases — including pricing and packaging options — to senior stakeholders for alignment and investment, and support client AI-governance and due-diligence questionnaires with Legal and Compliance.
Client-facing validation: Lead client presentations, demos, and working sessions with senior client stakeholders to validate direction and build advocacy ahead of launch, representing the voice of the client in prioritization trade-offs.
Roadmap ownership and success metrics: Own the end-to-end roadmap for AI interfaces and agent solutions, including S&C data AI-readiness, MCP, AI Insights, and agentic tools. Report adoption, quality, and business-impact metrics to leadership on a regular cadence.

Your Skills And Experience That Will Help You Excel

7+ years in product management or other related role, including ownership of AI/ML-enabled or data-distribution products — financial data, ESG/sustainability, or index/analytics experience preferred.
Solid understanding of sustainability and climate data domains (ESG ratings & scores, sustainability data, carbon emissions and climate risk metrics, etc) and comfort with complex, evolving data taxonomies.
Working knowledge of AI/LLM concepts: retrieval-augmented generation, semantic search, vector embeddings, similarity scoring, hallucination mitigation, agentic AI architectures, and MCP or comparable tool-calling protocols.
Familiarity with data distribution mechanisms — APIs, data feeds, cloud data warehouses (Snowflake), and client-facing UI platforms.
Demonstrated ability to write clear requirements for engineering and user documentation for clients.
Strong executive presence — comfortable presenting to senior internal stakeholders and high-profile client stakeholders.
Track record of excellent cross-functional collaboration across Engineering, Research, Programme Management, Legal, Client Coverage and Marketing.
Demonstrated enthusiasm and curiosity for learning about and using cutting-edge AI tools and technologies

About MSCI

Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing.
Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces.
A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results.
A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients.
Global Orientation program to kickstart your journey, followed by access to our Learning@MSCI platform, AI Learning Center , LinkedIn Learning Pro and tailored learning opportunities for ongoing skills development.
Multi-directional career paths that offer professional growth and development through new challenges, internal mobility and expanded roles.

At MSCI we are passionate about what we do, and we are inspired by our vision – to power better decisions. Apply Now
