Overview

Small businesses drive the global economy. In the US, SMBs employ 60% of the labor force and create 80% of new jobs. However, the stakes are high, as 1 in 2 businesses will fail to survive within their first five years. In an environment where time is money, precise time tracking for payroll, invoicing, and project management is the critical lever for maintaining profitability and growing the business.

Within QuickBooks, our Workforce platform fuels productivity for growing teams — from time tracking and scheduling to project management and field operations. With 30M+ employees in the QuickBooks ecosystem and 18M paid through Workforce Solutions, we are building the essential tools that empower frontline teams and help businesses turn time into money.

Opportunity

We are seeking a Staff Product Manager to lead the verticalization of QuickBooks Time. You’ll make our time tracking platform the system of record for hours, labor cost, and payroll in the industries where labor is the highest cost, starting with construction and field services. Time is the source of hours for the entire QuickBooks ecosystem. Customers use the hours their teams track to run payroll, bill for their work, and understand whether each job is making money, and the mid-market businesses we serve need all three to work together without spreadsheets or re-entry.

This is a high-ownership role. You will own three connected areas end to end: time to payroll, so approved hours, overtime, and pay items flow into QuickBooks Payroll accurately and automagically; job costing, so every hour tracked produces labor cost estimates against projects and budgets before payroll runs and accurate actuals after it; and worker time tracking across Workforce Web, Workforce Kiosk, and the Workforce mobile app, where millions of workers track their time. You will build on Time 2.0, our rebuilt time platform that now lives inside QuickBooks Online, and extend it so that serving a new industry is mostly configuration rather than new code.

We need a scrappy, customer-obsessed product leader who leads through influence. Someone who navigates dependencies across Payroll, Projects, Mid-Market, and Payments, earns the trust and confidence of our customers and accountants, and ships experiences that delight both the worker clocking in on a job site and the admin who approves time and runs payroll.




Responsibilities
* Vertical Strategy. Own the multi-year roadmap for verticalizing QuickBooks Time, starting with construction and field services. Translate how each industry runs its labor (jobs, cost codes, phases, and certified payroll on a construction site; jobs, visits, and dispatch in field services) into shared platform concepts and configurable experiences, so that each new vertical is mostly configuration rather than new code. Decide what we build, what we configure, and where partner integrations fill the gap.
* Time to Payroll. Own the flow of hours from clock-in to paycheck. Make approved time, overtime and break policies, and pay items land in QuickBooks Payroll accurately and automatically, with no exports, syncs, or re-entry, and make approvals fast and trustworthy for a mid-market company with hundreds of employees. 
* Job Costing: Estimates and Actuals. Deliver real-time labor costing that owners, project managers, and accountants trust. Partner with Projects, Payroll, and Accounting so that time is the single source of hours for payroll, invoicing, and profitability reporting.
* Worker Time Tracking. Own how workers track time across Workforce Web, Workforce Kiosk, and the Workforce mobile app, where millions of workers already track their hours. Deliver one consistent, reliable experience for clocking in and out, breaks, schedules, geofencing, and job and task selection that holds up on a job site with poor connectivity and for crews whose first language is not English, and complete the migration of workers off legacy TSheets surfaces onto the new platform.
* Commercial Impact. Own the metrics for your area: Time adoption within Workforce Premium and Elite offerings, attached in mid-market and industry editions. Plus worker engagement across web, kiosk, and mobile. Use data and customer evidence to prioritize, measure what ships, and make Time and real-time job costing a central part of how QuickBooks is sold to construction and field services customers, a market where competitors generate $150M+ ARR.
* Operational Velocity. Run the end-to-end product lifecycle for your area: write crisp requirements, pressure-test designs, manage edge cases, and drive alignment across engineering, design, data, go-to-market, and customer success teams in the US and India. You lead through influence rather than authority, and you are fluent in AI-native tools like Claude and Cursor, using them to move faster from insight to shipped product.
* Customer Empathy. Be the voice of the business owner, the payroll admin, and the frontline worker. Spend time with customers on their job sites and with the accountants who recommend HCM products to their clients, and make sure every feature removes a real pain point in how they bid, schedule, track, pay, and get paid.


Qualifications
A Product Leader. 8+ years of product management craft, including ownership of a complex, multi-team product area as a senior individual contributor. Strategic & Influential. You possess strong executive presence, translating market and customer insight into a strategy and roadmap that align senior stakeholders and technical teams. You make bold bets and bring partner teams along without direct authority.
Domain Depth. You understand how labor-intensive businesses run: how hours become payroll, how time, cost rates, and pay types become job costs, and how estimates compare to actuals. Experience with payroll, time and attendance, job costing, or construction and field service workflows is a strong advantage.
A Proven Growth Driver. You have a track record of spearheading complex initiatives that deliver measurable business growth. You understand the levers of adoption, attach, ARPC, and retention, and you use them to prioritize and to drive P&L growth.
An Ambitious Problem Solver. You proactively anticipate customer and stakeholder needs, thrive in ambiguity and turn complex, messy friction into clear roadmaps. You are scrappy and effective at managing a portfolio of bets across the lifecycle, from 0-1 innovations to products at scale. You know when to push forward and when to pivot based on evidence and stakeholder feedback.
Customer Obsessed & Analytical. You possess deep empathy for small and mid-market business operations and frontline workforce challenges. You combine this heart with rigorous analytical aptitude, storytelling with data to prioritize investments.
Technical Fluency. You demonstrate strong product judgment and comfort engaging across technical topics to build reliable web, mobile, and kiosk products on a shared platform, including APIs, data models, and integrations with payroll and accounting systems. Experience with agentic AI, payment systems, or HCM platforms is an advantage.
Education. BA or BS degree is required, and an MBA or advanced degree is preferred.

Innovate in Bengaluru

Lowe's Blue Technology Private Limited, part of Lowe's Companies, Inc., operates under the brand name Lowe's Commerce Solutions (LCS) the technology and innovation arm of Lowe’s Companies, Inc., focused on building modern retail commerce platforms and enterprise-grade solutions for retailers across the globe. jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
Here at Appian, our values of Intensity and Excellence define who we are. We set high standards and live up to them, ensuring that everything we do is done with care and quality. We approach every challenge with ambition and commitment, holding ourselves and each other accountable to achieve the best results. When you join Appian, you’ll be part of a passionate team dedicated to accomplishing hard things, together.
Own the Identity and Access Management product roadmap and deliver enterprise-grade authentication features that secure every connection between Appian and the enterprise.
ABOUT THE TEAM
The IAM Product team is on a mission to secure every identity, authentication flow, and access point that connects Appian to the enterprise. This team operates with high autonomy and directly influences how global enterprises trust and deploy AI-Powered Process Automation at scale. Your work will define how millions of users authenticate securely across mission-critical workflows.
THE OPPORTUNITY
As enterprises accelerate digital transformation, identity security has become the frontline of platform trust. This role exists because Appian is scaling its authentication and authorization capabilities to meet zero trust demands from the world's most security-conscious organizations. You will shape how the platform handles federated identity, modern protocols, and seamless user experiences in highly regulated environments.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
Lead the end-to-end IAM product roadmap, defining priorities that balance enterprise security requirements with developer and end-user experience
Partner with Engineering to evaluate, design, and enhance authentication and authorization capabilities including native authentication and support for SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM, and federated identity frameworks
Execute discovery and requirements gathering with enterprise customers to understand identity provider integrations, compliance needs, and zero trust adoption patterns
Architect product specifications and user stories that translate complex identity protocols into intuitive, scalable platform features
Drive cross-functional alignment with Security, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success to deliver authentication features that accelerate enterprise adoption
Analyze product performance metrics, customer feedback, and competitive positioning to continuously improve IAM capabilities and reduce friction in authentication flows
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field
4+ years of experience as a Technical Product Manager with a proven track record of successfully managing products that involve identity and access management
Deep experience with identity and access management, user authentication, or identity provider software in enterprise environments
Strong technical proficiency with authentication protocols including SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM, and federated identity architectures
Demonstrated ability to collaborate with engineering teams to define technical requirements and deliver secure, scalable authentication solutions
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Knowledge of zero trust architecture principles and implementation strategies
Experience working with cloud identity providers such as Okta, Azure AD, Ping Identity, or Auth0
Background in cybersecurity, compliance frameworks, or enterprise security product management
We value experience with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce or ServiceNow, as these skills translate well into our Enterprise-Grade Orchestration environment.
This role is based at our Chennai office in DLF Downtown Chennai. Appian was built on a culture of in-person collaboration, which we believe is a key driver of our mission to be the best. Employees hired for this position are expected to be in the office 5 days a week to foster that culture and ensure we continue to thrive through shared ideas and teamwork. We believe being in the office provides more opportunities to come together and celebrate working with the exceptional people across Appian. 
Tools and Resources 
Training and Development: During onboarding, we focus on equipping new hires with the skills and knowledge for success through department-specific training. Continuous learning is a central focus at Appian, with dedicated mentorship and the First-Friend program being widely utilized resources for new hires. 
Growth Opportunities: Appian provides a diverse array of growth and development opportunities, including our leadership program tailored for new and aspiring managers, a comprehensive library of specialized department training through Appian University, skills based training, and tuition reimbursement for those aiming to advance their education. This commitment ensures that employees have access to a holistic range of development opportunities.
Community: We’ll immerse you into our community rooted in respect starting on day one. Appian fosters inclusivity through our 8 employee-led affinity groups. These groups help employees build stronger internal and external networks by planning social, educational, and outreach activities to connect with Appianites and larger initiatives throughout the company.
Benefits
Appian offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and financial future. Benefits may include health coverage, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with free mental health support, life and disability insurance, an Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), a retirement/pension plan, wellness dollars, tuition reimbursement, family-forming benefits and more. Benefits vary by country—please ask your Talent Acquisition contact for details specific to the location you are applying to.
About Appian
Appian provides AI automation for the most important business processes at the world’s largest organizations. Our platform is known for its unique power, reliability, and scale. We’ve been automating processes for more than 25 years and have proven expertise in enterprise operations. For more information, visit appian.com. 
Follow Appian: LinkedIn, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, and X.

Who we are 
Verona is an authenticated matchmaking community designed exclusively for the modern, global Indian. We’re on a mission to foster fulfilling partnerships that last lifetimes. In a country
where dating app disillusionment abounds, Verona makes the matchmaking process delightful—and effective.

Verona was founded by two serial entrepreneurs Mr. Poshak Agrawal and Mr. Rahul Subramaniam, and backed by some of the biggest names in global technology, such as Mr. Michael Novogratz (ex-Fortress Investment Group, CEO of Galaxy Group Investments) & Mr. Rishi Jaitly (ex-Twitter CEO for Asia, Middle East, and Africa).

Security and Science make the basis of Verona where before matchmaking there will be Fintech-grade authentication to ensure fraud detection. Through a deep appreciation for the science of compatibility, with Verona, we will be using AI for matchmaking based on an individual’s core & shared values.

The 3 S’s of Verona - Standards, Security, and Science

Role Brief
As a Product Manager at Verona, you will be responsible for owning the end-to-end lifecycle of Verona features, from problem definition and system design to post-launch iteration. You will work closely with Engineering and Design teams to translate business requirements into detailed product logic, drive day-to-day execution, and act as the final quality gate to ensure a high-quality, data-driven user experience across the platform.

Education and Experience
Bachelor’s/ Master’s from a Tier 1 institute (preferred)
2-5 years of experience in product management or engineering roles
Experience in consumer products and analytics
Strong communication and attention to detail

Key Responsibilities
1) Feature & Systems Design
Translate business and user requirements into detailed product logic, covering user flows, system behavior, and state transitions.
Define how features behave across different states (e.g., session persistence, backgrounding, retries, cross-tab interactions).
Proactively identify and design for edge cases and failure scenarios (e.g., API failures, latency, empty states) to ensure a seamless user experience.
2) Execution & Delivery Excellence
Break down features into clear PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria that enable efficient development.
Drive day-to-day execution within the squad, ensuring clarity of scope, priorities, and timelines.
Actively unblock Design and Engineering by resolving ambiguities and making timely decisions.

Run cohort and behavioral analysis to isolate exactly where and why users face friction or abandon core workflows.
Drive V2/V3 product iterations heavily anchored in data insights, user experimentation outcomes, and business priorities.
Monitor post-launch performance, analyze funnels and drop-offs, and use data to drive iterative improvements.

About Bluevine

Bluevine is the banking platform for small businesses that need to keep moving, redefining how entrepreneurs manage their money.

We bring banking, payments, billing, and access to capital into one connected place, so business owners can move money, pay vendors, get paid, and fund what’s next without switching tools or losing time. Everything we build starts with a deep understanding of how small businesses actually run, and we keep their money secure along the way.

Since 2013, more than 1 million small business owners across all 50 states have trusted us with their money, from contractors to dental offices to e-commerce brands. Today, over 500 employees come to work focused on making banking one less thing that slows them down.

All of this comes back to our team. We’re curious problem-solvers who learn fast, would rather solve problems together, and care deeply about the people we’re building for. If you want your work to make a real difference to business owners every day, and want to keep growing while you do it, apply below.

ABOUT:

Bluevine is looking for an experienced Product Manager who will own and drive the roadmap for payments, collections, capital markets, accounting & finance for the lending business unit. The platform and systems used in this domain are mission-critical and impact the experience for our clients and serves as the backbone for internal stakeholders’ workflows.

This person will be responsible for articulating the business case for and delivering new features as well as enhancing our existing solutions, based on customer and stakeholder feedback and data driven analyses. This role will require collaboration with a broad set of technical and non- technical stakeholders, including R&D, risk and back-office operations, support, business operations, accounting and finance teams, and legal & compliance.

Monitor and maintain mission-critical systems across payments, accounting, and capital markets — ensuring data accuracy, integrating with banks and vendors, and enhancing internal operational tools for efficiency and scalability
Identify the business case for new products and enhancements through data analysis, SQL-based querying, customer feedback, and stakeholder input — prioritizing work for highest business impact
Facilitate smooth communication between R&D teams and business stakeholders, providing regular project updates, managing expectations, and proactively identifying and mitigating risks

About us
We build subscription apps for Bharat: the hundreds of millions of people in tier 2, 3 and 4 India who pay by UPI and live on their phones. Our apps include BhaktiLok (daily devotion, aartis, AI palm and face reading), MeraTune (ringtones with your own name in them), CashAlert (voice alerts for UPI payments) and HeyBuddy (voice lock and assistant).
We are a small team that ships fast. An idea on Monday is usually a live test by Friday, and the numbers decide who was right.

The role
You will own the path from install to paid subscriber on one or more of our apps: onboarding, paywall, trial, autopay and retention. You work directly with the founders, engineers, designers and the ads team, and you get real ownership from week one — this is a backfill role, so you'll be stepping into live funnels and running experiments from day one, not easing in slowly.
This is a junior role (6 months to 2 years of experience). We care more about how you think and how fast you learn than about your title so far.

What you'll do
• Run experiments on onboarding, paywalls, pricing and trials, from hypothesis to result, and call the winner with data.
• Live in Mixpanel: build funnels, spot where users drop, and turn that into the next test.
• Track the subscription numbers that matter: login to trial, trial to paid, autopay success, renewals and churn.
• Write short, clear PRDs and work with engineers and designers to ship them quickly.
• Tear down competitor apps and bring back what is worth testing.
• Work with the ads team so the promise in the ad matches the first screen of the app.
• Shape features around how our users actually behave: regional languages, low-end Android phones, UPI autopay habits.
• Use AI tools every day to move faster on research, specs, copy and analysis.

Who we're looking for
You should have
• A feel for consumer apps in India, especially subscription, UPI autopay or content apps for the next billion users.
• Comfort with numbers. You can read a funnel, question it, and explain what it means in two lines.
• Clear writing in English and good spoken Hindi. You should be able to think like a user in Patna as easily as one in Pune.
• A bias to ship. You would rather run a rough test this week than a perfect one next month.
• Curiosity. You install apps just to see how their paywall works.
Good to have
• Hands-on time with Mixpanel, Firebase or a similar analytics tool.
• Hands-on experience with UPI AutoPay, mandate flows, recurring billing, or payment retry/dunning logic — big plus given our autopay and D2C payments work.
• Exposure to paywalls, pricing tests, payment gateways (Razorpay, Juspay, etc.) or Meta ads.
• Experience in devotional, astrology, utility or entertainment apps.
• A side project, app, page or channel you grew yourself.

Why you'll like it here
Real ownership. Your tests go live to real users, and you see the result in days.
Grow with us. This is an immediate backfill with real scope from day one — if you own it well, there's a clear path from Associate PM to PM as the product and team grow.
Learn the full stack of a subscription business. Product, pricing, payments, ads and analytics, all in one seat.

Description

Trust depends on two things being true at once: that every piece of customer data is governed, controlled, and provably compliant, and that the organization can move fast enough to keep up as products become agentic and ambient. TCI's AI Enablement & Data Governance charter owns both. On the data side, we make data classification, handling, and retention enforceable and provable rather than asserted. On the enablement side, we build the AI-driven automation and internal products that take operational load off the whole organization, so builders spend their time creating trust instead of maintaining it by hand.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager - Technical to own the product vision and roadmap for this work. You will define the internal products, paved paths, and automation that make data governance provable and that measurably reduce operational burden across every charter. You will translate a broad, ambiguous mandate into a clear product strategy, decide what to build and in what order, and turn it into shipped capabilities that other teams adopt because they are genuinely better and faster. This is a technical product role: you will operate close to data systems, enforcement mechanisms, and AI automation, and you will be expected to reason about the architecture and trade-offs, not just the surface. You will work across engineering, science, product, privacy, and legal, and you will influence teams beyond your own to adopt the standards you set.

Key job responsibilities

Own the product vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for the charter's data governance and AI enablement products.
Define the internal products and paved paths that make data classification, handling enforcement, and retention provable, and make adopting them the easy default for other teams.
Own the product direction for AI-driven automation that reduces operational burden across charters, and define how its impact on capacity is measured.
Write the narratives and requirements that align leadership and partner teams, and represent the charter in cross-organization reviews.
Partner with engineering and science to make build-versus-adopt and automation trade-offs, and to hold governance and compliance guarantees as product requirements rather than afterthoughts.
Prioritize ruthlessly across a broad surface, balancing compliance obligations, operational-efficiency gains, and partner-team needs.
Define and track the metrics that prove governance is enforceable and that automation is actually returning capacity, and use them to steer the roadmap.
Partner with privacy and legal to translate obligations into product requirements that builders can adopt by configuration.
Influence and align teams beyond your own to build to the standards and paved paths you define.

Trust CX Innovations is a strategic innovation team within Amazon Devices & Services that focuses on advancing AI technology while prioritizing customer trust and experience. Our team operates at the intersection of artificial intelligence, privacy engineering, and customer-centric design.

To pioneer trustworthy AI innovations that delight customers while setting new standards for privacy and responsible technology development. We aim to transform how Amazon builds AI products by creating solutions that balance innovation with customer trust.

Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product

Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

Experience delivering large, cross-functional, customer facing products

Experience analyzing data to make business decisions

About Us Pluang is Indonesia's leading multi-asset investment platform, offering diverse products such as Crypto, US Stocks, Indonesian Stocks, US Options, Mutual Funds, and Gold. With a mission to become the primary money app for Indonesians, we provide a seamless, innovative, and secure experience to empower millions of Indonesians to achieve financial independence. We are an AI-native fintech. We build AI into our products, and every team uses AI in its daily work. Backed by $110M+ in funding from global investors like Accel and Openspace Ventures, we are one of Indonesia's fastest-growing fintechs.
We're hiring a Product Manager - Platform based in Gurgaon to own and build cutting-edge, AI-powered trading tools, optimize onboarding processes, and enhance user experience. This role is an opportunity to work closely with cross-functional teams, shape product strategy, and solve meaningful problems in the fast-evolving world of digital finance. Join Pluang and play a part in shaping the future of investing in Indonesia.

What You Will Do As the Product Manager - Platform, you will work on the following initiatives and more:


Trading Platform Product Development
  • Own the roadmap for the core trading experience, including the trade page, order placement, charts and portfolio, and make it simple to use across every asset class.
  • Work closely with engineers to build scalable features that work across crypto, US stocks, Indonesian stocks, gold and mutual funds.
Onboarding Optimization
  • Own user onboarding and KYC journeys, reducing friction while maintaining security.
  • Partner with teams to streamline onboarding processes while improving user experience.
  • Optimize identity verification, automated approvals, and authentication mechanisms.
Trading Tools, Salesforce Chatbot Enhancements
  • Build and improve trading tools such as Signals, Screeners, price alerts and Auto Invest, along with market insights.
  • Improve charting features, order types, and portfolio tracking for traders.
  • Work on Salesforce integrations to improve customer relationship management and automate workflows.
  • Build and improve the admin panel and internal tools that our operations, compliance and support teams use every day, and remove manual work and errors from their jobs.
  • Improve the chatbot to optimize customer support and user engagement.
  • Build AI products that change how Indonesians trade, from Aura, our AI assistant that gives every user personalised insights and trade recommendations, to our MCP server, which lets users research and trade on Pluang from AI agents like Claude.
Data-Driven Product Enhancements
  • Analyze market trends, user behavior, and platform performance to inform product decisions.
  • Run A/B tests, gather trader feedback, and iterate on key platform features.
  • Own and improve KPIs such as install-to-first-trade conversion, KYC approval rate, 30-day activation, feature adoption, and retention.
Compliance, Security Risk Management
  • Work with the Compliance team to make sure features meet Indonesian regulations from OJK and CFX.
  • Collaborate with security teams to protect user data and transactions.
  • Work with legal teams to ensure compliance with financial regulations.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Partner with engineering, data, compliance, and UX teams to drive execution.
  • Engage with traders and users to help refine product offerings.
  • Collaborate with marketing teams to support adoption and user growth.


What We're Looking For We're seeking a passionate and driven product manager who thrives in fast-paced, innovative environments. The ideal candidate will have: Relevant product management experience


  • 2-4 years of experience in Product Management.
  • Prior experience with trading platforms, fintech, or financial services is preferred.
  • Being an active investor or trader yourself is a strong plus, and can make up for no fintech experience.
Strong problem-solving and execution skills
  • Ability to work through ambiguity, navigate challenges, and drive projects to completion.
  • A bias for action and a willingness to push boundaries to achieve ambitious goals.
  • Ability to balance structured thinking with hands-on execution.
  • A habit of owning outcomes. You pick up problems nobody assigned to you and follow each launch through to its results.
Strong collaboration abilities
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills to work effectively with stakeholders.
  • Clear written communication, including PRDs that engineers can build from without a follow-up meeting.
Analytical and data-driven mindset
  • Ability to use data to prioritize initiatives, solve problems, and optimize user experiences.
  • Hands-on with analytics tools such as Mixpanel or SQL, so you can pull and read data yourself.
AI-native way of working
  • You use AI tools like Claude every day to research, write PRDs, analyse data and build quick prototypes.
  • You spot where AI can make the product better for users, and you push to build it.
Curiosity and adaptability
  • A growth mindset and eagerness to learn about emerging technologies and market trends.
  • Openness to experimenting and iterating to create innovative products.
Passion for investing and empowering investors
  • A strong belief in Pluang's mission to make investing accessible, rewarding, and impactful for all Indonesians.
Why Should You Join Us
Pluang Offers:
  • The chance to build AI products that real investors use every day, from personalised insights in Aura to trading on Pluang from AI agents like Claude through our MCP.
  • Real ownership early. You own a part of the Pluang app from your first quarter and see your work

jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
About the company

Openprovider is an ICANN-accredited domain registrar and technology company founded in 2004 in Rotterdam, Netherlands.

We are a fully-remote organization with more than 90 team members spread across 20+ countries.

A diverse and inclusive organization, we support a healthy work/life balance and are constantly looking for new ways to help the well-being of our people. We support a flexible schedule and are 100% performance and result-oriented.

At Openprovider, we're not just a company; we're a mission-driven team dedicated to transforming the domain industry. We believe in providing a trusted digital identity to every business.

Our innovative approach is reshaping the industry from a traditional transactional model to a more customer-centric, subscription-based approach. We pay subscriptions for music, newspapers, and movies - why should domains be any different?

Our vision is to build a place where curious, self-driven people do their best work together, to deliver on our mission: a reliable, free, and secure online world for every customer we serve. Our world is changing fast, especially with AI, and we see that as an opportunity to stay ahead of change, shape it and create more value for our customers.

Our values

Be a wolf, not a sheep: we value the entrepreneurial spirit in everyone.
Knowledge equals power: we are constantly hungry to learn, for ourselves and our customers.
Enjoy what you do and do what you enjoy: we want work to be something you look forward to.
Quality results in quantity: we care about excellence and attention to detail.
TEAM, Together everyone achieves more: collaboration is how we get our best results.
Come join us on our journey to create a trusted digital world.

About the role

In this role, you’ll build a profitable and sustainable products business alongside our domains portfolio. Your scope will include SSL certificates, Email and Plesk as commercial product lines, as well as the RCP (reseller control panel) journeys that enable our resellers to purchase, provision, manage and renew these products.

You’ll be accountable for their financial performance and quality, while managing supplier partnerships to keep our offering competitive and future-proof. The role reports to the Director of Product.

Key responsibilities

Own the SSL, Email and Plesk portfolio and P&L: positioning, assortment, pricing proposals (with Pricing and Finance), margin and lifecycle decisions from launch to sunset.

Own supplier partnerships with Certificate Authorities, our email platform provider and Plesk/WebPros: contracts, volume tiers, rebates, SLAs, roadmap alignment and escalations.

Grow adoption across our reseller base through cross-sell with domains and hosting, bundles, purchase journey placement and launches with Sales and Marketing.

Run product initiatives as structured projects, including supplier integrations, API changes and compliance changes such as CA/B Forum rules.

Shape the product roadmap with a commercial lens and partner with Engineering on delivery.

Track results against clear targets: margin and revenue per product line, attach and renewal rates, and on-time delivery of milestones and roadmap items.

What we are looking for

Competences

Hosting & Security Products Knowledge: Solid understanding of SSL/TLS certificates (DV/OV/EV, validation, CA/B Forum requirements and lifecycle changes), email hosting and anti-spam, and Plesk licensing and hosting control panels.

Supplier & Vendor Management: Negotiates commercial terms, volume tiers, rebates and SLAs; runs business reviews; manages supplier performance, dependency and contract risk.

Commercial & P&L Acumen: Builds business cases; understands pricing, margin, unit economics, cannibalisation and reseller incentive models.

Product Strategy & Roadmapping: Translates strategy into operational roadmaps for the RCP and the SSL, email and Plesk product lines.

Project & Programme Management: Plans and delivers multi-party projects with Engineering and suppliers: scope, milestones, dependencies, risk logs and stakeholder updates, within a strong Agile/EOS rhythm.

Data & Funnel Analytics: Instruments and analyses order, provisioning and renewal journeys; separates price effects from product effects.

AI Proficiency: Embeds AI tools across daily work - discovery, documentation, analysis, supplier communication and GTM.

How we work at Openprovider

Self-management: you own your time, priorities and results, and raise issues early.

Learning Agility and AI Literacy: you learn fast and use AI with confidence and good judgement.

Adaptive Innovation Mindset: you see change as a chance to improve and help others move forward positively.

Quality Orientation: you take pride in your work, test assumptions with facts and deliver results others can rely on.

Customer Focus: you understand who your work serves, including our resellers, and make decisions that create real value for them.

What we offer

100% remote work (you can work from any location, no need to go to the office);

Paid time off and sick leave;

International team and regular online and offline events to stay connected;

Internal workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions;

Quarterly review and annual salary review;

Flexible working hours;

We are an ISO 27001-certified remote workplace;

Meaningful work with real ownership and room to stretch beyond your comfort zone;

Courses in the Openprovider Academy, a structured onboarding path and a clear Career Framework to manage your own growth;

A Virtual Office that makes it easy to connect with colleagues, wherever you are.

Openprovider is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome all qualified candidates to apply.

About us

Most resellers spend too much money and time on domains. With Openprovider and our Membership program, you can buy, renew, and transfer domains at cost price on one platform to become a more successful and profitable reseller.

We are a rapidly-growing, ICANN-accredited domain registrar and technology scale-up founded in 2004 in Rotterdam, the Netherlands. We understand the frustrations of wasting hours searching for new domains at fair prices; being hit by unexpected renewal costs after the first year; and losing customers because you can’t offer attractive bundles.

That’s why we built a platform to easily manage operations for over 1,900 domain extensions. We were the first to offer a Membership Program to get the domains you need at cost price, and we've been helping clients sell millions of domains for more than 20 years.

We have been fully remote since 2020, and our team has only expanded since then. Our team currently consists of 90+ employees, who are spread across 20+ different countries and 4 different continents. We are proud of our fun and diverse team and regularly connect with each other through online and offline events.

About ePS Packaging

At ePS Packaging, we’re shaping the future of packaging through technology. As a global leader in industry-specific business and production software, we help packaging companies streamline operations, boost efficiency, and unlock growth.

With over 30 years of experience, a global footprint, and a deep understanding of the packaging industry, we believe one thing above all: our success grows when our customers thrive.

Core responsibilities:

The Product Owner is the execution arm of the product team and is accountable for translating product direction, roadmap initiatives, and customer needs into clearly defined, prioritised, and deliverable work for Agile development teams. The role owns the product backlog and sprint-level execution, ensuring that development teams understand what needs to be built, why it matters, and how successful delivery will be validated.

Core responsibilities:

Product Backlog and Prioritization

Own, maintain, groom, and prioritise the product backlog, ensuring alignment with product goals, customer needs, business value, and delivery dependencies.
Lead backlog refinement and ensure items are clearly defined, appropriately sized, prioritised, and ready for development.
Assess feature requests, enhancements, defects, and competing demands; recommend sequencing and trade-offs in collaboration with the Product Manager.

Requirements and User Stories

Translate roadmap initiatives and customer or business needs into epics, user stories, workflows, business rules, and clear acceptance criteria.
Break down complex initiatives into manageable increments that can be delivered and validated through Agile sprints.
Clarify functional behaviour, use cases, edge cases, and dependencies for Engineering and QA.
Review completed work against acceptance criteria and confirm whether the agreed requirements have been met.

Agile Delivery and Team Enablement

Work as the product domain expert and primary point of contact for the development team on backlog scope and requirement clarification.
Participate actively in sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and other relevant Agile ceremonies; support the team in maintaining sprint-level momentum.
Monitor sprint goals, backlog readiness, scope changes, and cross-team dependencies, escalating risks through the appropriate channels.
Partner with Engineering and QA to support feature validation, quality, and delivery against agreed priorities.

Customer and Stakeholder Collaboration

Work with Product Managers and relevant customer-facing teams to understand customer feedback and translate it into actionable product backlog items.
Drive early feedback on new features and incorporate validated insights into backlog refinement and prioritization.
Communicate priorities, scope decisions, requirement changes, and delivery expectations clearly to cross-functional stakeholders.
Build alignment where stakeholders have competing needs, using product priorities and customer value to guide recommendations.

Continuous Improvement and Senior-Level Contribution

Identify opportunities to improve story quality, backlog health, team collaboration, and product delivery practices.
Use delivery and quality feedback to identify recurring requirement gaps, reduce avoidable rework, and improve sprint readiness.
Share product domain knowledge and provide guidance or mentorship to less experienced Product Owners and team members, where applicable.

Role Focus and Responsibility Boundaries

Maintain focus on product backlog ownership, requirement clarity, and sprint-level product execution in alignment with the Product Manager/CPO.
Tier 2 support and technical triage are owned by Support/DevOps teams; project management and Scrum Master responsibilities by Delivery roles; customer demos and training by Enablement/Presales; and code contribution by Development teams.
Other duties as assigned.

Required experience and skills:

8+ years of experience in Product Ownership, product delivery, software product development, or a closely related role, with substantial hands-on Product Owner experience.
Mandatory: Relevant experience in the Packaging industry/domain, with specific exposure to CLF (Cartons, Labels & Flexibles). Understanding of packaging workflows, products, and industry-specific business processes is strongly preferred.
Demonstrated experience owning and prioritizing product backlogs for software products, ideally within a global SaaS or enterprise software environment.
Strong capability in writing epics and detailed user stories, defining measurable acceptance criteria, and translating customer needs and roadmap initiatives into development-ready work.
Proven experience working with Agile/Scrum development teams and contributing effectively to sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
Ability to prioritize competing requirements by considering customer impact, business value, product priorities, effort, and dependencies.
Experience working closely with Product Managers, developers, QA, Support, Implementation, and other cross-functional stakeholders.
Strong understanding of software development lifecycle, Agile delivery practices, and product quality/acceptance processes.
Ability to act as a domain expert for delivery teams, resolve requirement ambiguity, facilitate decisions, and communicate scope and priority changes effectively.
Experience with JIRA and familiarity with Confluence, Agile boards, backlog tools, and customer feedback tools.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, organization, and stakeholder-management skills.
Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, globally distributed SaaS business.
Experience mentoring colleagues or improving product ownership practices is an advantage.
Business-level English proficiency (written and verbal) required.

Why Join ePS

At ePS, you’ll be part of a global, collaborative, and forward-thinking team that’s redefining what’s possible in the packaging industry. We foster an inclusive workplace where diversity drives innovation and every team member’s voice is valued. You’ll have the opportunity to make a real impact, helping our customers operate smarter and succeed sustainably.

Join us and help build the future of packaging technology.

This is a growth-stage product operator role, not a 0-to-1 role. Webnyay has a mature product, established enterprise customers, live deployments, and meaningful transaction volumes across dispute resolution and grievance redressal.

Our platform powers complex workflows across arbitration, mediation, online dispute resolution, and BFSI grievance management. The product is live, the customers are real, and the operational challenges are substantial.

Your job is to grow it — through better, faster, and more scalable versions of what works, while building new capabilities that expand what our customers can do with Webnyay.

You should be comfortable working with complex workflows, demanding enterprise customers, and engineering teams. You should be equally comfortable understanding a legal or operational problem, translating it into a product requirement, and driving it all the way to deployment.

You'll Own

* *Product roadmap:* Owning and driving the roadmap across Webnyay's ODR, arbitration, mediation, BFSI dispute resolution, and grievance redressal products.
* *New feature development:* Identifying high-leverage opportunities from customer feedback, operational bottlenecks, and market requirements. Scoping and shipping capabilities that improve product value and expand our addressable market.
* *Backlog prioritisation:* Turning hundreds of customer requests, change requests, bug reports, and internal ideas into a coherent, prioritised shipping plan. Knowing what to build, what to defer, and what to push back on.

Former Ivy League and Top 20 admissions officers to rigorously review and refine applications

Professors and PhD teaching fellows from leading universities to guide students through original, independent research — with pathways to selective peer-reviewed publication or conference presentation

Past ISEF winners and judges who coach students to compete for state, national, and international science fair awards

Capstone project mentors who help students design and scale leadership initiatives with real-world impact, measurable outcomes, and credible external validation

We’re backed by leading VC firms, including Tiger Global, Heal Partners, IceHouse Ventures, and Movac, and recently closed a USD $40M Series D funding round at a USD $640M valuation. We now operate across 21 markets worldwide, including the US, Canada, UK, Singapore, Japan, Hong Kong, Australia, and New Zealand.

The Role:

We’re looking for a product manager who thinks in systems, not features. Our team — including product admins and student success managers — handles a large and growing workload, and much of it is still manual: watching customer Slack channels, cross-referencing Google Sheets, catching escalations late, onboarding our students etc. Your job is to design the product and infrastructure that takes that load off people so they can focus on the work that actually matters.

You’ll own the full picture: how the dashboard and interface fit together, how information flows between systems, and where AI can quietly do the heavy lifting. The bar is simple — every feature you ship should make someone’s day easier, never add cognitive load.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is product-minded with a real technical sense. Not a pure PM who hands off specs, and not a pure developer — someone who can talk to a user, sketch the flow in Figma, build a working prototype in Dify or n8n, and judge whether the result is genuinely good to use.

What you’ll do

Own the end-to-end experience. Design the dashboard and interface as a coherent whole, not a collection of features. Understand how each screen, workflow, and data point connects, and keep the system simple as it grows.

Design for real users under real load. Observe how team members work, find friction and repetitive effort, and design flows that streamline high-volume work. UX quality is a core deliverable, not a finishing touch.

Use AI to remove work, not create it. Identify where LLMs, RAG, and automation can take tasks off people’s plates — triage, summarization, flagging, routing, follow-ups — and design those capabilities so they feel invisible and trustworthy.

Build a unified view of the customer journey. Integrate conversations from customer Slack channels with our core applications and Google Sheets so the team sees one picture instead of many.

Make service proactive. Build systems that automatically flag and triage customer escalations before they become critical, and that help student success managers identify at-risk clients and trigger timely, automated follow-ups.

Prototype and verify quickly. Use Dify.AI to build LLM-powered prototypes, implement RAG, and iterate on prompts; use n8n to orchestrate automated workflows across third-party apps and APIs. Validate ideas with working prototypes before committing engineering time.

Lead AI product design. Prompt engineering, model selection and configuration, interaction design for AI features, and an evaluation framework that tells us whether an AI feature is actually working.

Run on data. Monitor product and AI-effect metrics, analyze user behavior, identify pain points, and drive continuous iteration.

Stay current. Track developments in AI tooling (Dify, n8n, Coze, and others), analyze competitors, and bring what’s useful back into our product.

Shape the roadmap. Contribute to short-term product planning and offer well-reasoned input on product strategy and technical direction.

What we’re looking for

2–5 years of product management experience, including 1–3 years designing AI-powered products.

Strong UI/UX judgment. You understand information architecture, interaction design, and how to design for people doing high-volume work. You can tell the difference between “has the feature” and “is pleasant to use,” and you care about the difference. Proficient with Figma, Axure, or similar.

Solid AI product fundamentals. Deep understanding of how LLM applications work; practical experience with prompt engineering and RAG; able to independently design, evaluate, and optimize an AI feature and balance technical feasibility against user experience.

Hands-on with AI tooling. Real-world experience with Dify.AI, n8n, or comparable platforms — you build, not just specify.

Technical fluency. Comfortable working closely with engineering and AI teams, understanding the principles and limitations of the technology, and helping get solutions shipped.

Systems thinking. You see how pieces connect and design for the whole, not the part in front of you.

Exceptional communication. Much of this role is talking to people, understanding their core needs, and finding a solution that works for everyone. Fluent English (spoken and written) and a talent for making complex things simple.

Independent drive. Disciplined, self-motivated, and able to deliver high-quality work in a remote environment without micromanagement. Strong sense of ownership.

Why work for Crimson?

Rapidly growing start up, with a flexible working environment where you will be empowered to structure how you work

Limitless development and exposure - our internal promotions/role changes made up 33% of all recruitment last year

$1000 individual training budget per year, we love to ‘Level Up’ (it’s one of our core values)!

Psychologist on staff

Insightful fireside chats and workshops to help support our high-performing and ambitious team

Radical Candor is a feedback approach we live by

We’re a global player with 28 markets (and growing) across the globe. Most roles have the option to work from one of our many offices or remotely!

If you're passionate about growing in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and want to work with cutting-edge technology, then we'd love to hear from you!

Who We Are
Techdome is a product engineering company that helps enterprises move from “we should use AI” to AI running reliably in production. The Opportunity
A GenAI demo is easy to build. A GenAI product that passes a security audit, stays within budget, keeps cost per query under control, and earns the trust of its users is not.
We’re hiring a Product Manager who wants to own that second problem. You’ll take products from the first client conversation through launch and growth, and you’ll be the one who catches the fuzzy requirement, the dropped handoff, or the hidden risk while it’s still cheap to fix.

Define the product
Turn a client’s raw idea into a clear product definition with realistic scope, milestones, timelines, and budgets.
Learn each client’s industry, regulations, and compliance needs, and translate them into requirements engineers can build from without guessing.
Get GenAI into production
Work with ML engineers to turn LLM, RAG, agent, and automation prototypes into reliable, scalable, and safe systems.
Set and monitor the production metrics that matter: accuracy, latency, evaluation scores, and cost per query.
Ensure every AI feature integrates with client systems through APIs and meets enterprise standards for security, data privacy, and uptime.
Align the team

Plan capacity and hold all parties to their commitments.

PMP, PRINCE2, CSM, CSPO, or an AI/cloud certification.

Forward Deployed Domain Practitioners (FDDPs) – Healthcare Domain

Converge for Healthcare | Deloitte Consulting

About the Role

The Team

This role sits within Converge for Healthcare, Deloitte's industry-focused asset studio for healthcare, part of Deloitte Consulting's Innovation & Delivery Transformation (I&DT) practice. I&DT brings an engineering- and innovation-led mindset to how Deloitte builds, delivers, and scales technology-enabled solutions.

Data Studio is Converge for Healthcare's foundational platform—combining agentic AI and analytics capabilities atop a unified healthcare data foundation to turn healthcare data into decision-ready insight and automated action across the Converge for Healthcare product portfolio.

Forward Deployed Domain Practitioners are the business and domain half of Converge for Healthcare's Forward Deployed model. Where Product Forward Deployed Engineers (pFDEs) cover product and technology, FDDPs cover business and domain—partnering with pFDEs, client account teams, and product teams to define the real client problem, prove measurable value, and identify where the platform can deliver more, feeding real-world domain learnings back into the platform roadmap.

Position Summary

As a Forward Deployed Domain Practitioner within Converge for Healthcare, you will work directly with clients, Deloitte Consulting's broader Health Care consulting practice, and Converge Health's product and engineering teams. Paired with a pFDE on each engagement, you'll bring the client-domain fluency that shapes what gets built on Data Studio and why—defining the business problem and success criteria, aligning client stakeholders on what value means, and translating real operational workflows into the requirements, rules, and edge cases the pFDE builds against.

This is a domain-led, business-facing role grounded in production reality rather than abstract requirements. You'll work alongside real users, real workflows, and real data, on engagements that are scoped, time-boxed, and exit-oriented—leaving behind documented domain artifacts and reusable patterns so that each deployment makes the next one materially faster.

The role draws on healthcare breadth rather than a single specialty, spanning provider and payer domains—from revenue cycle, utilization management, and clinical operations to network strategy, risk adjustment, actuarial, and beyond.

Key Responsibilities

Work You'll Do

• Presales & opportunity shaping: Partner with Health Care consulting teams, account teams, and pFDEs during the sales cycle—leading business discovery, mapping current-state workflows, and building the value hypothesis and business case, while the pFDE leads technical discovery and demonstrations, to qualify client needs into Product fit or out to Services as custom scope.

• Business problem definition & success criteria: Frame each use case around a concrete operational problem, establish baseline performance, and define measurable outcomes the client and Deloitte agree on (e.g., denial rates, days in A/R, prior authorization turnaround, coding accuracy, care-gap closure).

• Domain-to-build translation: Translate business needs into the workflow logic, decision rules, policy references, exceptions, and acceptance criteria the pFDE builds against—and contribute domain-accurate, labelled test cases to the use case's evaluation set so agent outputs are judged against how the work is actually done.

• Use case discovery beyond the original ask: Surface adjacent, domain-specific use cases grounded in what you observe in the client's workflows and data, size their value, and route them through engagement governance and the product roadmap—never through informal commitments on features or timelines.

• Stakeholder alignment & adoption: Build alignment among client executives, operational leaders, and front-line users on what value means for the engagement, and lead the process change, training, and adoption activities that turn a working capability into one people actually use.

• Value realization & measurement: Stay engaged post-launch to track outcomes against the agreed baseline, diagnose where value is or isn't landing, and develop the evidence and client value stories that support adoption, renewal, and platform growth.

• Field-to-product feedback & reusable domain assets: Capture recurring domain patterns, workflow variations, and policy or regulatory shifts, translate them into concrete use-case and capability requests for Product Managers, and codify them into reusable domain playbooks, value frameworks, and use-case definitions for the next client.

Qualifications

Required

• 8+ years of experience in healthcare consulting, provider or payer operations, or a domain-specialist role in healthcare technology

• 4+ years of client-facing experience leading business discovery, process redesign, or business case development

• Comfortable client-facing, including product demos and discovery with senior stakeholders

• Based in India, able to work virtually with US stakeholders on US-market direction and its nuances

Preferred

• Master's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business, Public Health, Health Informatics, Nursing or another clinical discipline, such as an MBA, MHA, or MPH, or another relevant advanced degree

• Relevant professional credentials (e.g., HFMA CRCR or CHFP, AAPC or AHIMA coding certifications, clinical licensure such as RN, or SOA actuarial credentials)

• Experience with AI, automation, or advanced analytics implementations in a healthcare setting

• Experience in product- or platform-based delivery models, as distinct from purely services-based delivery

Core Competencies

• Domain-first profile—deep healthcare business and operational expertise paired with enough technical fluency to partner credibly with engineers on agentic AI and data solutions

• Strong healthcare domain knowledge spanning provider and/or payer domains—such as revenue cycle, utilization management, care management, clinical operations, network strategy, risk adjustment, or actuarial—with the versatility to apply it across multiple areas rather than a single specialty

• Proven ability to diagnose operational workflows, quantify improvement opportunities, and build credible business cases and ROI models that client executives act on

• Practical understanding of what agentic AI can and cannot do reliably—human-in-the-loop design, accuracy-versus-automation trade-offs, and how to judge agent outputs for domain correctness—without needing to write code

• Working knowledge of healthcare data and data standards (e.g., claims, remittances, EMR data, X12 EDI, HL7, FHIR) at a business level—what the data means, where it breaks, and how data quality affects business outcomes

• Fluency in the regulatory and policy landscape that shapes healthcare workflows—such as CMS rules, payer medical and reimbursement policies, coding standards (ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS), prior authorization requirements, and HIPAA

• Strong requirements and process skills—process mapping, decision tables, use-case definition, and acceptance criteria that engineers can build and test against

• Judgment to size each engagement—recognizing when a client problem maps to a proven use case, when it needs meaningful extension, and when it is custom scope better served by Services

• Commercial instinct grounded in client value—spotting where the platform can do more for a client and framing it in outcome terms, while respecting engagement governance and the product roadmap

• Change management and adoption experience, including redesigning roles and workflows around automation and bringing front-line teams along

• Intellectual curiosity about how AI is changing the way healthcare work gets done, and a strong pull toward rethinking workflows rather than automating them as they are

DESCRIPTION

Are you passionate about building innovative, customer facing analytics products that help businesses make smarter purchasing decisions? Do you enjoy solving complex customer problems at scale using data, analytics, and artificial intelligence? Are you excited about shaping how organizations of all sizes understand, manage, and optimize their business spending?

Amazon Business is transforming how businesses, governments, and organizations purchase products and manage procurement operations. Serving millions of business customers worldwide, Amazon Business combines the selection, convenience, and value of Amazon with capabilities tailored to the unique needs of business customers.

Amazon Business Analytics (ABA) plays a critical role in this transformation by building a suite of customer facing analytics products that help organizations turn purchasing data into actionable insights. Our customers range from small and medium businesses to large enterprises and public sector organizations. Our products empower procurement leaders, finance teams, and business administrators to understand organizational spending, identify savings opportunities, monitor purchasing behavior, and make informed business decisions.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager, Technical (PMT) to help shape and deliver the next generation of Amazon Business Analytics experiences. In this role, you will drive product strategy and execution across our customer facing analytics portfolio, spanning spend visibility, self service reporting, intelligent insights, and AI powered conversational analytics. You will build intuitive and scalable products for the full range of business customers, from those seeking simple, out of the box spending insights to large enterprises requiring sophisticated analytics across complex organizational structures.

You will have the opportunity to reimagine how business customers interact with their purchasing data, moving beyond traditional dashboards and reports toward intelligent, proactive, and conversational experiences. You will use advances in generative AI, large language models, and modern data technologies to make analytics more accessible, personalized, and actionable for customers worldwide.

This is a highly visible role that requires strong customer obsession, technical judgment, strategic thinking, and the ability to influence and deliver across multiple engineering and business organizations. The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, dives deep into customer and technical challenges, and has a demonstrated track record of building and scaling customer facing technology products.

We are open to hiring candidates to work from the following locations: Hyderabad, IND | Bangalore, IND

Key job responsibilities
As the PMT for ABA, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for customer facing analytics capabilities across Amazon Business. You will develop a deep understanding of how small businesses, large enterprises, procurement professionals, and finance teams use purchasing data, and turn those needs into intuitive, scalable, and differentiated product experiences.

You will lead the development of intelligent analytics experiences, including conversational interfaces, natural language querying, proactive insights, and AI powered capabilities. You will also build products that help customers analyze organizational spending, identify savings opportunities, and improve procurement outcomes. You will balance ease of use for smaller businesses with the depth that large enterprises require, and develop capabilities that serve customers across multiple geographies.

You will partner closely with engineering, applied science, UX, and data teams to define product requirements, evaluate architectural tradeoffs, and deliver scalable, reliable analytics solutions. You will define success metrics and use customer feedback, experimentation, and data to keep improving outcomes. Finally, you will collaborate with senior leaders across Amazon Business to align priorities and drive decisions.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

- Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Role Summary
The most senior individual-contributor product management role, responsible for the strategic direction, development, and business of a major service or a portfolio of services used by customers ranging from single engineers to large enterprises. Principal PMT-ES Product Managers are trusted members of organizational leadership who define 3–5 year vision and roadmaps, own pricing and go-to-market strategy, and are typically assigned where the business opportunity or technology strategy is not yet defined. They operate with complete independence as single-threaded owners, influence customer and internal engineering roadmaps, and may own P&L.

Key Responsibilities
Own the strategic direction (business and technology), development, and business aspects of a major service or a portfolio of services used by a wide spectrum of customers, from startups to enterprises, typically working with multiple engineering teams

Define the strategic vision and long-term roadmap for strategic service initiatives, and drive teams to execute on it across business verticals and market segments
Own positioning, go-to-market strategy, and pricing strategy; may own product marketing strategy (branding, promotions, deals) and Profit/Loss (P/L)
Own end-to-end service experience: customer engagement, PR/FAQ and requirements definition, CX design, compliance, feature priority, messaging, and reliability
Identify opportunities to accelerate customer business success, and anticipate customers’ future growth, turning those signals into viable long-term business opportunities

Distinguish between one-way and two-way doors, take smart risks, and make it safe for design and technology teams to experiment
Ask the hard questions (Where do we need to invent? Should this product continue to exist?)
Drive joint or cross-organization launches and strategic partnerships across multiple services; influence engineering roadmaps and priorities, internally and externally

Team Leadership: Lead, mentor and develop Product Managers, fostering a culture of accountability, customer-centricity, innovation and strong execution.

12+ years of overall experience, with at least 8–10 years in Product Management and 2–3+ years in a Director, Senior Product Manager, Head of Product or equivalent leadership capacity.

Strong experience building and scaling B2B SaaS / Enterprise SaaS products, preferably in the industrial technology or manufacturing software ecosystem.
Proven experience owning product strategy, roadmap and end-to-end product lifecycle for enterprise software products.
Strong understanding of manufacturing and industrial workflows, including production operations, plant maintenance, asset management, work order management, reliability engineering or frontline workforce processes.
Experience working with enterprise customers in manufacturing, chemicals, oil & gas, energy, mining, utilities or other asset-intensive industries.

Strong analytical skills with experience defining product metrics, tracking adoption and using data to drive product decisions.

Enterprise Asset Management (EAM)
Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS)
Industrial IoT (IIoT) and Connected Worker Platforms
Manufacturing Operations Management (MOM)

Industrial Workflow Automation and Digital Transformation Platforms

Delivering training sessions, and product demonstrations for internal teams and current or prospective clients
Supporting software maintenance and client service teams with business-level troubleshooting
Assisting onboarding teams and clients with conversions and implementations, as needed 


What We Value

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

About The/Nudge

The/Nudge is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals, and youth across rural development, agriculture, skilling, and economic inclusion, in partnership with 15+ central and state governments.

Our economic inclusion journey towards serving 25 million Indians spans 10 states and currently reaches over 1.5 million people. Through our incubator, accelerator, and grand challenges, we have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs, including Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, Earthshot Prize winners, and nationally recognized changemakers.

Founded with the support of 130+ eminent philanthropists, 40+ corporates, and 15+ foundations, The/Nudge is working towards a poverty-free India, within our lifetime.

About The Insight Program

Who are we solving for?

We are solving for millions of adults in India, especially in rural communities, living with uncorrected presbyopia, a near-vision impairment affecting 1 in 3 people over 30. Without timely access to simple solutions like reading glasses, they face barriers to work and income, despite evidence showing such interventions can boost productivity by 34% and income by 20%.

What are we solving for?

Millions in India experience uncorrected presbyopia, a near-vision impairment affecting one in three people over 30, with cases now appearing as early as 35. Globally, presbyopia is the most common cause of vision impairment, impacting over 800 million people. In India alone, 300 million people live with this condition, contributing to $14 billion in lost productivity each year.

For many, especially in rural communities, clear near vision is essential for work and daily activities. Without access to timely solutions, individuals may face challenges in earning a livelihood. However, studies from Assam and Bangladesh show that a simple intervention - reading glasses - can increase productivity by 34% and boost income by 20%.

Despite the clear benefits, several factors have made it difficult for people to access reading glasses at scale.

With only one trained optometrist per 180,000 people, access to professional eye care remains a challenge in many areas.

Many individuals aren’t aware that their near-vision difficulties can be easily corrected, and some hesitate to wear glasses due to social and cultural perceptions.

Bringing reading glasses to remote and rural areas requires innovative and community-driven approaches to ensure affordability and reach.

Through the InSight Program, The/Nudge Institute is collaborating with central and state governments to make India presbyopia-free using a community-led model.

What will you do?

Define and drive product strategy by translating program needs into a clear roadmap with measurable milestones.
Lead user research to deeply understand field staff, beneficiaries, and government users, ensuring an intuitive and scalable product experience
Drive adoption within operations teams by designing onboarding, training, and change management plans, and monitoring adoption metrics

Data engineering for production-ready ETL for large datasets using software such as Apache Spark
Administer and manage third-party tools used. Eg: Survey software such as SurveyCTO, Kobo Toolbox
Work with the product team to develop automations for operations teams 

Who are we looking for in this role?

Have a strong motivation to contribute to poverty alleviation efforts in India
Are willing to make periodic field visits to understand the program and the users for whom the tech product is being built
Work with a high level of rigour - especially in implementing development and DevOps best practices
Have 5+ years of work experience in development, and/ or DevOps:
Experience with developing ETL pipelines
Experience in scripting / automations
Development experience in any programming language
Working with cloud environments such as AWS or Azure
Have the ability to work independently in an AI-first, fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment (bias for action and curiosity to learn)
What’s in it for you?

Own your growth: An impact-led learning environment encourages Nudgesters to invest in their learning and capacity building needs through initiatives and policies, including L&D wallet, individual development plan and internal role change opportunities.
Find your tribe: Our hiring philosophy emphasises intent, attitude, smarts and skills, in that order, to build a cohesive environment for Nudgesters. The organisation is committed to curating people-centric policies, enhancing how employees experience life at The/Nudge.

Job Description

Senior Vice President, POM Product Owner

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Senior Vice President, POM Product Owner to join our Payments Enablement Platform team. This role is located in Pune, India.

In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:

Define the pod roadmap and product vision, ensuring priorities are aligned to platform objectives and OKRs.
Own end-to-end delivery of pod outcomes, from intake and prioritization through execution and release.
Partner with stakeholders across business, technology, operations, and control functions to ensure the product vision aligns with platform strategy and user needs.
Translate business and user needs into clear user stories and acceptance criteria, while maintaining a healthy backlog at least 3 to 4 sprints ahead of the team.
Manage dependencies across pods and teams to support coordinated delivery against the broader Payments Enablement Platform strategy.
Track product outcomes and business value after release, communicating progress, risks, and delivery status to stakeholders on a regular basis.
Support release planning, sprint reviews, and stakeholder demos to ensure transparency and alignment throughout the delivery lifecycle.
Monitor the risk, control, and regulatory environment and adjust priorities in partnership with leadership as needed.

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:

Experience serving as a Product Owner or in a similar product delivery role within an Agile environment.
Ability to define priorities, manage backlogs, and convert strategic goals into actionable work for delivery teams.
Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across multiple teams and functions.
Excellent communication skills, including the ability to clearly articulate product vision, progress, and trade-offs.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to escalate and resolve blockers effectively.
Relevant domain knowledge in payments, financial services, platform delivery, or related business areas is preferred.
Experience working in a regulated environment is a plus.

About Us

At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide.

Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

About The Team

At BNY, our culture speaks for itself, check out the latest BNY news at: BNY Newsroom & BNY LinkedIn

Here’s a Few Of Our Recent Awards

World’s Most Admired Companies, Fortune 2025

Our Benefits And Rewards

BNY offers highly competitive compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs rooted in a strong culture of excellence and our pay-for-performance philosophy. We provide access to flexible global resources and tools for your life’s journey. Focus on your health, foster your personal resilience, and reach your financial goals as a valued member of our team, along with generous paid leaves, including paid volunteer time, that can support you and your family through moments that matter.
