Why Esko? 

Esko, part of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), is the global leader in packaging and product lifecycle solutions. More than 25,000 customers across 140+ countries rely on Esko to design, manage, manufacture, and deliver products found on store shelves every day. Packaging for 9 out of 10 major consumer brands is managed using Esko solutions. As we enter our next phase of growth, we're making significant investments in cloud, AI, and platform engineering to build the future of product innovation.

Our vision is to create the industry's leading AI-native Product Intelligence Platform. This modern, multi-tenant cloud platform unifies product, packaging, regulatory, quality, manufacturing, and supply chain data into a single intelligent ecosystem. By combining cloud-native architecture, intelligent automation, and AI-powered insights, we're helping global consumer goods, life sciences, and manufacturing companies innovate faster, improve compliance, reduce waste, and bring products to market with greater speed and confidence.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager – Cloud Platform Services to define and drive the product strategy for the cloud platform services that power Esko's SaaS products.

You will own the product direction and roadmap for foundational capabilities such as repository and data services, workflow, search, APIs, and other shared platform services used across multiple Esko products. You will work closely with Architects, Engineering leaders, and Product Managers to identify common platform needs, establish priorities, drive adoption, and translate platform strategy into an executable roadmap.

You must be comfortable engaging with Architects and Engineering leaders on APIs, distributed systems, data architectures, cloud-native services, scalability, reliability, and technical trade-offs.

What You Will Do

Define and drive the product strategy, roadmap, and priorities for Cloud Platform Services. 
Own the product direction for shared capabilities such as repository and data services, workflow, search, APIs, and other foundational platform services. 
Partner with product and engineering teams to identify common needs and opportunities for reusable platform capabilities. 
Partner with Architects and Engineering leaders on platform architecture and technical direction, bringing product context to technical decisions and trade-offs. 
Drive a strong developer experience, making platform capabilities easier to discover, integrate, and adopt. 
Lead cross-platform planning and align dependencies across Platform Services, IAM, Infrastructure Engineering, and consuming product teams. 
Balance product needs, platform investments, technical debt, reliability, scalability, and architectural evolution when setting priorities. 
Define success measures and use adoption, usage, developer experience, reliability, and business outcomes to guide platform investments. 


Required Experience

10+ years of experience in the software industry, including 5+ years in product management for cloud, SaaS, API, developer, or other technically complex software products. 
Experience owning the strategy and roadmap for platform products or shared services used by multiple products or engineering teams. 
Strong technical understanding of APIs, microservices, distributed systems, data stores, multi-tenancy, and cloud-native architectures. 
Demonstrated ability to participate effectively in architecture and technical design discussions with Architects and senior Engineers, understand trade-offs, and connect technical decisions to product outcomes. 
Experience with APIs and developer-facing products, including concepts such as API contracts, versioning, backward compatibility, integration patterns, and developer experience. 
Strong product judgment and ability to prioritize across product capabilities, technical investments, reliability, scalability, and developer experience. 
Experience defining and using adoption, usage, and outcome metrics to guide product decisions.

Preferred Experience

Prior experience in software engineering, solution architecture, technical product management, or another hands-on technical role. 
Experience with developer platforms, API platforms, or shared cloud services. 
Experience with platform capabilities such as workflow, search, repository/data services, APIs, or integration services. 
Experience in a multi-product SaaS organization where shared platform capabilities serve multiple products. 


What Success Looks Like

Cloud Platform Services have a clear strategy, roadmap, priorities, and measurable outcomes.

Solid understanding of the SDLC, technology system interfaces, and data integration.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

About The Role

In this role, you will work cross-functionally with engineering, fraud & risk, finance, operations, and third-party payment service providers (PSPs). Key Responsibilities

Product Discovery & Execution
Collaborate with Principal product manager and engineering leads to break down platform initiatives into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical PRDs (Product Requirement Documents).
Manage and prioritize the sprint backlog for our payment infrastructure workstreams (e.g., checkout APIs, gateway integrations, payouts, reconciliation).

Data Analytics & Monitoring
Define, track, and monitor core payments KPIs such as reject, return rates
Investigate transaction anomalies, settlement discrepancies, recon breaks and gateway downtime in collaboration with site reliability and support teams.
Conduct exploratory data analysis using SQL/BI dashboards to uncover platform bottlenecks and identify cost-saving routing opportunities.

Requirements & Qualifications

Experience: 3+ years of professional experience in product management, technical program management, business analysis, or software engineering (ideally within fintech, e-commerce, or SaaS).
Foundational knowledge of payment lifecycle concepts: bank payments, ACH, RTGS, Real time payments, auth/capture, interchange fees, API, settlement, financial operations and treasury management. 
Technical Aptitude: Strong comfort discussing technical concepts (APIs, webhooks, microservices, databases, system latency) with software engineers.
Analytical Skills: Hands-on experience querying data with SQL and visualizing trends using tools like Tableau, Looker, or Metabase.
Problem-Solving: Structured analytical mindset with the ability to diagnose complex edge cases (e.g., intermittent payment timeouts, currency conversion rounding).
Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to translate technical complexities into plain business language for cross-functional stakeholders.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, Economics, or equivalent practical experience.

Must Have

Familiarity with regulatory frameworks and standards such as PCI-DSS, PSD2 / Strong Customer Authentication (SCA), or local financial data privacy regulations.
Prior experience with third-party payment APIs (e.g., Stripe, Braintree, Adyen, Checkout.com).

30 Days: Develop a solid grasp of our payments architecture, data schemas, third-party vendor relationships, and current backlog.
60 Days: Own and deliver your first feature or gateway enhancement end-to-end, writing specs and collaborating with engineers through QA and launch.
90 Days: Independently identify payment optimization opportunities (e.g., smart retry logic, reducing authorization drops) and propose a data-backed feature spec.

Senior Product Manager, Search, Indexing and Query

Couchbase | Product Organisation | Bangalore, India | Reports to VP of AI Product Management

About The Role

Couchbase is building the operational data platform for AI. Search, indexing and query are the core of it — how data is found, filtered, ranked and returned is what determines whether an application, or an agent, can actually use the data underneath. We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to own that surface area across Capella and Couchbase Enterprise: the SQL++ query experience, secondary indexing, full-text search, and vector and hybrid search.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who wants to do the work at the Senior level — write the PRFAQ, sit with the customer, push the tradeoff, ship the capability, and own the outcome after launch. Reporting to the VP of AI Product Management, you will partner closely with the query, indexing and search engineering teams, with sales and GTM, and with the broader AI organization.

You do not need to have shipped a query engine or a search product before. We are hiring for the underlying capability, not the resume line — see “Who This Role Is Open To” below.

What You Will Own

Search, indexing and query as a product surface: End-to-end ownership of how customers express and satisfy a query on Couchbase — SQL++ query, global secondary indexes, full-text search, and vector and hybrid search. The roadmap in your area, the PRFAQs and PRDs, the launch, the adoption, and the iteration after launch.

Retrieval for AI applications: Make Couchbase the retrieval layer that RAG applications and agents actually use — hybrid search relevance, metadata filtering, recall and freshness, and cost per query. Work with the wider AI portfolio so retrieval composes with the rest of the platform rather than sitting beside it.

Developer experience for query and indexing: How a developer writes a query, gets an index recommendation, debugs a slow plan, and understands what a query costs. Reduce the number of things a developer has to know before their first query is fast.

Performance, cost and benchmark credibility: Own the performance story for your area. Reproducible benchmarks the field can stand behind, a defensible cost and TCO narrative against MongoDB, Elastic, Postgres and pgvector, and dedicated vector stores, and a clear point of view on where Couchbase wins and where it does not.

Working backwards from the customer: Start with the customer and work backwards. Write the PRFAQ before any code is written. Validate with real, named enterprise customers. Make clear tradeoff calls about what to build and what to defer based on what the enterprise ICP universally needs — not features chasing competitors or one-off requests outside the ICP.

Engineering partnership: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with the query, indexing and search engineering teams. Earn their trust by being technically credible, decisive on scope, and clear on the why. Own the PRD as a living document, not a one-time artifact. Hold the bar on quality, scope, and timing through to launch.

Customer and design partner engagement: Run design partner programs for the capabilities you own. Bring real customer voice into roadmap decisions and back to the broader team. Help build a pipeline of named reference customers willing to talk publicly about what they have shipped.

Cross-portfolio collaboration: Coordinate across Core Database, Capella, Analytics, Mobile and Edge, and the AI Specialist team so the capabilities you own compose cleanly with the rest of the platform. Bring a build-vs-partner point of view to your area.

Sales and GTM partnership: Equip sales, sales engineering, PMM, and partner GTM with what they need to win on search, indexing and query — positioning, demos, competitive context, benchmark data, customer proof points. Be the product owner in deals where the technical depth matters.

External voice: Contribute as the product owner in customer briefings, webinars, blog posts, documentation, and enablement content for the capabilities you own. Support analyst engagements and keynote content led by the Principal PM, PMM, and AR.

AI-driven PM practice: Use AI deeply and visibly in your own product management work — research, PRFAQ drafting, customer synthesis, competitive analysis, benchmark analysis, engineering collaboration. Adopt and contribute to the team’s AI-driven PM and AI-DLC (AI-driven development lifecycle) practices in day-to-day execution.

Raising the bar: Share what works. Contribute to PRFAQ and PRD standards, interview loops, and onboarding. Mentor associate and early-career PMs as the team grows.

What You Will Deliver

PRFAQs and PRDs for the capabilities you own, validated with named enterprise customers before engineering starts.

Shipped capabilities across query, indexing and search with measurable adoption and at least one named reference customer per major launch.

A published, reproducible performance and cost position for your area that sales and engineering both stand behind.

Clear, defensible tradeoff decisions visible to engineering, sales, and GTM. The team knows what is in, what is out, and why.

Sales and GTM enablement that the field actually uses — measured by pipeline influence and win-rate signals, not enablement-decks-produced.

Contributions to the broader platform narrative — customer-facing content, blog posts, and documentation in partnership with the AI Specialist team, PMM, and AR.

Visible AI-driven PM practice — concrete examples of AI-DLC in your daily work that the rest of the team can learn from.

Must Have

Seven or more years in product management, with at least three on a technical platform — database, data infrastructure, search, analytics, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, or AI infrastructure.

Systems depth. You can reason about latency, throughput, recall, index structures, query plans, memory and storage tradeoffs, and cost per operation. Given a benchmark or a slow query, you know what to ask next.

Customer obsession and working-backwards rigor: You start with the customer and work backwards. You write PRFAQs before code. You can tell which feature requests reflect universal ICP needs and which are noise, and you make the call clearly.

Engineering credibility: Engineers want to work with you. You hold your own on architecture, are decisive on scope, and own the why behind every tradeoff.

Cross-functional trust: Sales trusts your roadmap. GTM trusts your enablement. Marketing trusts your narrative. You build durable working relationships outside your own team.

AI-driven PM practice: You already use AI in your own PM work — research, PRFAQ drafting, customer synthesis, competitive analysis — and you can point to concrete examples.

Strength in Trust

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world’s most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what’s next.

Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next-generation skills.

People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.

About The Role

HackerRank Interviews is a live technical interviewing platform designed to evaluate how candidates solve realistic engineering problems, not just whether they can pass an algorithm test. Candidates and interviewers collaborate in a shared workspace using coding tools, production-style repositories, and Plan-Build-Review tasks. The platform also supports observable AI-assisted development, letting teams assess how candidates prompt, review, and apply AI-generated work, with observation tools and post-interview reports giving hiring teams clearer, structured evidence for decisions.

In this role, you'll help lead the Interviews product - an AI-native, pair-programming interview experience that gives interviewers the ability to collaborate with candidates on real-world problems and code repos. You'll shape how the platform evolves across richer ADE experiences (harnesses like Claude Code and Codex CLI), Chakra Assist for evaluation, richer session observation (screen sharing, A/V), and reporting across in-product, exports, APIs and MCP. You'll work closely with engineers as collaborators and as the product's core customer and user base including senior engineering leadership as stakeholders who care deeply about this space.

What You Will Do

Own the roadmap for how HackerRank Interviews evaluates AI-assisted development including richer ADE harnesses, Chakra Assist, and session observation capabilities.
Define how the platform captures and surfaces signals on how candidates prompt, review and apply AI-generated work, so interviewers get clearer, structured evidence.
Drive the reporting and integration strategy across in-product reporting, exports, APIs and MCP.
Engage directly with engineering customers and users including senior engineering leadership as the primary audience for this product, translating their needs into roadmap decisions.
Represent the product in high-visibility, customer-facing moments with composure, including when executives engage directly and unexpectedly.
Partner closely with Engineering and Design to ship production-quality, AI-native interview experiences.
Embrace AI - in how we operate, as well as in the product.

Who You Are

Overall 7+ years of total professional experience including at least 1 year of hands-on Software Engineering.
5+ years of Product Management experience, preferably building B2B SaaS, enterprise products and/or tech services and/or platforms, and you are currently working as a PM today.
Comfortable being the technical/product voice in a room full of engineers, including stakeholders like senior engineering leadership
Able to stay composed and sound under sudden high-visibility pressure for example, a CTO persona dropping into a live customer channel.
A strategic thinker who can evaluate complex challenges, prioritise effectively, and balance short-term progress with long-term success.
Deeply passionate about AI using it as a reflex across your own workflows, not just in the product you build.
Ability to deep dive into ambitious problem statements and create customer value.

Ability to work in a fast paced cross team, cross geo environment and to deliver on a common vision.
Ability to work with engineers, designers and analysts and be comfortable presenting to non-technical/business stakeholders and customers.

Even better if you have

Hands-on fluency with agentic coding harnesses (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Copilot Workspace, or similar) deep enough to reason about what a good AI-assisted engineering actually looks like.
Experience designing or owning a GTM motion where the buyer and user were engineers or engineering leadership, rather than a traditional non-technical economic buyer.

Background in HR tech, talent assessment, or technical hiring.
Experience building reporting/analytics or API-level integrations (e.g. MCP, data exports) for a technical audience.

You will thrive in this role if you

You are a builder at heart. You enjoy creating something from scratch, transforming ideas into tangible, high-impact products.
Ambiguity excites you. You’re comfortable working in undefined spaces, carving out clarity where little exists, and defining a clear vision and strategy.

You are deeply passionate about AI. You’re in the weeds and trying out AI tools constantly and are at a point where you are using AI as a reflex to try and automate several workflows in your life and 10x yourself.

Role: Product Manager - AI Services

Location: Bangalore (Quarterly visit for 2 weeks)

Function: Product Management

Reports to: Director, Packaging Intelligence

Are you... 

Passionate about architecting large-scale cloud platforms? 
Excited to define technology that powers an entire portfolio of products, not just a single application? 
Interested in building the industry's leading AI-native Product Intelligence Platform? 


If so, we'd love to meet you.

Why Esko? 

Esko, part of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), is the global leader in packaging and product lifecycle solutions. More than 25,000 customers across 140+ countries rely on Esko to design, manage, manufacture, and deliver products found on store shelves every day. Packaging for 9 out of 10 major consumer brands is managed using Esko solutions. As we enter our next phase of growth, we're making significant investments in cloud, AI, and platform engineering to build the future of product innovation.

Our vision is to create the industry's leading AI-native Product Intelligence Platform. This modern, multi-tenant cloud platform unifies product, packaging, regulatory, quality, manufacturing, and supply chain data into a single intelligent ecosystem. By combining cloud-native architecture, intelligent automation, and AI-powered insights, we're helping global consumer goods, life sciences, and manufacturing companies innovate faster, improve compliance, reduce waste, and bring products to market with greater speed and confidence.

About The Role

As Product Manager for AI Services, you will own the product lifecycle for a shared foundation of AI capabilities that Esko's internal teams build on rather than re-invent - enabling them to solve customer problems that were previously out of reach with optimal speed and efficiency.

Cross-functional collaboration sits at the core of the role. You will coach internal teams, consolidate their needs to find common ground, work with technical and design stakeholders to agree the best approach, and document clear, testable requirements that are reviewed and approved before development begins. The result is a coherent, prioritized backlog and roadmap that reflects the combined needs of Esko's product teams and aligns with company strategy and AI transformation objectives.

You will keep stakeholders updated as work progresses, then support them through acceptance testing, triage and implement change requests, and drive adoption of the services in production. Ongoing success management is central: keeping services aligned with evolving team and customer needs while maintaining a generalized approach and backwards compatibility, and growing capabilities in line with advances in technology and market expectations. You will track adoption and key performance metrics to demonstrate impact and identify where more focus is needed.

As a key member of the Esko AI team, you will also help shape the strategic vision for Esko's AI initiatives through brainstorming, thought leadership, customer discussions and events.

What You Will Do

Own and prioritize the product backlog for AI Services – a shared collection of common AI capabilities leveraged by Esko product and engineering teams.
Proactively gather needs from cross-functional product teams and turn them into clear, well-scoped requirements for the Esko AI engineering teams.
Act as a bridge between Esko AI and other cross-functional teams - product, engineering, and commercial – to ensure their success in building AI-powered capabilities that deliver on the intended customer value.
Help other teams to bootstrap their own AI initiatives on top of the shared capabilities: clarifying what already exists, what needs to be built, and how to get started.
Weigh competing requests from multiple stakeholders against the long-term company strategy and priorities, while documenting risks and expected trade-offs.
Define and maintain adoption / success metrics for the shared capabilities - and use them to continually re-prioritize the backlog and indicate risks and areas of additional focus.
Communicate roadmap, priorities, and trade-offs clearly across engineering, product, and leadership stakeholders.


What We Are Looking For

At least 5 years’ experience in a Software Product Management role, preferably including ownership of a platform, API or other shared-services product used across multiple internal teams.
Undergraduate or master’s degree in computer science or related discipline.
Native or fluent proficiency in English.
Experience initiating, deploying, and scaling AI-powered capabilities in production, with a track record of managing the development cycle from proof-of-concepts or early-stage ideas into production capabilities that other teams depend on.
Experience acting as a liaison in a large, global organization with multiple cross-functional teams - gathering and distilling requirements from varied stakeholders, aligning competing priorities, and driving toward a successful shared outcome.
Strong product management fundamentals: backlog ownership and refinement, roadmap creation & communication, and the ability to write clear, unambiguous requirements for engineering to build and test against.
Comfort operating at the boundary between a platform team and the product teams that consume it, balancing shared needs and central objectives against individual team priorities and timelines.
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to work fluently with both technical and business stakeholders alike.


Preferred Experience

Experience in packaging graphics or the wider graphic arts industry is strongly preferred. 


What Success Looks Like

Teams across the business ship AI-powered capabilities that solve valuable customer problems by leveraging a shared foundation of AI Services, rather than “re-inventing the wheel”.
Ideas and concepts forged by different teams are assessed for potential development as centralized AI services.
A roadmap for AI Services is maintained and accurately describes the status of current and plans for future objectives.
The Esko AI engineering teams work from a clearly prioritized backlog.
Cross-functional teams know exactly who to talk to when they want to bootstrap an AI initiative; and that person offers guidance on opportunities, prioritization and planning.
AI services are clearly explained and documented, with measures taken to minimize any roadblocks or barriers to successful adoption.
AI Services grows as a coherent whole rather than fragmenting into one-off, team-specific solutions.
A class-leading set of capabilities provide a powerful base for Esko cross-functional teams to transform the value of our software using cutting-edge AI technologies.


At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve. Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes.

Unsolicited Assistance

We do not accept unsolicited assistance from any headhunters or recruitment firms for any of our job openings. Experience rolling out a shared platform across regions or business units

Experience leading analysts and managing SI partners and vendors

AI in operations: document intake, triage or agent assist

Why you’ll love working with us!

Mstack is a tech-enabled specialty chemicals company that runs global sourcing, sales, logistics and finance on its own platforms. The Product team builds and runs SalesStack, ProcureStack and LogiStack, and integrates them with our ERP (Microsoft Dynamics Business Central).

Solutioning: explore options, weigh trade-offs, and pick the simplest solution that moves the metric - software, AI agent, automation or process change.
PRDs: write crisp PRDs with goals, non-goals, user flows, edge cases, success metrics and acceptance criteria that engineering can build from.
UI/UX: create wireframes and flows in Figma (or prototype directly with AI tools) and review designs for usability.
Delivery: work with engineering through sprints, unblock decisions, groom the backlog and own release quality.
GTM and adoption: plan rollout, train users, write release notes and track adoption until the feature is actually used.
Ownership: own one or more product areas end to end, with metrics you report on to leadership.

Spot AI opportunities: find repetitive, rules-heavy or communication-heavy work across teams and judge where AI is the right tool and where it isn't.
Design agentic workflows: define what an agent does, which tools and data it uses, where a human approves, and how it fails safely — for email, voice and document-based workflows.
Prototype fast: build working prototypes and internal tools yourself using tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable, n8n or Zapier before asking engineering to build at scale.
Spec AI features well: write PRDs that cover prompts, context, evaluation sets, accuracy targets, guardrails, cost per run and human-in-the-loop design.
Measure AI quality: set up evals and monitoring so we know when an agent is right, wrong or drifting.
Raise the team's AI bar: share what works, help other teams use AI in their daily work, and keep up with new models and tools.

Has built something real with AI - an agent, an automation, an internal tool or an AI feature in production - and can walk through how it works.

A public portfolio: side projects, GitHub, blog or demos of things you've built.

30 days

60 days

90 days
Launched an AI agent or automation to production with a clear metric (hours saved, cost cut, cycle time or error rate) and a plan to scale it.

,

The Data Product Manager owns the strategy, roadmap, and delivery outcomes for a portfolio of Ralph Lauren’s enterprise data products — the shared datasets, analytical assets, and AI-ready data foundations that power decision-making across the business.

Working closely with Data Engineering, Platform, Analytics, and Governance teams, as well as business stakeholders, this role defines what data products should exist, why they matter, and how success is measured — translating business needs into clear product requirements and prioritized roadmaps.

As Ralph Lauren advances its multi-year digital and AI-driven transformation, the Data Product Manager plays a central role in ensuring data products are well-defined, adopted, and continuously improved, while balancing platform constraints, governance requirements, and business value.

At a manager level, this role brings experience owning product strategy and roadmaps, leading cross-functional delivery teams, and managing senior stakeholder relationships in a complex, global organization.

,

Product Strategy & Roadmap
Define the vision, roadmap, and prioritization for assigned data products in alignment with enterprise data strategy and business priorities.
Translate business needs from stakeholders into clear product requirements and success criteria.
Balance demand across business units, weighing value, effort, and platform constraints.
Own the product backlog and ensure it reflects current priorities and dependencies.
Stakeholder & Business Partnership
Build strong relationships with business stakeholders to understand decision-making needs and data gaps.
Act as the primary point of contact for assigned data products, managing expectations and trade-offs.
Present roadmaps, progress, and outcomes to business and technology leadership.
Champion data product thinking and adoption across the organization.
Delivery Leadership
Partner with Data Engineering Managers and Scrum Masters to translate roadmaps into executable sprint plans.
Make day-to-day prioritization calls within sprints, while delegating execution details to delivery teams.
Track delivery progress, risks, and dependencies, and remove blockers where needed.
Ensure data products are delivered with appropriate documentation, testing, and operational readiness.
Value Measurement & Continuous Improvement
Define and track adoption, usage, quality, and value realization metrics for owned data products.
Use metrics and stakeholder feedback to identify opportunities for iteration or retirement.
Conduct post-launch reviews to validate whether data products are meeting intended business outcomes.
Continuously refine the product roadmap based on usage trends and changing business needs.
Governance & Data Trust
Partner with governance and security teams to ensure data products meet quality, privacy, and compliance standards.
Ensure metadata, lineage, and documentation are maintained to support discoverability and trust.
Surface and help resolve data quality or definitional issues that affect product reliability.
People & Cross-Functional Leadership
Provide product direction and mentorship to Product Analysts supporting the portfolio.
Foster collaboration across Data Engineering, Platform, Analytics, and Governance teams.
Promote consistent product management practices across the Data Product Management function.

,

Qualifications

Required

7–10 years of experience in product management, data product management, or related roles, including people or portfolio leadership.
Proven experience owning the strategy and roadmap for data, analytics, or platform products.
Strong understanding of data engineering, analytics, and BI concepts, with the ability to converse fluently with technical teams.
Demonstrated ability to manage senior stakeholder relationships and influence prioritization decisions.
Experience operating in Agile or product-based delivery models.

Preferred

Experience in retail, consumer goods, or digital commerce environments.
Background delivering enterprise data products, shared data assets, or analytical platforms at scale.
Comfort working in global, matrixed organizations.
Exposure to cloud-based data platforms and AI-driven use cases.

Success Measures

Clear, well-prioritized roadmaps for owned data products aligned to business value.
Strong adoption, usage, and satisfaction metrics for data products in the portfolio.
Predictable delivery against committed roadmaps with minimal rework.
High stakeholder confidence in product direction and decision-making.

About Techdome

Techdome builds AI-first products for enterprise clients in FinTech, Healthcare, E-commerce, EdTech, Logistics, and SaaS. Our engineers, designers, and AI specialists work on LLM-powered applications, RAG systems, conversational assistants, autonomous agents, and workflow automation, alongside scalable enterprise platforms with the integrations, security, and compliance that clients require.

Role Summary

A GenAI demo takes a weekend. A product that survives a compliance review, a budget cycle, and real users takes a PM who knows the difference.

As Product Manager, you will own each product from the first client conversation through launch and beyond. You are accountable for scope, schedule, budget, risk, and the client relationship. You will turn a talented cross-functional team into shipped products by catching unclear requirements, dropped handoffs, and unspoken risks while they are still cheap to fix.

Key Responsibilities

Product and scope

Convert client vision into clear scope, milestones, timelines, and budgets that are ambitious but technically realistic.
Learn each client’s industry, regulations, and compliance needs, and translate them into requirements the team can build without guesswork.

GenAI delivery

Work with ML engineers to move LLM, RAG, agent, and automation prototypes into reliable, scalable, safe production systems.
Define and track production metrics: accuracy, latency, evaluation results, and cost per query.
Ensure AI features integrate with client systems through APIs and meet enterprise standards for security, data privacy, and uptime.

Cross-functional leadership

Coordinate UI/UX, frontend, backend, mobile, QA, DevOps, and business analysts so handoffs are clean and nothing is left to assumption.
Plan team capacity and hold all parties to clear commitments.
Manage third-party vendors, including LLM and cloud providers.

Risk, change, and reporting

Run structured change control for scope, timeline, and budget impacts.
Identify and escalate delivery, technical, and AI-specific risks early: hallucinations, prompt injection, data privacy, bias, and runaway costs.
Track progress in JIRA or Azure DevOps and give clients and leadership clear, no-surprise updates.
Use AI tools to speed up documentation, planning, tracking, and reporting.

Requirements

Must have

3+ years as a Product Manager delivering complex enterprise software on time and within budget.
Hands-on GenAI experience, ideally having shipped at least one LLM, RAG, or agent-based product, with a clear understanding of the AI lifecycle and its risks.
Experience leading cross-functional teams across design, engineering, QA, and DevOps.
Working knowledge of Agile (Scrum/Kanban) and Waterfall, and of JIRA, Azure DevOps, Trello, or Asana.
Technical grounding in the SDLC, APIs, microservices, databases, cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), and CI/CD, enough to challenge estimates and earn engineers’ respect.
Strong judgment in managing risk, change, vendors, and stakeholders.
Excellent written and verbal communication, including with senior client stakeholders.

Good to have

Familiarity with LLM evaluation, guardrails, and cost-optimization practices.
PMP, PRINCE2, CSM, CSPO, or an AI/cloud certification.
Deep expertise in FinTech or Healthcare.
Exposure to multiple industries and the curiosity to learn a new one quickly.

Success Metrics

First 30 days: Learn Techdome’s delivery process, meet the team, and get up to speed on active client projects.

By 60 days: Independently lead at least one project, owning the plan, the risks, and the client relationship.

By 90 days: Deliver a key milestone, improve how we run projects, and earn the trust of the team and clients.

What We Offer

Technically demanding GenAI projects across multiple industries.
Daily collaboration with experienced designers, engineers, QA specialists, and AI experts.
A real voice in how projects are planned, run, and delivered.
Deep expertise-building at the frontier of GenAI.

Job Description

Availity is seeking a Senior Product Manager to own the strategy, roadmap, discovery, delivery and measurable outcomes for the User & Organization (U&O) Platform, a foundational platform layer that enables shared identity, organization management, user administration and access capabilities across Availity products.

This is a product leader who can connect customers and market needs with enterprise platform strategy. Success in this role requires balancing frictionless customer experiences with security, privacy, compliance, reliability, and scalability. The Senior Product Manager will influence investment decisions and align Product, Engineering, Architecture, Security, Compliance, Operations and customer-facing teams around a coherent long-term platform direction

Roles & Responsibilities

About Availity 

Availity is a leading healthcare technology company focused on simplifying healthcare administration and solving real-world challenges for healthcare providers, health plans, and patients. Our technology helps reduce complexity, so providers can spend less time navigating administrative systems and more time focused on patient care.

Our India organization is being built with a strong focus on ownership, learning, collaboration, engineering excellence, and meaningful business impact. Associates in India have the opportunity to solve complex problems, contribute to global initiatives, and support products and services that are part of the U.S. healthcare ecosystem.

About The Role

Availity is seeking a Senior Product Manager to own the strategy, roadmap, discovery, delivery and measurable outcomes for the User & Organization (U&O) Platform, a foundational platform layer that enables shared identity, organization management, user administration and access capabilities across Availity products. 
This is a product leader who can connect customers and market needs with enterprise platform strategy. The role will define reusable capabilities that simplify how users, administrators and organizations are represented, verified, authenticated, authorized and governed within a complex, multi-tenant healthcare ecosystem.

The Senior Product Manager will influence investment decisions and align Product, Engineering, Architecture, Security, Compliance, Operations and customer-facing teams around a coherent long-term platform direction

Role Mandate 

Turn identity, organization and access management into a scalable shared platform that reduces product-by-product duplication, strengthens trust, and accelerates enterprise growth.

How Success Will Be Measured

Success in this role will include: 

A clear, evidence-based U&O platform strategy that aligns executive stakeholders, delivery teams and consuming product teams. 
Increased adoption and reuse of shared identity, organization and access-management capabilities. 
Reduced duplication of identity, user-administration and access-management capabilities across Availity products. 
Reduced effort and lead time required for products to integrate with shared U&O services. 
Measurable improvement in user and administrator journeys, including registration, onboarding, sign-in, account recovery and access administration. 
Improved customer and administrator satisfaction with identity, organization and access-management experiences. 
Stronger access governance, assurance alignment, traceability, auditability, and policy consistency across the platform. 
Improved platform reliability, scalability, security, and release predictability. 
Successful migration of priority products and customers to share U&O capabilities with controlled customer and operational risk. 
Increased visibility into users, organizations, affiliations, roles, entitlements, and product access. 
Reduced manual administration, avoidable support demand, and operational complexity. 
Roadmap and investment decisions that are demonstrably tied to customer outcomes, enterprise value, risk reduction, and long-term platform health.

Experience delivering platform capabilities that serve multiple products, customer segments, or business workflows. 
Proven ability to define reusable platform capabilities while balancing legitimate product-specific and customer-specific requirements. 
Experience leading customer and product migrations from legacy or fragmented capabilities to shared platform services. 
Proven success partnering with Engineering, Security, Architecture, Compliance, Operations and customer-facing teams to deliver enterprise platform capabilities. 
Strong understanding of platform reliability, scalability, security, privacy, observability, and operational readiness.

LotusFlare is a provider of cloud-native SaaS products based in the heart of Silicon Valley. Founded by the team that helped Facebook reach over one billion users, LotusFlare was founded to make affordable mobile communications available to everyone on Earth.

Today, LotusFlare focuses on designing, building, and continuously evolving a digital commerce and monetization platform that delivers valuable outcomes for enterprises. Our platform, Digital Network Operator® (DNO™) Cloud, is licensed to telecommunications services providers and supports millions of customers globally.

LotusFlare has also designed and built the leading eSIM travel product - Nomad. Nomad provides global travelers with high-speed, affordable data connectivity in over 190 countries. Nomad is available as an iOS or Android app or via getnomad.app.

Job Description And Responsibilities

You will own the platform that helps our sales and marketing teams bring LotusFlare to life for CSPs, showing what our technology can do in the context of each customer's business. It is also a place to build and try new ideas that are not yet part of the core product, so we can learn what excites the market before we commit to them. You will report to the director of product and lead a team of four engineers.

What success looks like in the first year

Sales and marketing can set up a tailored demo themselves, with far less engineering time per demo than today.
Booth and call demos run reliably, with problems found before the client sees them.
A working experiment track: ideas come in, get tested, and at least some graduate to the core roadmap or are retired with a clear reason.
The four-person team delivers predictably, and sales and marketing trust the roadmap.

Responsibilities

Discovery and roadmap: You turn what sales and marketing need into a prioritized roadmap and tickets the engineers can build from.

Talk regularly with sales, pre-sales and marketing to learn demo pain points, upcoming client needs and conference plans.
Balance two kinds of demos: live sales-call demos tailored to a specific CSP, and booth demos that must run reliably and with little supervision.
Check each demo request against current DNO capabilities and decide what belongs on the platform roadmap, what is a one-off, and what is a request to the core product team.
Write clear requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
Create the demo process, user guides and training that drive adoption by non-technical users.

Experimental features: You run the part of the platform where we develop and host features that are not yet part of the core product, and test them before they reach it.

Set up how experiments are proposed, selected and scoped, and keep them small enough to ship quickly.
Define up front what each experiment must show, such as client reaction in demos, conference interest or sales feedback.
Decide, with the evidence, whether an experiment graduates to the core product roadmap, continues, or is retired.
Hand graduating features to the core product team with the context they need.
Keep experiments clearly labeled so sales never presents an unreleased feature as available.

Technical partnership and demo quality: You work alongside engineering and do not own architecture decisions alone; you bring the product context and the tradeoffs.

Work with the engineering lead and backend teams on API integrations and data flows between the platform and DNO systems.
Define requirements for how AI tools and agents set up demo environments, generate demo data and build demo experiences, so sales can prepare demos with minimal engineering support.
Take part in architecture discussions, understand the tradeoffs, and help the team make decisions.
Work with engineering to keep demo environments, data and key journeys stable, with automated tests where they pay off, so every demo is client-ready.

Leading the team and delivery

Lead a team of four engineers: set priorities, give feedback and support their growth.
Run sprint planning, backlog refinement and retrospectives, using Scrum or Kanban as fits the team.
Own delivery of features from requirements through to production release.
Track dependencies on other teams, flag risks early and keep stakeholders informed of timelines.
Report progress and results to leadership in plain, non-technical terms.

Job Requirements

4+ years of product management experience, ideally with B2B SaaS or platform products.

Experience owning features or a product from discovery through delivery.
Experience working with sales, pre-sales or marketing teams as users or stakeholders.
Comfortable working daily with engineers and writing clear tickets and acceptance criteria.
Working knowledge of APIs and system integrations.
Hands-on use of AI tools in your own work, and the ability to prototype ideas quickly.
Experience running sprint ceremonies for an engineering team.
Clear communication with both technical and non-technical audiences, including leadership.
Experience leading or mentoring people is a plus; if you have not managed engineers before, tell us how you have led without authority.

Nice to have

Telecom or digital BSS domain knowledge.
Experience building products for internal users.
Familiarity with AI agents and MCP servers.
Experience with demo tooling or conference and event demos.

Benefits We Have For You

Competitive salary package
Paid lunch (In the office)
Private healthcare
Yearly bonus
Training and workshops
Truly flexible working hours
Top-of-the-class engineers to learn from and work with

About Us

At LotusFlare, we attract and keep amazing people by offering two key things:

Purposeful Work: Every team member sees how their efforts make a tangible, positive difference for our customers and partners.
Growth Opportunities: We provide the chance to develop professionally while mastering cutting-edge practices in cloud-native enterprise software.

From the beginning, our mission has been to simplify technology to create better experiences for customers. Using an “experience down” approach, which prioritizes the customer's journey at every stage of development, our Digital Network Operator™ Cloud empowers communication service providers to achieve valuable business outcomes. DNO Cloud enables communication service providers to innovate freely, reduce operational costs, monetize network assets, engage customers on all digital channels, drive customer acquisition, and increase retention.

With headquarters in Santa Clara, California, and five major offices worldwide, LotusFlare serves Deutsche Telekom, T-Mobile, A1, Globe Telecom, Liberty Latin America, Singtel, and other leading enterprises around the world.

*1. JOB PURPOSE*

To lead and manage the complete product development process of imitation jewellery, including conceptualisation, designing, sampling, material selection, product costing and coordination with manufacturing teams. The position is responsible for developing innovative, market-oriented and commercially viable jewellery products while ensuring cost efficiency, product quality and timely execution.

*2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES*

*A. Product Development*

* Lead the development of new imitation jewellery collections based on current fashion trends, market research and customer requirements.
* Identify new product opportunities, designs, materials, finishes and manufacturing techniques.
* Develop product concepts from initial ideas to final approved samples.
* Coordinate with sampling and production teams for prototype development and product modifications.
* Ensure all new products are commercially viable and suitable for bulk manufacturing.
* Maintain a systematic database of new products, approved samples and product specifications.

*B. Jewellery Designing*

* Lead the design and development of necklaces, earrings, bangles, bracelets, rings, pendants and jewellery sets.
* Prepare creative designs, sketches, technical drawings and detailed product specifications.
* Ensure designs are aligned with brand identity, customer expectations and prevailing market trends.
* Guide designers and sampling personnel in converting concepts into finished products.
* Review and approve design concepts and samples before submission to management or customers.
* Ensure originality and confidentiality of designs and product developments.

*C. Product Costing & Pricing*

* Prepare detailed product-wise costing sheets for all newly developed jewellery.
* Calculate material consumption, stone costs, components, labour, plating, polishing, assembly and finishing charges.
* Account for wastage, rejection, manufacturing overheads, packaging and other applicable expenses.
* Establish appropriate manufacturing costs and recommend selling prices based on target profit margins.
* Compare estimated costing with actual production costs and identify variations.
* Identify cost-reduction opportunities without compromising product quality.
* Coordinate with purchase and production departments to obtain updated raw material prices and manufacturing rates.
* Ensure costing accuracy before finalising product quotations.

*D. Production & Interdepartmental Coordination*

* Coordinate with production, purchase, quality control, stores and merchandising departments.
* Ensure approved designs and specifications are followed during bulk production.
* Resolve technical and design-related issues arising during manufacturing.
* Monitor sample development schedules and ensure timely completion.
* Review production feasibility, material availability and manufacturing capacity before finalising new products.
* Work closely with quality control to maintain consistency in product finishing, plating and workmanship.

*E. Team Management & Reporting*

* Lead and supervise the product development, design and costing team.
* Allocate responsibilities and monitor individual and departmental performance.
* Establish systems for design approvals, sample tracking and costing documentation.
* Submit periodic reports to management on new product development, costing, sample status and production feasibility.
* Ensure timely execution of assigned product development projects.

*3. REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS*

* Thorough knowledge of imitation jewellery manufacturing processes.
* Strong understanding of jewellery components, stones, beads, chains, metal accessories and plating.
* Expertise in product development, design concepts and sampling.
* Good understanding of material consumption and manufacturing costing.
* Knowledge of labour costing, wastage, overheads and profit-margin calculations.
* Proficiency in CorelDRAW, Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop or relevant design software.
* Knowledge of market trends and fashion forecasting.
* Leadership, negotiation, communication and coordination skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

*4. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)*

* Number of commercially viable new products developed every month.
* Timely completion of product development and sample approvals.
* Accuracy of estimated product costing against actual manufacturing costs.
* Achievement of targeted product cost and profit margins.
* Reduction in material wastage and manufacturing costs.
* Design innovation and customer sample approval ratio.
* Timely coordination and resolution of production-related issues.
* Overall performance and productivity of the product development team.

*5. AUTHORITY & ACCOUNTABILITY*

* Responsible for product development, design and costing activities.
* Recommend new materials, components and manufacturing processes.
* Recommend cost optimisation measures and design modifications.
* Review and approve samples within the authority delegated by management.
* Submit final product costing and pricing recommendations for management approval.
* Accountable for the accuracy of costing, timely product development and commercial viability of new products.

*6. OVERALL RESPONSIBILITY*

The Manager – Product Development, Design & Costing shall be responsible for transforming creative jewellery concepts into commercially successful products by ensuring effective design development, accurate costing, manufacturing feasibility, cost optimisation and coordination with all concerned departments.

Job Description: Short Description for Internal Candidates

We are looking for a technically strong Manager – AI Product Experience to own the design and delivery of AI-powered product features for the Accounts Receivable and Order-to-Cash domain. The role combines hands-on AI engineering capability with product management ownership, requiring the incumbent to work closely with data scientists, software engineers, and Finance stakeholders to ship intelligent AR automation that reduces DSO, improves cash application accuracy, and enhances collections intelligence.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Product Design & AI Strategy

Define and manage the AI product roadmap for AR capabilities: cash application automation, deductions management, credit risk scoring, collections prioritization, and dispute resolution.
Translate AR business requirements into AI architectures, orchestration frameworks, and product features that deliver measurable outcomes (DSO reduction, auto-match rate improvement).
Design Generative AI solutions using state-of-the-art models (GPT-4o, Claude, Llama 3) for AR-specific tasks: automated remittance parsing, dispute email generation, and intelligent customer communication.
Architect Agentic AI workflows for autonomous AR operations: cash matching agents, dispute classification agents, and collections prioritization agents using LangChain, AutoGen, and CrewAI.

Technical Leadership

Guide data science and ML engineering teams in building, fine-tuning, and deploying LLMs and ML models for AR use cases: payment prediction, credit risk scoring, and anomaly detection.
Architect scalable AI pipelines on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP); drive adoption of LLM orchestration stacks and MLOps practices for production AR AI systems.
Stay current on advancements in Generative AI, NLP, and ML engineering frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph); proactively incorporate innovations into the AR AI product.
Ensure AI solutions meet compliance, security, and auditability standards applicable to receivables and financial data.

Client Engagement

Collaborate with client Finance technology teams and AR operations leads to identify AI-driven automation opportunities and co-define solution requirements.
Present Generative AI use cases, proof-of-concept demos, and ROI narratives to both technical and non-technical client audiences.
Act as a trusted product and AI advisor to clients on the technical, ethical, and operational considerations of deploying AR AI solutions.
Support Sr. AVP in first-engagement solutioning, client workshops, and RFP/RFI responses for AR transformation engagements.

Product Management & Delivery

Write detailed Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), user stories, and acceptance criteria for AI-powered AR features; manage and prioritize the product backlog.
Conduct user discovery interviews with AR operations teams, controllers, and treasury leads to surface pain points and validate product hypotheses.
Lead sprint planning, grooming, and retrospectives with cross-functional Agile engineering teams; manage release readiness across QA, UX, and compliance workstreams.
Define and track product metrics: cash application hit rate, auto-match accuracy, DSO improvement, collector productivity, and AI model performance.
Author product collateral: demo scripts, solution one-pagers, sales enablement decks, and ROI calculators for AR AI solutions.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education & Experience (9–12 Years)

B.Tech or M.Tech in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical discipline.
9–12 years of total experience, with at least 4–5 years in AI/ML product engineering and 3+ years of Finance technology experience with strong AR/O2C domain exposure.
3–4 years of hands-on experience with Generative AI and Large Language Models: prompt engineering, LLM fine-tuning, and building applications using LangChain, LlamaIndex, or RAGAS.
Hands-on experience with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow) and applying ML models to finance classification, prediction, and anomaly detection use cases.
Working experience with Agentic AI concepts: Autonomous Agents, AutoGen, CrewAI, LangGraph; ability to design and deploy multi-step AI agent workflows for AR automation.
Experience in ML Engineering and MLOps: model deployment, performance monitoring, versioning, and retraining pipelines (MLflow, SageMaker, Azure ML).
Strong software engineering skills in Python; experience building AI-powered APIs, integrations, and cloud-native microservices.
Proven track record of delivering AI product features from ideation through production deployment in an Agile environment; CSPO or equivalent certification preferred.

Skills & Competencies

Solid functional knowledge of Accounts Receivable: cash application, collections, credit management, deductions, billing, and ERP AR modules (SAP FSCM, Oracle Fusion AR, HighRadius, Esker).
Experience with NLP techniques for remittance advice parsing, dispute letter classification, and payment confirmation extraction from unstructured documents.
Understanding of Vector Databases and Graph Databases and their application in AR knowledge retrieval, semantic matching, and customer intelligence.
Familiarity with cloud AI services (AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, GCP Vertex AI) for both model inferencing and fine-tuning AR-specific models.
Strong SQL and Python proficiency; experience with BI/analytics tools (Tableau, Power BI) for data-driven product and model performance decisions.
Excellent communication skills: ability to explain Generative AI concepts and product value to non-technical Finance audiences.
Experience working cross-functionally across engineering, data science, UX, and Finance SME teams; comfortable managing competing priorities in a fast-paced product environment.
Participation in RFI/RFP, thought leadership, and client-facing solutioning activities preferred.

jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

About the Role

Harness is looking for a Staff Product Manager to define the future of Agentic Application Security. You will lead our Code Security and AI Security Agents portfolio, spanning static application security testing (SAST), AI-powered vulnerability triage, and autonomous remediation.

As AI coding agents transform how software is built, security must evolve beyond detecting vulnerabilities to autonomously investigating, validating, and fixing them at machine speed.

We are looking for a product leader who can help build autonomous security engineering systems that understand code, reason about security risks, generate secure fixes, and continuously validate outcomes across modern development environments.

What You'll Own
AI-Native Code Security: Own the strategy and roadmap for SAST, code analysis, reachability, exploitability, and AI-powered vulnerability discovery.
Autonomous Security Agents: Build intelligent triage and remediation agents that investigate findings, assess risk, generate fixes, and verify security outcomes.
Agentic Remediation Workflows: Drive autonomous repository analysis, multi-file code changes, dependency upgrades, test generation, regression validation, and pull request creation.
Agentic Developer Ecosystem: Integrate security into AI coding assistants, autonomous development agents, IDEs, SCM, and CI/CD workflows.
Next-Generation Security Testing: Explore LLM-driven security analysis, sandbox execution, exploit validation, and continuous security testing.
Product Strategy & Execution: Own product differentiation, customer engagement, roadmap execution, adoption, and business outcomes while partnering with engineering, security research, and go-to-market teams.
What We're Looking For
8+ years of product management experience in Application Security, AI Developer Tools, DevSecOps, or software engineering platforms.
Strong understanding of application security, SAST, vulnerability management, secure coding, and developer workflows.
Experience or strong technical familiarity with AI coding agents, LLM orchestration, tool calling, and autonomous software development.
Understanding of how agents reason over repositories, plan and execute tasks, modify code, run tests, and iteratively resolve failures.
Ability to translate advances in AI and software engineering into reliable, enterprise-grade products.
Proven experience driving product strategy, technical execution, customer adoption, and measurable business outcomes.
Strong technical judgment and ability to collaborate with engineering, security research, and executive stakeholders.
Nice to Have
Experience building autonomous coding agents, AI-native developer tools, or application security products.
Knowledge of code property graphs, dataflow analysis, reachability, exploitability, and software composition analysis.
Familiarity with multi-agent architectures, MCP, sandbox environments, agent memory, and feedback-driven execution.
Experience with automated vulnerability remediation, secure code generation, and verification workflows.
Background in software engineering, security engineering, or AI/ML.
Why Join Harness?

Help define the next generation of application security, where intelligent agents don't just identify vulnerabilities but autonomously investigate, remediate, and verify them.

At Harness, you'll work at the intersection of AI, application security, and software engineering to build security products designed for a world where humans and AI agents develop software together.

What You Will Have at Harness

Competitive salary
Comprehensive healthcare benefits
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
Flexible Time Off and Parental Leave
Quarterly Harness TGIF-Off / 4 days
Monthly, quarterly, and annual social and team-building events
Recharge & Reset Program
Monthly internet reimbursement
Commuter benefits
Harness in the news:
Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5.5 billion valuation
How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale | Jyoti Bansal
Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare
Harness has been named to the Inc. Power Partner list for software delivery success

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin.

At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https://harness-privacy.relyance.ai/

Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers

We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers.

Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. Additionally, Harness will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via our website. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations.

If you believe that you have been the target of an interview/offer scam by someone posing as a representative of Harness, please do not provide any personal or financial information and contact us immediately at security@harness.io. You can also find additional information about this type of scam and report any fraudulent employment offers via the Federal Trade Commission’s website (https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams), or you can contact your local law enforcement agency.
